Complexity.counter_carry_step
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_carry_step (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (pre bs : List Bool) :
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.step (counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) []) =
      if bs.head? = some true then
        counterCfg x 1 p (pre.length + 1) (pre ++ false :: bs.tail) []
      else counterCfg x 2 p (pre.length - 1) (pre ++ true :: bs.tail) []

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counter_carry
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_carry (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ pre : List Bool,
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) [])
        (counterCarry bs + 1) =
      counterCfg x 2 p ((pre.length : ℤ) + counterCarry bs - 1)
        (pre ++ counterInc bs) []

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counter_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_rewind (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ bs.length),
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 2 p ((j : ℤ) - 1) bs []) (j + 1) =
      counterCfg x 0 p 0 bs []

Complexity.counter_increment
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_increment (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length)
    (bs : List Bool) :
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 bs [])
        (2 * counterCarry bs + 2) =
      counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ 0 (counterInc bs) []

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counter_count
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_count (x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length),
    ∃ t, t + 2 * i.bits.count true ≤ 4 * i ∧
      FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.initCfg x) t =
        counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 i.bits []

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counter_emit_run

private lemma counter_emit_run (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ i (_hi : i ≤ bs.length),
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 3 p 0 bs []) i =
      counterCfg x 3 p i bs (bs.take i)

    (hturn : M.step (F L) = R L)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem catalog_write_take {Symbol : Type*} (f : ℤ → Option Symbol) (a : ℤ)
    (w : List Symbol) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
    Function.update
      (fun q => if a ≤ q ∧ q < a + (r : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - a) else f q)
      (a + (r : ℤ)) (some w[r]) =
      (fun q => if a ≤ q ∧ q < a + ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
        then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - a) else f q)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.catalog_clear_trace
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma catalog_clear_trace {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .sweep)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) (t : ℕ) :
    (clearTM k i).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace (catalogClearF i d) (catalogClearR i d w.length)
        { d with state := some .done
                 workTapes := fun j q =>
                   if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
                     then none else d.workTapes j q } w.length t

Turing.catalogSweepResidueR
Turing.catalog_trace_clauses
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma catalog_trace_clauses {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x)
    (touched : Fin k → Prop) [DecidablePred touched] (F R : ℕ → Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x)
    (D : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (L : ℕ)
    (htrace : ∀ t, M.runFrom d t = catalogTrace F R D L t)
    (hF : ∀ r, (F r).state = some .sweep ∧
      ∀ j, (F r).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if touched j then (r : ℤ) else 0)
    (hR : ∀ r, (R r).state = some .rewind ∧
      ∀ j, (R r).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if touched j then (r : ℤ) - 1 else 0)
    (hD : D.state = some .done ∧ D.workTapePos = d.workTapePos) :
    (∀ t < 2 * L + 2, (M.runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
    (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * L + 2 →
      if touched j then
        (M.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
          Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (L : ℤ))
      else (M.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.catalog_transferMap_trace
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma catalog_transferMap_trace {Symbol : Type*} {Δ : Type*} {x : List Symbol}
    (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (extract : Symbol → Δ)
    (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (rest : Symbol → Option Symbol) (w : List Symbol)
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .sweep)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) (t : ℕ) :
    (transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace
        (catalogSweepF src dst (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map
          fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ)) d)
        (catalogSweepResidueR src dst (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map
          fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ))
          (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos src)).bind rest) d w.length)
        { d with state := some .done
                 workTapes := (catalogSweepResidueR src dst
                   (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map
                     fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ))
                   (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos src)).bind rest)
                   d w.length 0).workTapes }
        w.length t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.catalog_compare_trace
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma catalog_compare_trace {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {x : List Symbol}
    (fst snd : Fin k) (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p)
    (hv : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (v.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p)
    (δ : ℕ) (hδ : δ ≤ min u.length v.length)
    (hp : ∀ r < δ, ∃ b, u[r]? = some b ∧ v[r]? = some b)
    (hs : ¬∃ b, u[δ]? = some b ∧ v[δ]? = some b)
    (he : (u[δ]? = v[δ]?) ↔ u = v) (t : ℕ) :
    (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace (catalogCompareF fst snd d)
        (catalogCompareR fst snd d (decide (u = v)))
        { d with state := some (.done (decide (u = v))) } δ t

private lemma catalog_increment_trace (i : Fin k) (w : List Bool)
    (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hw : ∀ q : ℤ, -1 ≤ q → q ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →

theorem transferMapTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {Δ : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (extract : Symbol → Δ)
    (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (rest : Symbol → Option Symbol) (w : List Symbol)
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some SweepPhase.done
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = src ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).bind rest
            else if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).map
                fun γ => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract γ)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2,
        ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).state ≠
          some SweepPhase.done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
        if j = src ∨ j = dst then
          ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
        else ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).workTapePos j =
          d.workTapePos j)

    (w : Fin k → List Bool) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (hdst : w dst = []) :
    ({ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w) with
        state := some q'
        workTapes := fun j p =>
          if j = src ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧
              p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ)
            then none

          else (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapes j p } : Cfg k Bool S x) =

theorem capture_visitedByTapeHead {k : ℕ} {S H : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool H)
    (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool),
      host.tr (emb s) inp w =
        captureAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp fun i => w i.castSucc))
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) :
    (∀ i : Fin k,
      host.visitedByTapeHead (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t i.castSucc
        = tm.visitedByTapeHead c₀ t i ∧
      host.spaceUsedByTape (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t i.castSucc
        = tm.spaceUsedByTape c₀ t i) ∧
    host.spaceUsedByTape (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t (Fin.last k)
      ≤ (tm.runFrom c₀ t).output.length - c₀.output.length + 1

private lemma f2_catalogPrefixTM_computes (w : List Bool) :
    (f2_catalogPrefixTM w).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => w ++ x) (fun n => w.length + n + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_scanCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private def f2_scanCfg {S : Type} (x : List Bool) (q : Option S)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) : Cfg 0 Bool S x

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_scanCfg_read
Turing.FinTM.f2_scanCopy_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_scanCopy_run {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = match inp with
      | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some q⟩
      | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩)
    (x out : List Bool) : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ x.length),
    tm.runFrom (f2_scanCfg x (some q) 0 (by omega) out) j =
      f2_scanCfg x (some q) j hj (out ++ x.take j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_scanCopy_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_scanCopy_finish {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = match inp with
      | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some q⟩
      | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩)
    (x out : List Bool) :
    tm.runFrom (f2_scanCfg x (some q) 0 (by omega) out) (x.length + 1) =
      f2_scanCfg x none x.length (by omega) (out ++ x)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairDupTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: private def f2_pairDupTM : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairDup_double
Turing.FinTM.f2_pairDup_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_pairDup_computes (x : List Bool) :
    f2_pairDupTM.ComputesInTime x (pairEncode x x) (4 * (x.length + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_scanCopy_suffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_scanCopy_suffix {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = match inp with
      | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some q⟩
      | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩)
    (x rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    tm.runFrom (f2_scanCfg x (some q) pre.length (by simp [hx]) out) (rest.length + 1) =
      f2_scanCfg x none x.length (by omega) (out ++ rest)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_scanTrues_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_scanTrues_run {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (emit : Bool)
    (htr : ∀ work, tm.tr q (some true) work =
      ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, if emit then some false else none, some q⟩)
    (x : List Bool) : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ x.length),
    x.take j = List.replicate j true →
    tm.runFrom (f2_scanCfg x (some q) 0 (by omega) []) j =
      f2_scanCfg x (some q) j hj (if emit then List.replicate j false else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_incFixed_cases
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_incFixed_cases (x : List Bool) :
    (x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ incFixed x = none) ∨
      ∃ j rest, x = List.replicate j true ++ false :: rest ∧
        incFixed x = some (List.replicate j false ++ true :: rest)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_incFixedTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: private def f2_incFixedTM : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_incFixed_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_incFixed_computes (x : List Bool) :
    f2_incFixedTM.ComputesInTime x ((incFixed x).getD []) (3 * (x.length + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_scanStep_right
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_scanStep_right {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S)
    (x : List Bool) (q : S) (q' : Option S) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length)
    (out : List Bool) (emit : Option Bool)
    (htr : ∀ work, tm.tr q x[i]? work = ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, emit, q'⟩) :
    tm.step (f2_scanCfg x (some q) i (by omega) out) =
      f2_scanCfg x q' (i + 1) (by omega) (out ++ emit.toList)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairValidTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: private def f2_pairValidTM : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairValid_block
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_pairValid_block (x pre rest : List Bool) (b c : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: c :: rest) :
    f2_pairValidTM.tm.runFrom (f2_scanCfg x (some none) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) 2 =
      if b = c then f2_scanCfg x (some none) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) []
      else f2_scanCfg x none (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) [!b && c]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairValid_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_pairValid_run (x rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1,
      (f2_pairValidTM.tm.runFrom
        (f2_scanCfg x (some none) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) t).state = none ∧
      (f2_pairValidTM.tm.runFrom
        (f2_scanCfg x (some none) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) t).output =
          [(pairDecode rest).isSome]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairValid_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_pairValid_computes (x : List Bool) :
    f2_pairValidTM.ComputesInTime x [(pairDecode x).isSome] (x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: private def f2_pairExtractTM (first second : Bool) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extractCfg
Turing.FinTM.f2_extractCfg_read
Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_first
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_extract_first (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    (f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.step
      (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) =
      f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl (some b))) (pre.length + 1) (by simp [hx]) a a.length []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_block
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_extract_block (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b c : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: c :: rest) :
    (f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) 2 =
      if b = c then f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx])
          (a ++ [b]) (a ++ [b]).length []
      else if b then f2_extractCfg x none (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) a a.length []
      else f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_extract_rewind (first second : Bool) (x a : List Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : ∀ j, j ≤ a.length →
    (f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) i hi a ((j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) =
      f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_replay
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_extract_replay (first second : Bool) (x a : List Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ a.length),
    (f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a 0 []) j =
      f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a j (if first then a.take j else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_replay_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_extract_replay_finish (first second : Bool) (x a : List Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :
    (f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a 0 []) (a.length + 1) =
      f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 2)) i hi a a.length (if first then a else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_suffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_extract_suffix (first : Bool) (x rest a : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    (f2_pairExtractTM first true).tm.runFrom
      (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 2)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length out)
        (rest.length + 1) =
      f2_extractCfg x none x.length (by omega) a a.length (out ++ rest)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_extract_finish (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ rest) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * a.length + rest.length + 3,
      ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []) t).state = none ∧
      ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []) t).output =
          (if first then a else []) ++ (if second then rest else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_extract_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_extract_run (first second : Bool) (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre a (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    ∃ t ≤ 3 * rest.length + 2 * a.length + 5,
      ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) t).state = none ∧
      ((f2_pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (f2_extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) t).output =
          match pairDecode rest with
          | some (b, c) => (if first then a ++ b else []) ++ (if second then c else [])
          | none => []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairExtract_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_pairExtract_computes (first second : Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (f2_pairExtractTM first second).ComputesInTime x
      (match pairDecode x with
        | some (a, b) => (if first then a else []) ++ (if second then b else [])
        | none => []) (5 * (x.length + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: private instance f2_catalogPolyControlDecidableEq (c C : ℕ) : DecidableEq (f2_CatalogPolyControl c C)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: private def f2_catalogPolyTape (q : ℕ) (z : ℤ) : Option Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: private def f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM (c C : ℕ) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyCfg
Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyMove_apply
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogPolyMove_apply {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (s s' : f2_CatalogPolyControl c C) (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (o : List Bool)
    (i : Fin (c + 1)) (d : SignType) :
    (f2_catalogPolyMove i d s').apply (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q s h o) =
      f2_catalogPolyCfg x q s' (Function.update h i (h i + d.cast)) o

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_emit
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogPoly_emit {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ C) (o : List Bool),
    (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.emit ⟨j, by omega⟩) h o) (j + 1) =
      f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance 0) h (o ++ List.replicate j true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogPoly_rewind {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (o : List Bool) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ q),
    (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.rewind i) (Function.update h i ((j : ℤ) - 1)) o) (j + 1) =
      f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩) (Function.update h i 0) o

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_advance
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogPoly_advance {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (o : List Bool) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.step
      (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) h o) =
      f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop i) (Function.update h i (h i + 1)) o

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyCost
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: private def f2_catalogPolyCost (q C : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_loop
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogPoly_loop {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) (_hq : 0 < q) :
    ∀ i (hi : i < c + 1) (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ)
      (_hh : ∀ k, k.val ≤ i → h k = 0) (o : List Bool) (r j : ℕ), j + r = q →
    (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop ⟨i, hi⟩) (Function.update h ⟨i, hi⟩ (j : ℤ)) o)
      (r * (f2_catalogPolyCost q C i + 2) + q + 2) =
      f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩) h
        (o ++ List.replicate (r * (C * q ^ i)) true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyTape_write
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogPolyTape_write (q : ℕ) :
    Function.update (f2_catalogPolyTape q) (q : ℤ) (some true) = f2_catalogPolyTape (q + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyCost_le
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogPolyCost_le (q C : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) : ∀ r,
    f2_catalogPolyCost q C r ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * r) * q ^ r

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPolyCopyCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private def f2_catalogPolyCopyCfg (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_copy
Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_setup
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogPoly_setup (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ q),
    (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (f2_catalogPolyCfg x q .setup (fun _ => (j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) =
      f2_catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop (Fin.last c)) (fun _ => 0) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogPoly_start (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) :
    (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.initCfg x)
      (2 * (x.length + 1)) =
      f2_catalogPolyCfg x (x.length + 1) (.loop (Fin.last c)) (fun _ => 0) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPoly_unary_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogPoly_unary_computes (c C : ℕ) :
    (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ (c + 1)) true)
      (fun n => (C + 5 * (c + 1) + 4) * (n + 1) ^ (c + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_polyHeads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private def f2_polyHeads {d C : ℕ} (q : ℕ)
    (s : Option (f2_CatalogPolyControl d C)) (h : Fin (d + 1) → ℤ) : Prop

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_polyHeads_bounds
Turing.FinTM.f2_poly_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_poly_step {d C q : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (hq : 0 < q)
    (c : Cfg (d + 1) Bool (f2_CatalogPolyControl d C) x)
    (hw : c.workTapes = fun _ => f2_catalogPolyTape q)
    (hp : f2_polyHeads q c.state c.workTapePos) :
    ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.step c).workTapes =
        (fun _ => f2_catalogPolyTape q) ∧
      f2_polyHeads q ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.step c).state
        ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.step c).workTapePos

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_head_steps
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_head_steps {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin k) :
    c.workTapePos i - (t : ℤ) ≤ (M.runFrom c t).workTapePos i ∧
      (M.runFrom c t).workTapePos i ≤ c.workTapePos i + (t : ℤ)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_poly_space
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_poly_space (d C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.spaceUsed
      ((f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
        (5 * (d + 1)) * (x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterTape_read
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_counterTape_read (pre bs : List Bool) :
    f2_counterTape (pre ++ bs) pre.length = bs.head?

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counterTape_write
Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_carry_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_counter_carry_step (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (pre bs : List Bool) :
    f2_counterTM.tm.step (f2_counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) []) =
      if bs.head? = some true then
        f2_counterCfg x 1 p (pre.length + 1) (pre ++ false :: bs.tail) []
      else f2_counterCfg x 2 p (pre.length - 1) (pre ++ true :: bs.tail) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_carry
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_counter_carry (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ pre : List Bool,
    f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) [])
        (f2_counterCarry bs + 1) =
      f2_counterCfg x 2 p ((pre.length : ℤ) + f2_counterCarry bs - 1)
        (pre ++ f2_counterInc bs) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_counter_rewind (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ bs.length),
    f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 2 p ((j : ℤ) - 1) bs []) (j + 1) =
      f2_counterCfg x 0 p 0 bs []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_start
Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_increment
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_counter_increment (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length)
    (bs : List Bool) :
    f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 bs [])
        (2 * f2_counterCarry bs + 2) =
      f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ 0 (f2_counterInc bs) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_count
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_counter_count (x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length),
    ∃ t, t + 2 * i.bits.count true ≤ 4 * i ∧
      f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) t =
        f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 i.bits []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_emit_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_counter_emit_run (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ i (_hi : i ≤ bs.length),
    f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterCfg x 3 p 0 bs []) i =
      f2_counterCfg x 3 p i bs (bs.take i)

Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_counter_computes : f2_counterTM.ComputesFunInTime
    (fun x => Nat.bits x.length) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_count_space
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_counter_count_space (x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length),
    ∃ t, t + 2 * i.bits.count true ≤ 4 * i ∧
      f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) t =
        f2_counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 i.bits [] ∧
      ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j : Fin 1,
        -(2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ) ≤
          (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ∧
        (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ≤
          (2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_counter_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_counter_heads (x : List Bool) (u : ℕ) (j : Fin 1) :
    -(2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ) ≤
      (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ∧
    (f2_counterTM.tm.runFrom (f2_counterTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ≤
      (2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_lenAction_apply (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (q q' : Option (f2_pairCountTM M).State)
    (i j r s : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (hj : j ≤ x.length)
    (m d : SignType) (b : Option Bool)
    (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) m = ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩)
    (hd : (r : ℤ) - 1 + d.cast = (s : ℤ) - 1) :
    (f2_lenAction M m d b q').apply (f2_lenCfg M c q i hi r) =
      {f2_lenCfg M c q' j hj s with output := b.toList}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenSuffix_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_lenSuffix_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest) r, r ≤ c.output.length →
    ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1,
      ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).state = none ∧
      ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).output =
          [decide (rest.length ≤ r)]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenParse_first
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_lenParse_first (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (pre rest : List Bool) (b : Bool) (r : ℕ)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    (f2_pairCountTM M).tm.step
      (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) =
      f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr (some b)))) (pre.length + 1) (by simp [hx]) r

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenParse_block
Turing.FinTM.f2_lenParse_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_lenParse_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest) r, r ≤ c.output.length →
    ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1,
      ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).state = none ∧
      ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).output =
          [match pairDecode rest with
            | some (_, b) => decide (b.length ≤ r)
            | none => false]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogRewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogRewind {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan))
    (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) :
    ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenStart
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_lenStart (M : FinTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w T) :
    ∃ t ≤ T + x.length + 4, ∃ c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x,
      c.output = w ∧
      (f2_pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom ((f2_pairCountTM M).tm.initCfg x) t =
        f2_lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) 0 (by omega) c.output.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_pairCount_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_pairCount_computes {M : FinTM Bool} {g : List Bool → List Bool}
    {T : ℕ → ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime g T) :
    (f2_pairCountTM M).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => [match pairDecode x with
        | some (_, b) => decide (b.length ≤ (g x).length)
        | none => false]) (fun n => T n + 2 * n + 5)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogPair_inverse
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogPair_inverse (x : List Bool) :
    ∀ a v, pairDecode x = some (a, v) → x = pairEncode a v

Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_id_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_id_spaceUsed :

      M.ComputesFunInTime id (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_const_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_const_spaceUsed (w : List Bool) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun _ => w) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_prepend_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_prepend_spaceUsed (w : List Bool) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),

      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:

        (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyUnary_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_polyUnary_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e) true)
        (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyBits_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_polyBits_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),

      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairEncodeFixed_spaceUsed

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairFst_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_pairFst_spaceUsed :

      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairSnd_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_pairSnd_spaceUsed :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairValid_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_pairValid_spaceUsed :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairConcat_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_pairConcat_spaceUsed :

      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun z => match pairDecode z with
          | some (a, b) => a ++ b
          | none => [])
        (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairDup_spaceUsed

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_unary_sharp
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_unary_sharp (C e : ℕ) :

      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e) true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => [match pairDecode x with
          | some (a, b) => decide (b.length ≤ C * (a.length + 1) ^ e)
          | none => false])
        (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t

Turing.FinTM.f2_rawStrip_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_rawStrip_rewind (x a : List Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : ∀ j, j ≤ a.length →
    f2_rawStripTM.tm.runFrom
      (f2_stripCfg x (some 2) i hi a ((j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) =
      f2_stripCfg x (some 3) i hi a 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_rawStrip_replay
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_rawStrip_replay (x a : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :

    f2_rawStripTM.tm.runFrom (f2_stripCfg x (some 3) i hi a 0 []) j =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_rawStrip_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_rawStrip_finish (x a : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :
    (f2_rawStripTM.tm.runFrom (f2_stripCfg x (some 2) i hi a (a.length - 1) [])
      (2 * (a.length + 1))).state = none ∧
    (f2_rawStripTM.tm.runFrom (f2_stripCfg x (some 2) i hi a (a.length - 1) [])
      (2 * (a.length + 1))).output = a

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_rawStrip_erase
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_rawStrip_erase (x w : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (b : Bool) :
    f2_rawStripTM.tm.step
      (f2_stripCfg x (some 1) i hi (w ++ [b]) ((w ++ [b]).length - 1) []) =
      f2_stripCfg x (some (if b then 2 else 1)) i hi w (w.length - 1) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_rawStrip_trim
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_rawStrip_trim (x w : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :
    ∃ t ≤ 3 * (w.length + 1),
      (f2_rawStripTM.tm.runFrom (f2_stripCfg x (some 1) i hi w (w.length - 1) []) t).state = none ∧
      (f2_rawStripTM.tm.runFrom (f2_stripCfg x (some 1) i hi w (w.length - 1) []) t).output =
        (splitAtLastTrue w).getD []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_rawStrip_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_rawStrip_computes : f2_rawStripTM.ComputesFunInTime
    (fun x => (splitAtLastTrue x).getD []) (fun n => 4 * (n + 1))

private lemma f2_anyTrue_run (x rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1,
      (f2_anyTrueTM.tm.runFrom (f2_scanCfg x (some ()) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) t).state = none ∧
      (f2_anyTrueTM.tm.runFrom (f2_scanCfg x (some ()) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) t).output =
        [rest.any id]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_anyTrue_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_anyTrue_computes : f2_anyTrueTM.ComputesFunInTime
    (fun x => [x.any id]) (fun n => n + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogMarker_cases
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_catalogMarker_cases (v : List Bool) :
    (v.any id = false ∧ splitAtLastTrue v = none) ∨
      ∃ u, v.any id = true ∧ splitAtLastTrue v = some u ∧
        ∀ pre, splitAtLastTrue (pre ++ v) = some (pre ++ u)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_strip_linear
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_strip_linear :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => match pairDecode x with
          | some (a, v) =>
            match splitAtLastTrue v with
            | some u => pairEncode a u
            | none => []
          | none => [])
        fun n => c * (n + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_stripLast_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_stripLast_spaceUsed :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => match pairDecode x with
          | some (a, v) =>
            match splitAtLastTrue v with
            | some u => pairEncode a u
            | none => []
          | none => [])
        (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_incFixed_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_incFixed_spaceUsed :

        (fun n => c * (n + 1)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c

Turing.FinTM.a2_map_move
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_map_move (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (q q' : Option (a2_MapState M.State)) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (a b : List Bool) (ha hb : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (mi ma mb : SignType) (emit : Option Bool) :
    (a2_mapAct M mi (none, ma) (none, mb) emit q').apply
      (a2_mapCfg M x q p a b ha hb out) =
      a2_mapCfg M x q' (moveInputPos p mi) a b (ha + ma.cast) (hb + mb.cast)
        (out ++ emit.toList)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_map_first
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_map_first (M : FinTM Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    (a2_mapTM M false).tm.step
      (a2_mapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] a.length 0 []) =
      a2_mapCfg M x (some (.parse (some b))) ⟨pre.length + 2, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] a.length 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_map_block
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_map_block (M : FinTM Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b c : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: c :: rest) :
    (a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (a2_mapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] a.length 0 []) 2 =
      if b = c then a2_mapCfg M x (some (.parse none))
        ⟨pre.length + 3, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩ (a ++ [b]) [] (a ++ [b]).length 0 []
      else if b then a2_mapCfg M x none
        ⟨pre.length + 3, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩ a [] a.length 0 []
      else a2_mapCfg M x (some .copyB)
        ⟨pre.length + 3, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩ a [] (a.length - 1) 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_map_suffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_map_suffix (M : FinTM Bool) (x rest a : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre b (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    (a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (a2_mapCfg M x (some .copyB) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a b (a.length - 1) b.length []) (rest.length + 1) =
      a2_mapCfg M x (some .backB) ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩
        a (b ++ rest) (a.length - 1) ((b ++ rest).length - 1) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_map_backB
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_map_backB (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ j, j ≤ b.length →
    (a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (a2_mapCfg M x (some .backB) p a b (a.length - 1) ((j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) =
      a2_mapCfg M x (some .backA) p a b (a.length - 1) 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_map_backA
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_map_backA (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ j, j ≤ a.length →
    (a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (a2_mapCfg M x (some .backA) p a b ((j : ℤ) - 1) 0 []) (j + 1) =
      a2_mapCfg M x (some .emitA) p a b 0 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_map_emit
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_map_emit (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b rest : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ pre out, a = pre ++ rest →
    (a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (a2_mapCfg M x (some .emitA) p a b pre.length 0 out) (2 * rest.length + 2) =
      a2_mapCfg M x (some (.run M.tm.q₀ true)) p a b a.length 0
        (out ++ rest.flatMap (fun d => [d, d]) ++ [false, true])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_map_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_map_finish (M : FinTM Bool) (x pre a b : List Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b) :
    (a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (a2_mapCfg M x (some .copyB) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] (a.length - 1) 0 []) (3 * a.length + 2 * b.length + 5) =
      a2_mapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_map_parse
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_map_parse (M : FinTM Bool) (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre a (hx : x = pre ++ rest), ∃ t ≤ 3 * rest.length + 3 * a.length + 5,
      match pairDecode rest with
      | some (d, b) => (a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom
          (a2_mapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
            a [] a.length 0 []) t =
          a2_mapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩
            (a ++ d) (pairEncode (a ++ d) [])
      | none =>
          ((a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom
            (a2_mapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
              a [] a.length 0 []) t).state = none ∧
          ((a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom
            (a2_mapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
              a [] a.length 0 []) t).output = []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_map_setup
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_map_setup (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    ∃ t ≤ 5 * (x.length + 1),
      match pairDecode x with
      | some (a, b) => (a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((a2_mapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t =
          a2_mapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a [])
      | none => ((a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((a2_mapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t).state = none ∧
          ((a2_mapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((a2_mapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t).output = []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_mapVirtual_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_mapVirtual_step (M : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y) (tag : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos tag)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a pre : List Bool) :
    ∃ tag', VirtualTag (M.tm.step c).inputPos tag' ∧
      (a2_mapTM M true).tm.step (a2_mapVirtual M c tag p a pre) =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_mapVirtual_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_map_space (M : FinTM Bool) (x y : List Bool) (t D S : ℕ)
    (hfirst : ∀ u ≤ t, -(D : ℤ) ≤
        ((a2_mapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((a2_mapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.castAdd (1 + M.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ∧
      ((a2_mapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((a2_mapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.castAdd (1 + M.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ≤ D)
    (hsecond : ∀ u ≤ t, -(D : ℤ) ≤
        ((a2_mapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((a2_mapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd M.k (0 : Fin 1))) ∧
      ((a2_mapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((a2_mapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd M.k (0 : Fin 1))) ≤ D)
    (hsource : ∀ i, (a2_mapTM M true).tm.visitedByTapeHead ((a2_mapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) t
        (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) ⊆ M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg y) t i)
    (hs : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg y) t ≤ S) :
    (a2_mapTM M true).tm.spaceUsed ((a2_mapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S + 2 * (2 * D + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd_spaceUsed {Mg : FinTM Bool}
    {g : List Bool → List Bool} {Tg : ℕ → ℕ} (Sg : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hg : Mg.ComputesFunInTime g Tg) (hTg : Monotone Tg)
    (hgs : ∀ (y : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      Mg.tm.spaceUsed (Mg.tm.initCfg y) t ≤ Sg y.length)
    (hSg : Monotone Sg) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun z => match pairDecode z with
          | some (a, b) => pairEncode a (g b)
          | none => [])
        (fun n => c * (n + 1 + Tg n)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t
          ≤ Sg x.length + c * (x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loop_first_halt
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loop_first_halt {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ)
    (hstart : cfg.state ≠ none) (hhalt : (tm.runFrom cfg t).state = none) :

private lemma f2_loop_rewind_bounded {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan))
    (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work =
      match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest)

    ∃ t ≤ cfg.inputPos.val + 2,
      tm.runFrom cfg t = {cfg with state := dest, inputPos := 1}

private lemma f2_loopBorrow_step (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (pre bs : List Bool) :
    f2_loopDebitTM.tm.step (f2_loopDebitCfg x p (.inl none) pre.length (pre ++ bs)) =
      match bs with
      | [] => f2_loopDebitCfg x p (.inl (some false)) (pre.length - 1) pre
      | true :: us => f2_loopDebitCfg x p (.inl (some true)) (pre.length - 1) (pre ++ false :: us)
      | false :: us => f2_loopDebitCfg x p (.inl none) (pre.length + 1) (pre ++ true :: us)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopBorrow_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopBorrow_run (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (u : List Bool) : ∀ pre : List Bool,
    f2_loopDebitTM.tm.runFrom (f2_loopDebitCfg x p (.inl none) pre.length (pre ++ u))
        (f2_loopBorrowPos u + 1) =
      f2_loopDebitCfg x p (.inl (some (f2_loopDebit u).2))
        ((pre.length : ℤ) + f2_loopBorrowPos u - 1) (pre ++ (f2_loopDebit u).1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopBorrow_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopBorrow_rewind (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (u : List Bool) (b : Bool) : ∀ j, j ≤ u.length →
    f2_loopDebitTM.tm.runFrom (f2_loopDebitCfg x p (.inl (some b)) ((j : ℤ) - 1) u)
        (j + 1) = f2_loopDebitCfg x p (.inr b) 0 u

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopBorrow_correct
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopBorrow_correct (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (u : List Bool) :
    2 * f2_loopBorrowPos u + 2 ≤ 2 * u.length + 2 ∧
      f2_loopDebitTM.tm.runFrom (f2_loopDebitCfg x p (.inl none) 0 u)
          (2 * f2_loopBorrowPos u + 2) =
        f2_loopDebitCfg x p (.inr (f2_loopDebit u).2) 0 (f2_loopDebit u).1

private lemma f2_loopBody_step (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (q : body.State) (release : Bool)
    (flag : Option Bool) (hc : c.state = some q)
    (hgo : ¬(q = anchor ∧ release = false)) :
    (f2_loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.step (f2_loopBodyCfg body anchor c release flag) =
      f2_loopBodyCfg body anchor (body.tm.step c) false
        (if (body.tm.step c).state = none then some true else flag)

private lemma f2_loopBody_run (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (hc : c.state ≠ none)
    (t : ℕ) (hlive : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ none)
    (hanchor : ∀ u < t, (u = 0 ∧ release = true) ∨
      (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor) :
    (f2_loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.runFrom (f2_loopBodyCfg body anchor c release none) t =
      f2_loopBodyCfg body anchor (body.tm.runFrom c t) (if t = 0 then release else false)
        (if (body.tm.runFrom c t).state = none then some true else none)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopBody_capture
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopBody_capture (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    {H : Type*} {x : List Bool} (host : MultiTapeTM (body.k + 1 + 1) Bool H)
    (emb : body.State × Bool → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ s inp work, host.tr (emb s) inp work =
      captureAction emb ret ((f2_loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.tr s inp fun i => work i.castSucc))
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (hc : c.state ≠ none)
    (t : ℕ) (hlive : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ none)
    (hanchor : ∀ u < t, (u = 0 ∧ release = true) ∨
      (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor) :
    host.runFrom (captureCfg emb ret [] [] (f2_loopBodyCfg body anchor c release none)) t =
      captureCfg emb ret [] []
        (f2_loopBodyCfg body anchor (body.tm.runFrom c t) (if t = 0 then release else false)
          (if (body.tm.runFrom c t).state = none then some true else none))

private lemma f2_loopControl_apply (body F : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (f2_LoopHostState body F) x)
    (q : Option (f2_LoopHostState body F)) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (flag counter payload : ℤ → Option Bool) (ch ph : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (inp : SignType) (fw : Option (Option Bool))
    (ca pa : Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (emit : Option Bool)
    (next : Option (f2_LoopHostState body F)) :
    (f2_loopControlAction body F inp fw ca pa emit next).apply
        (f2_loopFrame body F base q p flag counter payload ch ph out) =
      f2_loopFrame body F base next (moveInputPos p inp)
        (f2_loopWrite flag 0 fw) (f2_loopWrite counter ch ca.1) (f2_loopWrite payload ph pa.1)
        (ch + ca.2) (ph + pa.2) (out ++ emit.toList)

    (flag : Option Bool) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) :
