TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopBodySource_run
Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_anchor_return
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_anchor_return (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode startup : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x)
    (hend : (body.tm.runFrom c t).state = some anchor)
    (hreleased : t = 0 → release = false)
    (hanchor : ∀ u < t, (u = 0 ∧ release = true) ∨
      (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor) :
    (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (f2_loopCall body F anchor startup c release none word fuel) (t + 1) =
      f2_loopCall body F anchor startup {body.tm.runFrom c t with state := none}
        false (some false) word fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopReady_call
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopReady_call (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    {x : List Bool} (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) :
    f2_loopReady body F fuel =
      f2_loopCall body F anchor true (body.tm.initCfg x) false none fuel.output fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_release
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_release (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) :
    (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.step
        (f2_loopCall body F anchor true {c with state := none} false (some false) word fuel) =
      f2_loopCall body F anchor false {c with state := some anchor} true none word fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_start (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (s : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x)
    (hguard : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) u).state ≠ some anchor)
    (hend : body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) :
    (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (f2_loopReady body F fuel) (t + 2) =
      f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s))
        true none fuel.output fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_halt_return
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_halt_return (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (t : ℕ) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hlive : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ none)
    (hanchor : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < t → (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor)
    (hend : (body.tm.runFrom c t).state = none) :
    (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (f2_loopCall body F anchor false c true none word fuel) t =
      f2_loopCall body F anchor false (body.tm.runFrom c t) false (some true) word fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopCall_frame
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopCall_frame (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    {x : List Bool} (startup : Bool) (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (release : Bool) (flag : Option Bool) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) :
    f2_loopCall body F anchor startup c release flag word fuel =
      f2_loopFrame body F (f2_loopCall body F anchor startup c release flag word fuel)
        (f2_loopCall body F anchor startup c release flag word fuel).state c.inputPos
        (fun z => if z = 0 then flag else none) (bufferTape word) (bufferTape c.output)
        0 c.output.length []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopCall_reframe
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopCall_reframe (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (startup startup' release release' : Bool) (flag flag' : Option Bool)
    (word word' : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (q : Option body.State) :
    f2_loopFrame body F (f2_loopCall body F anchor startup c release flag word fuel)
        (f2_loopCall body F anchor startup' {c with state := q} release' flag' word' fuel).state
        c.inputPos (fun z => if z = 0 then flag' else none) (bufferTape word')
        (bufferTape c.output) 0 c.output.length [] =
      f2_loopCall body F anchor startup' {c with state := q} release' flag' word' fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_borrow_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_borrow_step (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (f2_LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre rest : List Bool) :
    (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.step
      (f2_loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 8))) p (bufferTape [])
        (bufferTape (pre ++ rest)) (bufferTape []) pre.length 0 []) =
      match rest with
      | [] => f2_loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 10))) p (bufferTape [])
          (bufferTape pre) (bufferTape []) (pre.length - 1) 0 []
      | true :: us => f2_loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 9))) p (bufferTape [])
          (bufferTape (pre ++ false :: us)) (bufferTape []) (pre.length - 1) 0 []
      | false :: us => f2_loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 8))) p (bufferTape [])
          (bufferTape (pre ++ true :: us)) (bufferTape []) (pre.length + 1) 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_borrow_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_borrow_run (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (f2_LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (word : List Bool) : ∀ pre,
    (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (f2_loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 8))) p (bufferTape [])
          (bufferTape (pre ++ word)) (bufferTape []) pre.length 0 [])
        (f2_loopBorrowPos word + 1) =
      f2_loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr (if (f2_loopDebit word).2 then 9 else 10)))) p
        (bufferTape []) (bufferTape (pre ++ (f2_loopDebit word).1)) (bufferTape [])
        ((pre.length : ℤ) + f2_loopBorrowPos word - 1) 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_borrow_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_borrow_rewind (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (f2_LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (word : List Bool) (success : Bool) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ word.length →
    (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (f2_loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr (if success then 9 else 10)))) p
          (bufferTape []) (bufferTape word) (bufferTape []) ((j : ℤ) - 1) 0 []) (j + 1) =
      f2_loopFrame body F base
        (some (if success then .inr (.inl (false, (anchor, true))) else .inr (.inr 11))) p
        (bufferTape []) (bufferTape word) (bufferTape []) 0 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_borrow
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_borrow (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (f2_LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (word : List Bool) :
    2 * f2_loopBorrowPos word + 2 ≤ 2 * word.length + 2 ∧
    (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (f2_loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 8))) p (bufferTape [])
          (bufferTape word) (bufferTape []) 0 0 []) (2 * f2_loopBorrowPos word + 2) =
      f2_loopFrame body F base
        (some (if (f2_loopDebit word).2 then .inr (.inl (false, (anchor, true)))
          else .inr (.inr 11))) p
        (bufferTape []) (bufferTape (f2_loopDebit word).1) (bufferTape []) 0 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopFrame_flag
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopFrame_flag (body F : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (f2_LoopHostState body F) x)
    (q : Option (f2_LoopHostState body F)) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (flag counter payload : ℤ → Option Bool) (ch ph : ℤ) (out : List Bool) :
    (f2_loopFrame body F base q p flag counter payload ch ph out).workTapeSymbols
        ⟨body.k, by omega⟩ = flag 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopFlag_clear
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopFlag_clear (flag : Option Bool) :
    f2_loopWrite (fun z : ℤ => if z = 0 then flag else none) 0 (some none) = bufferTape []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_reject
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_reject (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x)
    (hc : c.state = none) (ho : c.output = []) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * word.length + 4,
      if (f2_loopDebit word).2 then
        (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
            (f2_loopCall body F anchor false c false (some false) word fuel) t =
          f2_loopCall body F anchor false {c with state := some anchor} true none (f2_loopDebit word).1 fuel
      else
        ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
          (f2_loopCall body F anchor false c false (some false) word fuel) t).state = none ∧
        ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
          (f2_loopCall body F anchor false c false (some false) word fuel) t).output =
            (if findMode then [] else [false])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_payload_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_payload_rewind (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (f2_LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (flag counter : ℤ → Option Bool)
    (ch : ℤ) (word out : List Bool) : ∀ j, j ≤ word.length →
    (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (f2_loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 12))) p flag counter
          (bufferTape word) ch ((j : ℤ) - 1) out) (j + 1) =
      f2_loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 13))) p flag counter
        (bufferTape word) ch 0 out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_frame_replay
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_frame_replay (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (f2_LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (flag counter : ℤ → Option Bool) (ch : ℤ) (word : List Bool) :
    let c := f2_loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 13))) p flag counter (bufferTape word) ch 0 []
    ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom c (word.length + 1)).state = none ∧
    ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom c (word.length + 1)).output = word

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_accept
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_accept (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (hc : c.state = none) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * c.output.length + 3,
      ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (f2_loopCall body F anchor false c false (some true) word fuel) t).state = none ∧
      ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (f2_loopCall body F anchor false c false (some true) word fuel) t).output =
          (if findMode then c.output else [true])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_round
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_round (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (s next payload : List Bool) (accepted : Bool)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hanchor : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < t →
      (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) u).state ≠ some anchor)
    (hend : if accepted then
      (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧
      (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = payload
      else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next)) :
    ∃ v ≤ 3 * t + 2 * word.length + 5,
      let start := f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel
      if accepted then
        ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom start v).state = none ∧
        ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom start v).output =
          (if findMode then payload else [true])
      else if (f2_loopDebit word).2 then
        (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom start v =
          f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next))
            true none (f2_loopDebit word).1 fuel
      else ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom start v).state = none ∧
        ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom start v).output =
          (if findMode then [] else [false])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopCall_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopCall_heads (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (x s word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (B : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ i, -(B : ℤ) ≤ fuel.workTapePos i ∧ fuel.workTapePos i ≤ B) :
    ∀ i, -(B : ℤ) ≤ (f2_loopCall body F anchor false
        (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel).workTapePos i ∧
      (f2_loopCall body F anchor false
        (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel).workTapePos i ≤ B

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_bound
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: private def f2_loopHost_bound : ℕ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loopHost_contracts
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loopHost_contracts (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (findMode : Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = out x s
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ x : List Bool,
      ∃ (cfg : ℕ → Cfg (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).k Bool
          (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).State x) (startup : ℕ),
        startup ≤ c * (T x.length + 1) ∧
        (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
          ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0 ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, (cfg i).output = []) ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).state = none ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).output = (if findMode then [] else [false]) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∃ t ≤ c * (T x.length + 1),
          if acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) then
            ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧
            ((f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output =
              (if findMode then out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) else [true])
          else (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = cfg (i + 1)) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∀ j,
          -(T x.length : ℤ) ≤ (cfg i).workTapePos j ∧
          (cfg i).workTapePos j ≤ T x.length) ∧
        (∀ j, -((T x.length + c * (T x.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤
          (cfg (R x.length + 1)).workTapePos j ∧
          (cfg (R x.length + 1)).workTapePos j ≤
            (T x.length + c * (T x.length + 1) : ℕ))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loop_find_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_loop_find_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (accept : ℕ → Bool) (payload : ℕ → List Bool) (B N : ℕ)
    (hend : (cfg N).state = none ∧ (cfg N).output = [])
    (hround : ∀ j < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if accept j then
        (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none ∧
          (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = payload j
      else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∃ t ≤ N * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output =
        (match (List.range N).find? accept with | some i => payload i | none => [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_segment_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_segment_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x) (N B H : ℕ)
    (hseam : ∀ j < N, ∀ i, -(H : ℤ) ≤ (cfg j).workTapePos i ∧
      (cfg j).workTapePos i ≤ H)
    (hend : (cfg N).state = none)
    (hterminal : ∀ i, -((H + B : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (cfg N).workTapePos i ∧
      (cfg N).workTapePos i ≤ (H + B : ℕ))
    (hsegment : ∀ j < N, ∃ u ≤ B,
      (tm.runFrom (cfg j) u).state = none ∨ tm.runFrom (cfg j) u = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∀ t i, -((H + B : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).workTapePos i ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).workTapePos i ≤ (H + B : ℕ)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_space_radius
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_space_radius (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (B : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ t i, -(B : ℤ) ≤ (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos i ∧
      (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos i ≤ B) (t : ℕ) :
    M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ M.k * (2 * B + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_seamed_space
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_seamed_space (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (cfg : ℕ → Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (N B H startup : ℕ)
    (hstart : startup ≤ B) (hinit : M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0)
    (hseam : ∀ j < N, ∀ i, -(H : ℤ) ≤ (cfg j).workTapePos i ∧
      (cfg j).workTapePos i ≤ H)
    (hend : (cfg N).state = none)
    (hterminal : ∀ i, -((H + B : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (cfg N).workTapePos i ∧
      (cfg N).workTapePos i ≤ (H + B : ℕ))
    (hsegment : ∀ j < N, ∃ u ≤ B,
      (M.tm.runFrom (cfg j) u).state = none ∨ M.tm.runFrom (cfg j) u = cfg (j + 1))
    (t : ℕ) : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ M.k * (2 * (H + B) + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_exists_loopFind_space
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_exists_loopFind_space (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = out x s
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    ∃ (E : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      E.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => match (List.range (R x.length + 1)).find?
            (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))) with
          | some i => out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))
          | none => [])
        (fun n => c * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) ∧
      ∀ x t, E.tm.spaceUsed (E.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (T x.length + 1)

    (match (List.range (w.length + 1)).find?
        (fun i => f2_splitAccept C e w ((f2_splitStep w)^[i] [])) with
      | some i => pairEncode (w.take ((f2_splitStep w)^[i] []).length)
          (w.drop ((f2_splitStep w)^[i] []).length)

    (match solveSplit C e w.length with
      | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
      | none => [])

    (f2_splitCountAction emb ret (decide (w.length < s.length + c.output.length))

    (hagree : ∀ q over inp work, host.tr (emb q over) inp work =
      f2_splitCountAction emb ret over inp (tm.tr q none (fun i => work i.succ)))
    (w s : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S []) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ j < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c j).Halted) :
    host.runFrom (f2_splitCountCfg emb ret w s c) t =
      f2_splitCountCfg emb ret w s (tm.runFrom c t)

private lemma f2_splitEmbed_cut {k : ℕ} {S H : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM k Bool H)
    (emb : S → H) (anchor : H) (stop : S → Prop) [DecidablePred stop]
    (haway : ∀ q, emb q ≠ anchor)
    (hfix : ∀ c : Cfg k Bool S w, (∃ q, c.state = some q ∧ stop q) → tm.step c = c)
    (hagree : ∀ q, ¬stop q → ∀ inp work,
      host.tr (emb q) inp work = (tm.tr q inp work).mapState emb)
    (c d : Cfg k Bool S w) (T : ℕ)
    (hd : ∃ q, d.state = some q ∧ stop q) (hT : tm.runFrom c T = d) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, host.runFrom (c.mapState emb) t = d.mapState emb ∧
      f2_splitSafe host anchor (c.mapState emb) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitBody_prepare (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (w s : List Bool) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * (s.length + 1),
      (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (.prepare (0, false)) (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) (t + 1) =
          f2_splitCountCfg f2_SplitBodyState.count f2_SplitBodyState.check w s
            (f2_splitBank M s (some start) []) ∧
      f2_splitSafe (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm .anchor
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.prepare (0, false)) (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) (t + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitBody_count
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitBody_count (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (w s : List Bool)
    (out : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hT : M.tm.runFrom (f2_splitBank M s (some start) []) T = f2_splitBank M s none out) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
      (f2_splitCountCfg f2_SplitBodyState.count f2_SplitBodyState.check w s (f2_splitBank M s (some start) [])) t =
      f2_splitCountCfg f2_SplitBodyState.count f2_SplitBodyState.check w s (f2_splitBank M s none out) ∧
      f2_splitSafe (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm .anchor
        (f2_splitCountCfg f2_SplitBodyState.count f2_SplitBodyState.check w s (f2_splitBank M s (some start) [])) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitBody_rewind

    (ok : Bool) (c : Cfg (M.k + 1) Bool (Fin 3) w)
    (hc : c.state = some 0) :
    ∃ t ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (c.mapState (f2_SplitBodyState.rewind ok)) t =
        ({c with state := some (2 : Fin 3), inputPos := 1}).mapState (f2_SplitBodyState.rewind ok) ∧
      f2_splitSafe (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm .anchor (c.mapState (f2_SplitBodyState.rewind ok)) t

        ((f2_splitRestoreScan M.k w s 0).mapState f2_SplitBodyState.restore) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.restore (4, false)) (stateWord (M.k + 1) (f2_splitStep w s)) ∧
      f2_splitSafe (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm .anchor
        ((f2_splitRestoreScan M.k w s 0).mapState f2_SplitBodyState.restore) t

      (f2_splitEmitCfg k w s (some 3) pre.length h out) (rest.length + 1) =
      f2_splitEmitCfg k w s none w.length h (out ++ rest)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitEmit_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitEmit_run (k : ℕ) (w s : List Bool) (hs : s.length ≤ w.length) :
    (f2_splitEmitTM k).tm.runFrom (f2_splitEmitCfg k w s (some 0) 0 0 [])
      (s.length + w.length + 3) =
      f2_splitEmitCfg k w s none w.length s.length
        (pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitSafe_one
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitSafe_one {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d : Cfg k Bool S w)
    (he : tm.step c = d) (hc : c.state ≠ some anchor) (hd : d.state ≠ some anchor) :
    tm.runFrom c 1 = d ∧ f2_splitSafe tm anchor c 1

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitSafe_join
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitSafe_join {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d f : Cfg k Bool S w) (u v : ℕ)
    (h1 : tm.runFrom c u = d) (hs1 : f2_splitSafe tm anchor c u)
    (h2 : tm.runFrom d v = f) (hs2 : f2_splitSafe tm anchor d v) :
    tm.runFrom c (u + v) = f ∧ f2_splitSafe tm anchor c (u + v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitBody_round
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitBody_round (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (w s out : List Bool)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : M.tm.runFrom (f2_splitBank M s (some start) []) T = f2_splitBank M s none out) :
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T + 5 * s.length + 3 * w.length + 20 ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < j → j < t →
        ((f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) j).state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      if decide (s.length + out.length = w.length) then
        ((f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t).state = none ∧
        ((f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t).output =
            pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
      else (f2_splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t =
          Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) (f2_splitStep w s))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitSolve_of_body
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitSolve_of_body (C e : ℕ) (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (A : ℕ)
    (hstart : ∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ A * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1),
      (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k []))
    (hround : ∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ A * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
            ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if f2_splitAccept C e w s then
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output =
            pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (f2_splitStep w s))) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2)) ∧
      ∀ x t, M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitSource_poly
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitSource_poly (c C : ℕ) (s : List Bool) :
    (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (f2_splitBank (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C) s (some (.loop (Fin.last c))) [])
      (f2_catalogPolyCost (s.length + 1) C (c + 1) + 1) =
      f2_splitBank (f2_catalogPolyUnaryTM c C) s none
        (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ (c + 1)) true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitSource_constant
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitSource_constant (C : ℕ) (s : List Bool) :
    (f2_catalogPrefixTM (List.replicate C true)).tm.runFrom
      (f2_splitBank (f2_catalogPrefixTM (List.replicate C true)) s (some (0 : Fin ((List.replicate C true).length + 1))) []) (C + 1) =
      f2_splitBank (f2_catalogPrefixTM (List.replicate C true)) s none (List.replicate C true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitBody_envelope
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitBody_envelope (C e l n T : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ n + 1)
    (hT : T ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * e) * (l + 1) ^ e + 1) :
    T + 5 * l + 3 * n + 20 ≤
      ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitSolve_source
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitSolve_source (C e : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State)
    (B : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hsource : ∀ s : List Bool, M.tm.runFrom (f2_splitBank M s (some start) []) (B s.length) =
      f2_splitBank M s none (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ e) true))
    (hbound : ∀ l, B l ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * e) * (l + 1) ^ e + 1) :
    ∃ (N : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      N.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2)) ∧
      ∀ x t, N.tm.spaceUsed (N.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.f2_splitSolve_closed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma f2_splitSolve_closed (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => [])
        (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2)) ∧
      ∀ x t, M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_splitSolve_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_splitSolve_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),

        (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with

      (f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a =
        f2_timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) tapes heads b

    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) :
    (f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
      (fun n => 5 * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1))

      ((f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((f2_timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos =
        f2_condHeads D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos

      D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) T +

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool}
    {p : List Bool → Bool} {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool}
    {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ} (sD s₁ s₂ : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂)
    (hsD : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ sD x.length)
    (hs₁ : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      M₁.tm.spaceUsed (M₁.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s₁ x.length)
    (hs₂ : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      M₂.tm.spaceUsed (M₂.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s₂ x.length) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
        (fun n => c * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t
          ≤ sD x.length + max (s₁ x.length) (s₂ x.length) + c

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_source_radius

    (hf : a2_heads c B) (ho : c.output.length ≤ B) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_call_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_call_run (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode startup : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (hc : c.state ≠ none)
    (hlive : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ none)
    (hanchor : ∀ u < t, (u = 0 ∧ release = true) ∨
      (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor) :
    (f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (f2_loopCall body F anchor startup c release none word fuel) t =
      f2_loopCall body F anchor startup (body.tm.runFrom c t)
        (if t = 0 then release else false)
        (if (body.tm.runFrom c t).state = none then some true else none) word fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_call_prefix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_call_prefix (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (startup : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (t B : ℕ)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (hc : c.state ≠ none)
    (hzero : ∀ i, c.workTapePos i = 0)
    (hlive : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ none)
    (hanchor : ∀ u < t, (u = 0 ∧ release = true) ∨
      (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor)
    (hspace : ∀ u ≤ t, body.tm.spaceUsed c u ≤ B)
    (hf : a2_heads fuel B) (hout : (body.tm.runFrom c t).output.length ≤ B) :
    ∀ u ≤ t, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom
      (f2_loopCall body F anchor startup c release none word fuel) u) B

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_loop_prepare
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_loop_prepare (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (R T S : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hspace : ∀ x t, F.tm.spaceUsed (F.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S x.length)
    (x : List Bool) :
    ∃ (c : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (t : ℕ),
      c.state = none ∧ c.output = Nat.bits (R x.length) ∧ t ≤ 5 * T x.length + 7 ∧
      (f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom
        ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.initCfg x) t = f2_loopReady body F c ∧
      a2_heads c (S x.length) ∧
      ∀ u ≤ t, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom
        ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.initCfg x) u)
        (S x.length + 4 * (Nat.bits (R x.length)).length + 4)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_loop_start_prefix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_loop_start_prefix (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    {x : List Bool} (s : List Bool) (t B : ℕ) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x)
    (hguard : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) u).state ≠ some anchor)
    (hend : body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s))
    (hs : ∀ u ≤ t, body.tm.spaceUsed (body.tm.initCfg x) u ≤ B)
    (hf : a2_heads fuel B) :
    ∀ u ≤ t + 2, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom
      (f2_loopReady body F fuel) u) (B + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_loop_round
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_loop_round (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    {x : List Bool} (s next : List Bool) (accepted : Bool)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (t B : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hanchor : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < t →
      (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) u).state ≠ some anchor)
    (hend : if accepted then
      (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧
      (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = [true]
      else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next))
    (hspace : ∀ u ≤ t, body.tm.spaceUsed
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) u ≤ B)
    (hf : a2_heads fuel B) :
    ∃ v,
      (∀ u ≤ v, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom
        (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s))
          true none word fuel) u) (B + 2 * word.length + 6)) ∧
      ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom
        (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s))
          true none word fuel) v).state = none ∨
      ∃ v, (f2_loopDebit word).2 = true ∧
        (∀ u ≤ v, a2_heads ((f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom
          (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s))
            true none word fuel) u) (B + 2 * word.length + 6)) ∧
        (f2_loopHost body F anchor false).tm.runFrom
          (f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s))
            true none word fuel) v =
          f2_loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next))
            true none (f2_loopDebit word).1 fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_segments
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_segments {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool Q x) (N B : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 < N)
    (hround : ∀ i < N, ∃ u,
      (∀ v ≤ u, a2_heads (tm.runFrom (cfg i) v) B) ∧
      ((tm.runFrom (cfg i) u).state = none ∨
        i + 1 < N ∧ tm.runFrom (cfg i) u = cfg (i + 1))) :
    ∀ t, a2_heads (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t) B

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.a2_loop_halted_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma a2_loop_halted_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (accept : ℕ → Bool) (B N : ℕ)
    (hend : (cfg N).state = none ∧ (cfg N).output = [false])
    (hround : ∀ j < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if accept j then
        (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none ∧
          (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = [true]
      else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∃ t ≤ N * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output = [(List.range N).any accept]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_loopTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem exists_loopTM_spaceUsed (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T S : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = [true]
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s)))
    (hFspace : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      F.tm.spaceUsed (F.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S x.length)
    (hstartSpace : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), t ≤ T x.length →
      body.tm.spaceUsed (body.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S x.length)
    (hroundSpace : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∀ t ≤ T x.length,
        body.tm.spaceUsed
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t
            ≤ S x.length) :
    ∃ (E : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      E.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any
          fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))])
        (fun n => c * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        E.tm.spaceUsed (E.tm.initCfg x) t
          ≤ c * (S x.length + T x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.step_of_tapeAction_move
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem step_of_tapeAction_move {Symbol State : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (i : Fin k)
    (inp m : SignType) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (htr : M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp none m q') :
    M.step c =
      { c with
        state := some q'
        inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp
        workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + m) }

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.step_of_tapeAction_write
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem step_of_tapeAction_write {Symbol State : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (i : Fin k)
    (inp : SignType) (s : Option Symbol) (m : SignType) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (htr : M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp (some s) m q') :
    M.step c =
      { c with
        state := some q'
        inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp
        workTapes := Function.update c.workTapes i
          (Function.update (c.workTapes i) (c.workTapePos i) s)
        workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + m) }

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.compareTM_run_stop_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem compareTM_run_stop_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {k : ℕ}
    {x : List Symbol} (fst snd : Fin k) (hne : fst ≠ snd) (u v : List Symbol)
    (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run)
    (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p)
    (hv : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (v.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) :
    (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d (2 * compareStop u v + 2) =
        { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))) } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * compareStop u v + 2, ∀ b,
        ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * compareStop u v + 2 →
        if j = fst ∨ j = snd then
          ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (compareStop u v : ℤ))
        else ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.compareTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem compareTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (fst snd : Fin k) (hne : fst ≠ snd) (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run)
    (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p)
    (hv : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (v.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) :
    ∃ δ ≤ min u.length v.length,
      (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d (2 * δ + 2) =
          { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))) } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * δ + 2, ∀ b,
          ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
        (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * δ + 2 →
          if j = fst ∨ j = snd then
            ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
              Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (δ : ℤ))
          else ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.catalog_pass_contract
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private theorem catalog_pass_contract {k : ℕ} {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} {S : Type*}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (F : ℕ → Cfg k Symbol S x) (D : Cfg k Symbol S x) (L : ℕ)
    (hF : ∀ r < L, M.step (F r) = F (r + 1)) (hexit : M.step (F L) = D) (hD : M.step D = D)
    (P Q : Cfg k Symbol S x → Prop) (hP : ∀ r ≤ L, P (F r)) (hQ : ∀ r ≤ L, Q (F r))
    (hQD : Q D) :
    M.runFrom (F 0) (L + 1) = D ∧ (∀ t < L + 1, P (M.runFrom (F 0) t)) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ L + 1, Q (M.runFrom (F 0) t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private theorem catalog_seek_step {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase) (i : Fin k) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x)
    (q q' : SeekPhase) (z : ℤ) (m : SignType)
    (htr : M.tr q (catalogSeekCfg i d q z).inputSymbol
      (catalogSeekCfg i d q z).workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i 0 none m q') :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:

    (dir : SignType) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.skipTM_eq_walkTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.walkTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem walkTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src : Fin k)
    (moved : Fin k → Prop) [DecidablePred moved] (hsrc : moved src) (dir : SignType)
    (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ w.length →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + (dir : ℤ) * p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d (w.length + 1) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapePos := fun j =>
            d.workTapePos j + if moved j then (dir : ℤ) * ((w.length + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) else 0 } ∧
      (∀ t < w.length + 1, ((walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ w.length + 1 →
        ((walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d t).workTapePos j =
          d.workTapePos j + if moved j then (dir : ℤ) * (t : ℤ) else 0)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.skipTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem skipTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (skipTM k i).runFrom d (w.length + 1) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i
            (d.workTapePos i + w.length + 1) } ∧
      (∀ t < w.length + 1, ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ w.length + 1 →
        if j = i then
          ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + w.length + 1)
        else ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.skipBackTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: def skipBackTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.skipBackTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem skipBackTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (u : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - u.length - 1 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) :
    (skipBackTM k i).runFrom d (u.length + 3) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i
            (d.workTapePos i - u.length - 1) } ∧
      (∀ t < u.length + 3, ((skipBackTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ u.length + 3 →
        if j = i then
          ((skipBackTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - u.length - 2) (d.workTapePos j)
        else ((skipBackTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.fieldsTape_no_double_blank
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private theorem fieldsTape_no_double_blank {Γ : Type*} (ws : List (List Γ))
    (hws : ∀ u ∈ ws, u ≠ []) (z : ℤ) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hend : z + 1 < (fieldOffset ws ws.length : ℤ)) :
    ¬(fieldsTape ws z = none ∧ fieldsTape ws (z + 1) = none)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.seekEndTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: def seekEndTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.seekEndTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem seekEndTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (ws : List (List Symbol)) (hne : ws ≠ []) (hws : ∀ u ∈ ws, u ≠ [])
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ (fieldOffset ws ws.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = fieldsTape ws p) :
    (seekEndTM k i).runFrom d (fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i
            (d.workTapePos i + fieldOffset ws ws.length) } ∧
      (∀ t < fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1,
        ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1 →
        if j = i then
          ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + fieldOffset ws ws.length)
        else ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.seekStartTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: def seekStartTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.seekStartTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem seekStartTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (ws : List (List Symbol)) (hws : ∀ u ∈ ws, u ≠ [])
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hcur : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i) ≠ none)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -2 ≤ p → p < (fieldOffset ws ws.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - fieldOffset ws ws.length + p) = fieldsTape ws p) :
    (seekStartTM k i).runFrom d (fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i
            (d.workTapePos i - fieldOffset ws ws.length) } ∧
      (∀ t < fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4,
        ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4 →
        if j = i then
          ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - fieldOffset ws ws.length - 2) (d.workTapePos j)
        else ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.mealyRun
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: def mealyRun {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) : A → List Γ → A × List Γ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.mealyRun_append
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private theorem mealyRun_append {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List Γ) :
    mealyRun δ a (l₁ ++ l₂) =
      ((mealyRun δ (mealyRun δ a l₁).1 l₂).1,
        (mealyRun δ a l₁).2 ++ (mealyRun δ (mealyRun δ a l₁).1 l₂).2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.mealyRun_induction
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private theorem mealyRun_induction {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ)
    (P : A → List Γ → A × List Γ → Prop)
    (hnil : ∀ a, P a [] (a, []))
    (hcons : ∀ a γ l r, P (δ a γ).1 l r → P a (γ :: l) (r.1, (δ a γ).2 :: r.2))
    (a : A) (l : List Γ) : P a l (mealyRun δ a l)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.mealyRun_length
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private theorem mealyRun_length {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (l : List Γ) :
    (mealyRun δ a l).2.length = l.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.mealyRun_next
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private theorem mealyRun_next {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A)
    (w : List Γ) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
    (mealyRun δ a (w.take (r + 1))).1 = (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).1 ∧
      (mealyRun δ a w).2[r]'(by rw [mealyRun_length]; exact hr) =
        (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).2

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanResult
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: def scanResult {A Γ : Type*} (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) : A × List Γ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.ScanPhase
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: inductive ScanPhase (A : Type)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
def scanTM {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) :
    MultiTapeTM k Γ (ScanPhase A)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem scanTM_run_ofCfg {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (i : Fin k)
    (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀))
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some (.done (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).1)
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).2 (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ a,
        ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (.done a)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
        if j = i then
          ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
        else ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanKeep
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: def scanKeep {A Γ : Type*} : A → Γ → A × Γ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanFold
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: def scanFold {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A) : A → Γ → A × Γ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanMap
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: def scanMap {A Γ : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ) : A → Γ → A × Γ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanShift
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: def scanShift {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) : B → Γ → B × Γ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanCarry
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: def scanCarry {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ) : Bool → Γ → Bool × Γ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.mealyRun_keep
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header: private theorem mealyRun_keep {A Γ : Type*} (a : A) (l : List Γ) : mealyRun scanKeep a l = (a, l)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanResult_keep
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private theorem scanResult_keep {A Γ : Type*} (δf : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult δf scanKeep a₀ w = mealyRun δf a₀ w

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.shiftLeft_list
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private theorem shiftLeft_list {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    (List.zipWith set w.reverse (b₀ :: w.reverse.map get)).reverse =
      List.zipWith set w (w.tail.map get ++ [b₀])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.mealyRun_carry_clear
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private theorem mealyRun_carry_clear {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ)
    (w : List Γ) : mealyRun (scanCarry top next) false w = (false, w)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanResult_fold
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem scanResult_fold {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanFold δ) scanKeep a₀ w = (w.foldl δ a₀, w)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanResult_keep_keep
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem scanResult_keep_keep {A Γ : Type*} (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult scanKeep scanKeep a₀ w = (a₀, w)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanResult_map
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem scanResult_map {A Γ : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanMap f) scanKeep a₀ w = (a₀, w.map f)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanResult_shiftRight
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem scanResult_shiftRight {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanShift get set) scanKeep b₀ w =
      ((w.map get).getLast?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (b₀ :: w.map get))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanResult_shiftLeft
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem scanResult_shiftLeft {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult scanKeep (scanShift get set) b₀ w =
      ((w.map get).head?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (w.tail.map get ++ [b₀]))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.scanResult_carry
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem scanResult_carry {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanCarry top next) scanKeep true w =
      (w.all top, (w.takeWhile top).map next ++ ((w.dropWhile top).take 1).map next ++
        (w.dropWhile top).drop 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.cert_tail_test
Turing.certVerdictTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header: private def certVerdictTM (k : ℕ) (cap : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin 3)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.certVerdict_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
private theorem certVerdict_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (cap : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 3) x) (w : List Bool)
    (hs : d.state = some 0) (hw : d.workTapes cap = FinTM.bufferTape w)
    (hp : d.workTapePos cap = (w.length : ℤ)) :
    ((certVerdictTM k cap).runFrom d 3).state = none ∧
      ((certVerdictTM k cap).runFrom d 3).output = d.output ++ [decide (w = [true])]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.cert_capture_fields
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
private theorem cert_capture_fields {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (cap : Fin k) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι)
    (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin k → ℤ)
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (d : Cfg m Bool S x) :
    (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ d).workTapes cap =
        FinTM.bufferTape (pre ++ d.output) ∧
      (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ d).workTapePos cap =
        ((pre ++ d.output).length : ℤ)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.certCoreTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
private def certCoreTM {k : ℕ} (P : FinTM Bool)
    (ι : Fin (1 + P.k) ↪ Fin k) (cap : Fin k) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.certCore_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
private theorem certCore_run {k : ℕ} (P : FinTM Bool)
    (ι : Fin (1 + P.k) ↪ Fin k) (cap : Fin k) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι)
    {x y : List Bool} (d : Cfg P.k Bool P.State x) (hd : d.state ≠ none)
    (tag : Bool) (htag : FinTM.VirtualTag d.inputPos tag)
    (p : Fin (y.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (deadline : ℕ)
    (hhalt : (P.tm.runFrom d deadline).state = none) :
    ∃ t ≤ deadline + 4,
      let start := (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads [] []
        (vhostCfg d tag p [])).mapState (fun q => Sum.inl (Sum.inl q))
      ((certCoreTM P ι cap).tm.runFrom start t).state = none ∧
        ((certCoreTM P ι cap).tm.runFrom start t).output =
          [decide ((P.tm.runFrom d deadline).output = [true])]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.cert_call_cut
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
private theorem cert_call_cut {A : Type} (k : ℕ) (S : Type)
    [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (en ex : S)
    (input : A → List Bool) (before after : A → Fin k → List Bool) (budget : A → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ a, ∃ t ≤ budget a, 0 < t ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < t →
        (M.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := input a) en (before a)) u).state ≠ some ex) ∧
      M.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := input a) en (before a)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords ex (after a)) :
    ∃ (S' : Type) (_ : Fintype S') (_ : DecidableEq S')
      (N : MultiTapeTM k Bool S') (start finish : S'),
      ∀ a, ∃ t ≤ budget a,
        (∀ u < t, (N.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := input a) start (before a)) u).state ≠
          some finish) ∧
        N.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := input a) start (before a)) t =
          Cfg.ofWords finish (after a)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.cert_embed_words
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
private theorem cert_embed_words {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} {y : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (q : S)
    (localWords : Fin m → List Bool) (frame target : Fin k → List Bool)
    (hin : ∀ i, target (ι i) = localWords i)
    (hout : ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range ι → target i = frame i) :
    embedEmitCfg ι (fun i => FinTM.bufferTape (frame i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) q localWords) = Cfg.ofWords q target

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.cert_embed_call
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
private theorem cert_embed_call {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} {y : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (en ex : S)
    (localBefore localAfter : Fin m → List Bool) (before after : Fin k → List Bool)
    (hbefore : ∀ i, before (ι i) = localBefore i)
    (hafter : ∀ i, after (ι i) = localAfter i)
    (hframe : ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range ι → after i = before i) {t : ℕ}
    (hrun : M.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) en localBefore) t =
      Cfg.ofWords ex localAfter)
    (hcut : ∀ u < t, (M.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) en localBefore) u).state ≠ some ex) :
    (embedEmitTM ι M).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) en before) t =
        Cfg.ofWords ex after ∧
      ∀ u < t, ((embedEmitTM ι M).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) en before) u).state ≠
        some ex

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.cert_seq
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
private theorem cert_seq {k : ℕ} {S U : Type} [DecidableEq S] {y : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (N : MultiTapeTM k Bool U) (en ex : S) (start finish : U)
    (w₀ w₁ w₂ : Fin k → List Bool) {t₀ t₁ : ℕ}
    (h₀ : M.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) en w₀) t₀ = Cfg.ofWords ex w₁)
    (cut₀ : ∀ t < t₀, (M.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) en w₀) t).state ≠ some ex)
    (h₁ : N.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) start w₁) t₁ = Cfg.ofWords finish w₂)
    (cut₁ : ∀ t < t₁, (N.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) start w₁) t).state ≠ some finish) :
    (seamCompTM M ex N start).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) (Sum.inl en) w₀)
        (t₀ + 1 + t₁) = Cfg.ofWords (Sum.inr finish) w₂ ∧
      ∀ t < t₀ + 1 + t₁,
        ((seamCompTM M ex N start).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) (Sum.inl en) w₀) t).state ≠
          some (Sum.inr finish)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.cert_bank_word
Turing.cert_silent_words
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
private theorem cert_silent_words {m k : ℕ} {S U : Type} {y : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (cap : Fin k)
    (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (d : Cfg m Bool S y)
    (q : S) (finish : U) (hs : d.state = some q) (hp : d.inputPos = 1)
    (htape : ∀ i, d.workTapes i = FinTM.bufferTape (w (ι i)))
    (hhead : ∀ i, d.workTapePos i = 0) (ho : d.output = []) (hc : w cap = []) :
    (embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun i => FinTM.bufferTape (w i)) (fun _ => 0) [] [] d).mapState
      (fun _ => finish) = Cfg.ofWords finish w

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.certSplitWord_length
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.certSplit_valid
Turing.certSplit_language
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
private theorem certSplit_language (C c : ℕ) (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (y : List Bool) :
    (∃ x u, y = x ++ u ∧ u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧ out x u = [true]) ↔
      match solveSplit C c y.length with
      | none => False
      | some i => out (y.take i) (y.drop i) = [true]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.cert_prepare_exists
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
private theorem cert_prepare_exists (P : FinTM Bool) (j : Fin P.k) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ (D : FinTM Bool) (exit : D.State) (ρ : Fin m ↪ Fin D.k)
      (ι : Fin (1 + P.k) ↪ Fin D.k) (cap : Fin D.k) (a : ℕ),
      cap ∉ Set.range ι ∧
      ∀ (y x u : List Bool),
        ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + u.length + 1),
          ∃ (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
          (∀ s < t, (D.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) D.tm.q₀
              (Function.update (fun _ => []) (ρ ⟨0, hm⟩) (pairEncode x u))) s).state ≠
                some exit) ∧
          D.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) D.tm.q₀
              (Function.update (fun _ => []) (ρ ⟨0, hm⟩) (pairEncode x u))) t =
            (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads [] []
              (vhostCfg (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) P.tm.q₀
                (Function.update (fun _ => []) j u)) true (1 : Fin (y.length + 2)) [])).mapState
                  (fun _ => exit)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_certificateShell
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
theorem FinTM.exists_certificateShell (P : FinTM Bool) (j : Fin P.k) (C c : ℕ)
    (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hP : ∀ x u : List Bool, u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c →
      (P.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) P.tm.q₀ (Function.update (fun _ => []) j u))
          (T (x.length + u.length))).state = none ∧
        (P.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) P.tm.q₀ (Function.update (fun _ => []) j u))
          (T (x.length + u.length))).output = out x u) :
    ∃ (V : FinTM Bool) (b e : ℕ),
      V.DecidesInTime {y | ∃ x u, y = x ++ u ∧ u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧
          out x u = [true]}
        fun m => b * ((m + 1) ^ e + T m)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.name: Turing.FinTM.certificateShell_proj
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ce.header:
theorem FinTM.certificateShell_proj (C c : ℕ) (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) :
    {x : List Bool | ∃ u, u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧
        x ++ u ∈ {y : List Bool | ∃ x u, y = x ++ u ∧ u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧
          out x u = [true]}} =
      {x | ∃ u, u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧ out x u = [true]}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.loop_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
theorem loop_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (accept : ℕ → Bool) (B N : ℕ)
    (hout : ∀ j ≤ N, (cfg j).output = [])
    (hend : ∃ t ≤ B, (tm.runFrom (cfg N) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg N) t).output = [false])
    (hround : ∀ j < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if accept j then
        (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none ∧
          (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = [true]
      else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∃ t ≤ (N + 1) * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output = [(List.range N).any accept]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loop_first_halt
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loop_first_halt {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ)
    (hstart : cfg.state ≠ none) (hhalt : (tm.runFrom cfg t).state = none) :
    ∃ u, 0 < u ∧ u ≤ t ∧
      (∀ v < u, ¬(tm.runFrom cfg v).Halted) ∧
      (tm.runFrom cfg u).state = none ∧ tm.runFrom cfg u = tm.runFrom cfg t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loop_orbit_inv

private lemma loop_orbit_inv (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (s0 : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ x s, Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s)) (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    Inv x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loop_fuel_width
Turing.FinTM.loop_output_length_le
Turing.FinTM.loop_rewind_bounded
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loop_rewind_bounded {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan))
    (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work =
      match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest)
    (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : cfg.state = some start) :
    ∃ t ≤ cfg.inputPos.val + 2,
      tm.runFrom cfg t = {cfg with state := dest, inputPos := 1}

private lemma loopBody_step (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}

      (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor) :
    (loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.runFrom (loopBodyCfg body anchor c release none) t =
      loopBodyCfg body anchor (body.tm.runFrom c t) (if t = 0 then release else false)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopControl_apply
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopControl_apply (body F : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)
    (q : Option (LoopHostState body F)) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (flag counter payload : ℤ → Option Bool) (ch ph : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (inp : SignType) (fw : Option (Option Bool))
    (ca pa : Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (emit : Option Bool)
    (next : Option (LoopHostState body F)) :
    (loopControlAction body F inp fw ca pa emit next).apply
        (loopFrame body F base q p flag counter payload ch ph out) =
      loopFrame body F base next (moveInputPos p inp)
        (loopWrite flag 0 fw) (loopWrite counter ch ca.1) (loopWrite payload ph pa.1)
        (ch + ca.2) (ph + pa.2) (out ++ emit.toList)

private lemma loop_scan_left {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (frame : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x) (done : Cfg k Bool S x) (n : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ j < n, tm.step (frame (j + 1)) = frame j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_payload_scan
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_payload_scan (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (findMode : Bool) (src dst : Fin 14)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.tr (.inr (.inr src)) inp work =
      match work (Fin.last (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k))) with
      | some _ => loopControlAction body F 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (.inr (.inr src)))
      | none => loopControlAction body F 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) none (some (.inr (.inr dst))))
    {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (flag counter : ℤ → Option Bool)
    (ch : ℤ) (word out : List Bool) : ∀ j, j ≤ word.length →
    (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.runFrom
        (loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr src))) p flag counter
          (bufferTape word) ch ((j : ℤ) - 1) out) (j + 1) =
      loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr dst))) p flag counter
        (bufferTape word) ch 0 out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_fuel_copy
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_fuel_copy (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)

    (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.runFrom
        (loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 2))) p flag (bufferTape pre)
          (loopCopyTape pre rest) pre.length pre.length out) (rest.length + 1) =
      loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 3))) p flag (bufferTape (pre ++ rest))
        (bufferTape []) ((pre ++ rest).length - 1) ((pre ++ rest).length - 1) out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_fuel_return
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_fuel_return (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)

    (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.runFrom

          (bufferTape []) ((j : ℤ) - 1) ((j : ℤ) - 1) out) (j + 1) =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_fuel_setup
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_fuel_setup (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)

    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)

        (loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 0))) p flag (bufferTape [])
          (bufferTape word) 0 word.length out) (3 * word.length + 4) =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopFuelCaptured

Turing.FinTM.loopFuelCaptured_frame

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_prepare
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_prepare (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (findMode : Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (x : List Bool) :
    ∃ (c : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (t : ℕ),
      c.state = none ∧ c.output = Nat.bits (R x.length) ∧ t ≤ 5 * T x.length + 7 ∧
      (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.runFrom
        ((loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.initCfg x) t = loopReady body F c

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopBodyPadded
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private def loopBodyPadded (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (flag : Option Bool)

    Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) Bool (body.State × Bool) x

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopCall
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private def loopCall (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}

    (flag : Option Bool) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emLoopForwardCfg
Turing.FinTM.emLoopCall
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private def emLoopCall (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emLoopCall_frame
Turing.FinTM.emLoopCall_empty
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopBodyImage
Turing.FinTM.loopBodyImage_nil
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopBodyImage_nil (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)

    (release : Bool) (flag : Option Bool) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x)
    (hc : c.output = []) :
    loopBodyImage body F forward startup []
        (loopBodyPadded body F anchor c release flag word fuel) =
