      (FinTM.bufferTape (w ++ [false])) 0 w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨6, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageLeg6
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageLeg6 {M mU : ℕ} {SU : Type} [Fintype SU] [DecidableEq SU]
    (U : MultiTapeTM mU Bool SU) (ue : SU) (ux : Bool → SU)
    (header ctrOuter : Fin M) (σ : Fin mU ↪ Fin M) (hhc : header ≠ ctrOuter)
    (x w : List Bool) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (v : List Bool) (hv : incFixed (w ++ [false]) = some v) :

      (FinTM.bufferTape (w ++ [false])) 0 w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨6, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) u =
      ((incrementTM M ctrOuter).runFrom
        (canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some FlagPhase.run) ip

    (canonStageFr M mU SU U ue ux header ctrOuter σ).runFrom
      (((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some FlagPhase.run) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape (w ++ [false])) 0 w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨6, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) (2 * ((w

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageFrontSpec
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageFrontSpec {M mU : ℕ} {SU : Type} [Fintype SU] [DecidableEq SU]
    (U : MultiTapeTM mU Bool SU) (ue : SU) (ux : Bool → SU) (uBound : Fin mU) (ua : ℕ)
    (uinj : Function.Injective ux)
    (unary : ∀ (x w : List Bool) (d : Cfg mU Bool SU x), d.state = some ue →
      1 ≤ d.inputPos.val →
      d.workTapes uBound = FinTM.bufferTape w → d.workTapePos uBound = 0 →
      (∀ j, j ≠ uBound → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) →
      ∃ t ≤ ua * (x.length + w.length + 1),
        (U.runFrom d t).state =
          some (ux (codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1)
            (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome) ∧
        (U.runFrom d t).output = d.output ∧
        (∀ u < t, ∀ v, (U.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (ux v)) ∧
        (U.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
        (U.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
        ∀ ys, codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1)) = some ys →
          (U.runFrom d t).inputPos.val = x.length + 1 - ys.length)
    (header ctrOuter : Fin M) (σ : Fin mU ↪ Fin M) (hσb : σ uBound = header)
    (hσc : ∀ i, σ i ≠ ctrOuter) (hhc : header ≠ ctrOuter) :
    ∃ (H : Type) (_ : Fintype H) (_ : DecidableEq H) (Fr : MultiTapeTM M Bool H)
      (entry : H) (exit : Bool → H) (A : ℕ), Function.Injective exit ∧
      ∀ (x w : List Bool) (d : Cfg M Bool H x), d.state = some entry → d.output = [] →
        1 ≤ d.inputPos.val →
        d.workTapes header = FinTM.bufferTape w → d.workTapePos header = 0 →
        (∀ j, j ≠ header → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) →
        ∃ t ≤ A * (x.length + w.length + 1), ∃ u : List Bool,
          Nat.ofDigits 2 (u.map Bool.toNat) = counterValue w + 1 ∧
          u.length = w.length + 1 ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).state = some (exit (codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1)
            (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome) ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).output = [] ∧
          (∀ v < t, ∀ b, (Fr.runFrom d v).state ≠ some (exit b)) ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapes header = FinTM.bufferTape w ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapePos header = 0 ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapes ctrOuter = FinTM.bufferTape u ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapePos ctrOuter = 0 ∧
          (∀ j, j ≠ header → j ≠ ctrOuter →
            (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧
            (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = 0) ∧
          ∀ ys, codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1)) = some ys →
            (Fr.runFrom d t).inputPos.val = x.length + 1 - ys.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGramPh_deceq

Turing.MachineFormat.canonGramRed

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGramCut_leg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonGramCut_leg {M : ℕ} {HF H₃ : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (G : MultiTapeTM M Bool (Σ j, canonGramPh HF H₃ j))
    (d : Cfg M Bool (Σ j, canonGramPh HF H₃ j) x) (A B : ℕ) (i : Fin 4) (hi : i.val ≠ 3)
    (c : Cfg M Bool (canonGramPh HF H₃ i) x)
    (Mach : MultiTapeTM M Bool (canonGramPh HF H₃ i))
    (hhost : G.runFrom d A = c.mapState (Sigma.mk i))
    (hpre : ∀ u ≤ B, G.runFrom (c.mapState (Sigma.mk i)) u =
      (Mach.runFrom c u).mapState (Sigma.mk i))
    (vt : ℕ) (h1 : A ≤ vt) (h2 : vt ≤ A + B) (b : Bool) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGramFin_suffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGramLedger
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonGramLedger (AF A₃ X t₁ t₂ t₃ : ℕ)
    (h₁ : t₁ ≤ AF * (2 * (X + 1))) (h₂ : t₂ ≤ A₃ * (3 * (X + 1)) ^ 2)
    (h₃ : t₃ ≤ X + 2) :
    t₁ + 1 + (t₂ + 1) + (t₃ + 1) ≤
      (2 * AF + 9 * A₃ + 8) * (X + 1) ^ (2 * AF + 9 * A₃ + 8)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonGrammarStage
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonGrammarStage (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (G : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
      (entry : S) (exit : Bool → S) (a : ℕ) (header : Fin m), Function.Injective exit ∧
      ∀ (x bits rest : List Bool), pairDecode x = some (bits, rest) →
        bits = (codeBitsNat bits).bits →
        canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length →
        ∀ d : Cfg m Bool S x, d.state = some entry → d.output = [] →
          d.inputPos.val = 2 * bits.length + 3 →
          d.workTapes header = FinTM.bufferTape bits → d.workTapePos header = 0 →
          (∀ j, j ≠ header → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) →
          ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1) ^ a,
            (G.runFrom d t).state =
              some (exit (canonGrammar F.k (codeBitsNat bits) rest).isSome) ∧
            (G.runFrom d t).output = [] ∧
            ∀ u < t, ∀ v, (G.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (exit v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonDecider
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonDecider (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (D : FinTM Bool) (a : ℕ), ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ b : Bool,
      D.ComputesInTime α [b] (a * (α.length + 1) ^ a) ∧
        (b = false → F.decode α = F.fallback) ∧
        (b = true → ∃ tail, F.scan α = some tail)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_polyCanonizer
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
theorem exists_polyCanonizer :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (d : ℕ),
      C.ComputesFunInTime (fun α => F.serialize (F.decode α)) fun n => d * (n + 1) ^ d

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.summaryClock
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private def summaryClock {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q)
    {x : List Bool} : ℕ → Cfg k Bool Q x → Option Bool → Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.summaryClock_correct
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma summaryClock_correct {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q)
    {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (t : ℕ) :
    summaryClock M t c (outputSummary c.output) =
      ((M.runFrom c t).state.isNone &&
        (outputSummary (M.runFrom c t).output == some true))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.summaryClock_accepts
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma summaryClock_accepts (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    summaryClock M.tm t (M.tm.initCfg x) none = true ↔ M.ComputesInTime x [true] t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.summaryClock_zero
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma summaryClock_zero (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    summaryClock M.tm 0 (M.tm.initCfg x) none = false

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.h1HostedVerdictTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private def h1HostedVerdictTM (k : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM (1 + (k + 2 + 1)) Bool (CounterLoopState (Σ key, Ph k key) × Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.h1HostedVerdict_effect
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem h1HostedVerdict_effect {k n : ℕ} {x z : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some (exit k true))
    (rel : Rep M.tr (M.initCfg x) d) (t : ℕ)
    (p : Fin (z.length + 2)) :
    ∃ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) + 4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3,
      let e := (h1HostedVerdictTM k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T
      e.state = none ∧ e.inputPos = p ∧
        e.output = d.output ++ [summaryClock M t (M.initCfg x) none]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.h1HostedVerdict_accepts
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem h1HostedVerdict_accepts (F : MachineFormat) (α x z : List Bool)
    (d : Cfg (F.k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph F.k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some (exit F.k true))
    (rel : Rep (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr
      ((F.machine (F.decode α)).initCfg x) d) (t : ℕ)
    (p : Fin (z.length + 2)) :
    ∃ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).state = none ∧
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).output = d.output ++ [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_install
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_install :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a d : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ x α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * ((α.length + 1) ^ d + α.length +
          max α.length (F.serialize F.fallback).length + 1), 0 < t ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k α)) t').state ≠
            some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k α)) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (serializeK (F.machine (F.decode α))))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_locality
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_locality {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (x : List Bool)
    (t : ℕ) :
    (M.runFrom (M.initCfg (x.take t)) t).state = (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).state ∧
      (M.runFrom (M.initCfg (x.take t)) t).output = (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).output

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_verdict
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_verdict (S : FinTM Bool) (z : List Bool) (T B : ℕ) (answer : Bool) (P : Prop)
    (hT : T ≤ B) (halt : (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg z) T).state = none)
    (out : (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg z) T).output = [answer]) (hans : answer = true ↔ P) :
    (P → S.ComputesInTime z [true] B) ∧ (¬P → S.ComputesInTime z [false] B)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_table_le
Turing.MachineFormat.us_window_verdict
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_window_verdict (α x z : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (d : Cfg (F.k + 2) Bool (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) (x.take t))
    (entry : d.state = some (StepBlock.exit F.k true))
    (rel : StepBlock.Rep (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr
      ((F.machine (F.decode α)).initCfg (x.take t)) d)
    (p : Fin (z.length + 2)) (silent : d.output = []) :
    ∃ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).state = none ∧
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).output = [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_ledger
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_ledger (a d₀ A B L αl xl t T₁ T₂ s m tb bl : ℕ)
    (hm : m ≤ αl + L) (hs : s ≤ m) (htb : tb ≤ m) (hbl : bl ≤ t)
    (hT₁ : T₁ ≤ a * ((αl + 1) ^ d₀ + αl + m + 1) + A * (αl + s + 1) +
      B * (bl + min t xl + 1))
    (hT₂ : T₂ ≤ t * (50 * (tb + 1)) + 4 * t + 2 * bl + 3) :
    T₁ + 1 + T₂ ≤ (a * (L + 4) + A * (L + 3) + 3 * B + 50 * L + 110 + d₀ + 2) *
      (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (a * (L + 4) + A * (L + 3) + 3 * B + 50 * L + 110 + d₀ + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_bank
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_bank {k K : ℕ} (ιP : Fin k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (hcw : jctr ≠ jwin) (hct : jctr ≠ jtbl) (hcs : jctr ≠ jsm) (hwt : jwin ≠ jtbl)
    (hws : jwin ≠ jsm) (hts : jtbl ≠ jsm) (hcP : jctr ∉ Set.range ιP)
    (hwP : jwin ∉ Set.range ιP) (htP : jtbl ∉ Set.range ιP) (hsP : jsm ∉ Set.range ιP) :
    ∃ g : Fin (1 + (k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K,
      g (Fin.castAdd (k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin ∧
      (∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i) ∧
      g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd k 0))) = jtbl ∧
      g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd k 1))) = jsm ∧
      g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (k + 2))) = jctr

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_junction
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_junction {K : ℕ} {Q : Type} {z : List Bool} (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (g : Fin (1 + (F.k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K) (ιP : Fin F.k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (gw : g (Fin.castAdd (F.k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin)
    (gP : ∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i)
    (gt : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 0))) = jtbl)
    (gs : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 1))) = jsm)
    (gc : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (F.k + 2))) = jctr)
    (c : Cfg K Bool Q z) (done : Q) (hst : c.state = some done) (hout : c.output = [])
    (hctr : c.workTapes jctr = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) (hctrp : c.workTapePos jctr = 0)
    (hwin : c.workTapes jwin = FinTM.bufferTape (x.take t)) (hwinp : c.workTapePos jwin = 0)
    (htbl : c.workTapes jtbl = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr))
    (htblp : c.workTapePos jtbl = 0)
    (hsm : c.workTapes jsm =
      StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀))
    (hsmp : c.workTapePos jsm = 0)
    (hpas : ∀ i, c.workTapes (ιP i) = (fun _ => none) ∧ c.workTapePos (ιP i) = 0) :
    ∃ d : Cfg (F.k + 2) Bool (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) (x.take t),
      d.state = some (StepBlock.exit F.k true) ∧
      StepBlock.Rep (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr
        ((F.machine (F.decode α)).initCfg (x.take t)) d ∧
      d.output = [] ∧
      c.mapState (fun _ => ((CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true) :
          CounterLoopState (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) × Bool)) =
        embedEmitCfg g c.workTapes c.workTapePos []
          (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) d
            (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true c.inputPos [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_tail
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_tail {K : ℕ} {Q : Type} [DecidableEq Q] (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (U : MultiTapeTM K Bool Q) (done : Q) (g : Fin (1 + (F.k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K)
    (ιP : Fin F.k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (gw : g (Fin.castAdd (F.k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin)
    (gP : ∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i)
    (gt : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 0))) = jtbl)
    (gs : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 1))) = jsm)
    (gc : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (F.k + 2))) = jctr)
    (c₀ c : Cfg K Bool Q (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x)) (T₁ : ℕ)
    (run : U.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c) (hst : c.state = some done)
    (cut : ∀ u < T₁, (U.runFrom c₀ u).state ≠ some done) (hout : c.output = [])
    (hctr : c.workTapes jctr = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) (hctrp : c.workTapePos jctr = 0)
    (hwin : c.workTapes jwin = FinTM.bufferTape (x.take t)) (hwinp : c.workTapePos jwin = 0)
    (htbl : c.workTapes jtbl = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr))
    (htblp : c.workTapePos jtbl = 0)
    (hsm : c.workTapes jsm =
      StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀))
    (hsmp : c.workTapePos jsm = 0)
    (hpas : ∀ i, c.workTapes (ιP i) = (fun _ => none) ∧ c.workTapePos (ιP i) = 0) :
    ∃ T₂ ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      ((seamCompTM U done (embedEmitTM g (h1HostedVerdictTM F.k))
          (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true)).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl)
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).state = none ∧
      ((seamCompTM U done (embedEmitTM g (h1HostedVerdictTM F.k))
          (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true)).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl)
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).output = [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_start {K : ℕ} {Q R : Type} (W : MultiTapeTM K Bool (Q ⊕ R)) (entry : Q)
    (z : List Bool) :
    ({ W with q₀ := Sum.inl entry } : MultiTapeTM K Bool (Q ⊕ R)).initCfg z =
      (⟨some entry, 1, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ : Cfg K Bool Q z).mapState Sum.inl

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_run {K : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] (α x : List Bool)
    (t : ℕ) (U : MultiTapeTM K Bool Q) (entry done : Q) (g : Fin (1 + (F.k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K)
    (ιP : Fin F.k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (gw : g (Fin.castAdd (F.k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin)
    (gP : ∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i)
    (gt : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 0))) = jtbl)
    (gs : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 1))) = jsm)
    (gc : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (F.k + 2))) = jctr)
    (c : Cfg K Bool Q (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x)) (T₁ : ℕ)
    (run : U.runFrom ⟨some entry, 1, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ T₁ = c)
    (hst : c.state = some done)
    (cut : ∀ u < T₁, (U.runFrom (⟨some entry, 1, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ :
      Cfg K Bool Q (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x)) u).state ≠ some done)
    (hout : c.output = [])
    (hctr : c.workTapes jctr = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) (hctrp : c.workTapePos jctr = 0)
    (hwin : c.workTapes jwin = FinTM.bufferTape (x.take t)) (hwinp : c.workTapePos jwin = 0)
    (htbl : c.workTapes jtbl = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr))
    (htblp : c.workTapePos jtbl = 0)
    (hsm : c.workTapes jsm =
      StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀))
    (hsmp : c.workTapePos jsm = 0)
    (hpas : ∀ i, c.workTapes (ιP i) = (fun _ => none) ∧ c.workTapePos (ιP i) = 0) :
    let S : FinTM Bool :=
      { k := K, State := Q ⊕ (CounterLoopState (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) × Bool),
        tm := { seamCompTM U done (embedEmitTM g (h1HostedVerdictTM F.k))
          (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true) with q₀ := Sum.inl entry } }
    ∃ T₂ ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x))
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).state = none ∧
      (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x))
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).output = [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_uniformSimulator
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
theorem exists_uniformSimulator :
    ∃ (S : FinTM Bool) (d : ℕ), ∀ (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      ((F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t →
        S.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [true]
          (d * (α.length + x.length + t + 1) ^ d)) ∧
      (¬(F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t →
        S.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [false]
          (d * (α.length + x.length + t + 1) ^ d))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.idTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header: def idTM : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.idTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem idTM_spaceUsed (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    idTM.tm.spaceUsed (idTM.tm.initCfg x) t = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.idTM_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma idTM_run (x : List Bool) : ∀ t, t ≤ x.length →
    (idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) t).state = some () ∧
    (((idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos : ℕ) = t + 1) ∧
    (idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) t).output = x.take t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.idTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header: theorem idTM_computes (x : List Bool) : idTM.ComputesInTime x x (x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_id
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_id :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime id fun n => c * (n + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.constTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header: def constTM (w : List Bool) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.constTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem constTM_spaceUsed (w x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (constTM w).tm.spaceUsed ((constTM w).tm.initCfg x) t = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.constTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem constTM_computes (w x : List Bool) :
    (constTM w).ComputesInTime x w (w.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_const
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_const (w : List Bool) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun _ => w) fun n => c * (n + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.ifEqTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header: def ifEqTM (w₀ u v : List Bool) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.ifEq_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma ifEq_finish (w₀ u v x : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (cfg : Cfg 0 Bool (ifEqTM w₀ u v).State x)
    (hs : cfg.state = some (.inr (cond b (.inl 0) (.inr 0)))) (ho : cfg.output = []) :
    ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg ((cond b u v).length + 1)).state = none ∧
    ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg ((cond b u v).length + 1)).output = cond b u v

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.ifEq_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma ifEq_run (w₀ u v x : List Bool) : ∀ (r i : ℕ) (hlen : w₀.length = i + r), i ≤ x.length → x.take i = w₀.take i →
    ∀ (cfg : Cfg 0 Bool (ifEqTM w₀ u v).State x),
      cfg.state = some (.inl ⟨i, by omega⟩) → cfg.inputPos.val = i + 1 → cfg.output = [] →
      ∃ t, t ≤ r + max u.length v.length + 2 ∧
        ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg t).state = none ∧
        ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg t).output = if x = w₀ then u else v

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.ifEqTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem ifEqTM_computes (w₀ u v : List Bool) :
    (ifEqTM w₀ u v).ComputesFunInTime (fun w => if w = w₀ then u else v)
      (fun n => (w₀.length + max u.length v.length + 3) * (n + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_ifEq
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_ifEq (w₀ u v : List Bool) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => if w = w₀ then u else v) fun n => c * (n + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime
Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime
Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_comp
Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime_on_image
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime_on_image (M U : FinTM Bool)
    (f g : List Bool → List Bool) (T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T₁)
    (hU : ∀ x, U.ComputesInTime (f x) (g x) (T₂ x.length)) :
    (bufferedCompTM M U).ComputesFunInTime g (fun n => 2 * T₁ n + T₂ n + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_comp_on_image
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem exists_comp_on_image (M U : FinTM Bool) (f g : List Bool → List Bool)
    (T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T₁)
    (hU : ∀ x, U.ComputesInTime (f x) (g x) (T₂ x.length)) :
    ∃ N : FinTM Bool, N.ComputesFunInTime g (fun n => 2 * T₁ n + T₂ n + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computes_iff
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem bufferedCompTM_computes_iff (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) :
    (∃ t, (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t) ↔
      ∃ y : List Bool, (∃ t, M₁.ComputesInTime x y t) ∧ ∃ t, M₂.ComputesInTime y w t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_comp_partial
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem exists_comp_partial (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) :
    ∃ M : FinTM Bool, ∀ x w : List Bool,
      (∃ t, M.ComputesInTime x w t) ↔
        ∃ y : List Bool,
          (∃ t, M₁.ComputesInTime x y t) ∧ ∃ t, M₂.ComputesInTime y w t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.condTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header: def condTM (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.controlCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private def controlCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) : Cfg (condTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (condTM D M₁ M₂).State x

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.controlCfg_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma controlCfg_step (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (hs : c.state ≠ none) :
    (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step (controlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) =
      controlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.step c)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.controlCfg_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma controlCfg_run (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ s, s < t → (D.tm.runFrom c s).state ≠ none) :
    (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (controlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) t =
      controlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom c t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.condTM_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma condTM_start (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hD : ∃ t, D.ComputesInTime x [b] t) :
    ∃ (t : ℕ) (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
      (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t =
        rightCfg (fun q => .inr (.inr q)) ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) tapes heads

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.condTM_computes_iff
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem condTM_computes_iff (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (p : List Bool → Bool)
    (hD : D.Computes fun x => [p x]) (x w : List Bool) :
    (∃ t, (condTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t) ↔
      ∃ t, (cond (p x) M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_cond
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem exists_cond (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (p : List Bool → Bool)
    (hD : D.Computes fun x => [p x]) :
    ∃ M : FinTM Bool, ∀ x w : List Bool,
      (∃ t, M.ComputesInTime x w t) ↔
        ∃ t, (cond (p x) M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.name: Turing.CodeTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.header: structure CodeTM

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.name: Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.header: def CodeTM.toFinTM (M : CodeTM) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.name: Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM_eq
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.header:
theorem CodeTM.toFinTM_eq (M : CodeTM) :
    M.toFinTM = { k := 1, State := Fin (M.numStates + 1), tm := M.tm }

theorem pairDecode_eq_none (z : List Bool) (h : pairDecode z = none) :
    ∃ w tail, z = dbl w ++ tail ∧
      (tail = [] ∨ (∃ b, tail = [b]) ∨ ∃ r, tail = true :: false :: r)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.name: Turing.pairDiag_double
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.header:
private lemma pairDiag_double (x : List Bool) : ∀ t, (ht : t ≤ x.length) →
    pairDiagTM.tm.runFrom (pairDiagTM.tm.initCfg x) (2 * t) =
      pairDiagCfg x (some 0) ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩ ((x.take t).flatMap fun b => [b, b])

private lemma pairDiag_rewind (x out : List Bool) : ∀ j, (hj : j ≤ x.length) →
    pairDiagTM.tm.runFrom (pairDiagCfg x (some 4) ⟨j, by omega⟩ out) (j + 1) =
      pairDiagCfg x (some 5) 1 out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.name: Turing.pairDiag_copy
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.header:
private lemma pairDiag_copy (x out : List Bool) : ∀ t, (ht : t ≤ x.length) →
    pairDiagTM.tm.runFrom (pairDiagCfg x (some 5) 1 out) t =
      pairDiagCfg x (some 5) ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩ (out ++ x.take t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.name: Turing.pairDiag_separator
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.header:
private lemma pairDiag_separator (x out : List Bool) :
    pairDiagTM.tm.runFrom
      (pairDiagCfg x (some 0) ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ out) 3 =
      pairDiagCfg x (some 4) ⟨x.length, by omega⟩ (out ++ [false, true])

def emitAction {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (w : List Bool)
    (e : Fin (w.length + 1) → S) (i : Fin (w.length + 1)) : Action k Bool S

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.emit_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma emit_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (w : List Bool) (e : Fin (w.length + 1) → S)
    (htr : ∀ i inp work, tm.tr (e i) inp work = emitAction w e i)
    (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : cfg.state = some (e 0)) :
    ∀ t (ht : t ≤ w.length),
      (tm.runFrom cfg t).state = some (e ⟨t, by omega⟩) ∧
      (tm.runFrom cfg t).output = cfg.output ++ w.take t

    (htr : ∀ i inp work, tm.tr (e i) inp work = emitAction w e i)
    (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : cfg.state = some (e 0)) :
    (tm.runFrom cfg (w.length + 1)).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom cfg (w.length + 1)).output = cfg.output ++ w

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma leftCfg_step {k l : ℕ} {S S' : Type} {x : List Bool}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_scan
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma rewind_scan {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work =
      match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest) :
    ∀ (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x), cfg.state = some scan → cfg.inputPos.val ≤ x.length →
      tm.runFrom cfg (cfg.inputPos.val + 1) = {cfg with state := dest, inputPos := 1}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_from_any
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma rewind_from_any {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan))
    (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work =
      match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest)
    (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : cfg.state = some start) :
    ∃ t, tm.runFrom cfg t = {cfg with state := dest, inputPos := 1}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma timed_rewind {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan))
    (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) :
    ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_scan_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
theorem rewind_scan_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x), cfg.state = some scan →
      cfg.inputPos.val = j → j ≤ x.length →
      ∀ u ≤ j + 1, (tm.runFrom cfg u).workTapePos = cfg.workTapePos

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
theorem rewind_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan))
    (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) :
    ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1} ∧
      ∀ u ≤ r, (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos = c.workTapePos

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
def tapeBlocks {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (left : Fin k → α) (buffer : α)
    (right : Fin l → α) : Fin (k + (1 + l)) → α

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks_left
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
@[simp] lemma tapeBlocks_left {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (a : Fin k → α) (b : α)
    (c : Fin l → α) (i : Fin k) :
    tapeBlocks a b c (Fin.castAdd (1 + l) i) = a i

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks_buffer
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
@[simp] lemma tapeBlocks_buffer {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (a : Fin k → α) (b : α)
    (c : Fin l → α) (i : Fin 1) :
    tapeBlocks a b c (Fin.natAdd k (Fin.castAdd l i)) = b

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.tapeBlocks_right
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
@[simp] lemma tapeBlocks_right {α : Type} {k l : ℕ} (a : Fin k → α) (b : α)
    (c : Fin l → α) (i : Fin l) :
    tapeBlocks a b c (Fin.natAdd k (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) = c i

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header: def bufferTape {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (z : ℤ) : Option Symbol

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_nil
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header: @[simp] lemma bufferTape_nil {Symbol : Type*} : bufferTape (Symbol := Symbol) [] = fun _ => none

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_nat
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
@[simp] lemma bufferTape_nat {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (i : ℕ) :
    bufferTape w i = w[i]?

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_left
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header: @[simp] lemma bufferTape_left {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) : bufferTape w (-1) = none

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_eq
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
theorem bufferTape_eq {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (z : ℤ) :
    bufferTape w z = if 0 ≤ z then w[z.toNat]? else none

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_of_neg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
theorem bufferTape_of_neg {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) {z : ℤ} (hz : z < 0) :
    bufferTape w z = none

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_append
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma bufferTape_append {Symbol : Type*} (w : List Symbol) (b : Symbol) :
    bufferTape (w ++ [b]) = Function.update (bufferTape w) (w.length : ℤ) (some b)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.VirtualTag
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header: def VirtualTag {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)) (b : Bool) : Prop

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.VirtualTag_iff
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
theorem VirtualTag_iff {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 2)) (b : Bool) :
    VirtualTag p b ↔ (p.val = 0 → b = false) ∧ (p.val = n + 1 → b = true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.virtualMove
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header: def virtualMove (b : Bool) (inp : Option Bool) (m : SignType) : SignType

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.virtualNextTag
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header: def virtualNextTag (b : Bool) (m : SignType) : Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_inputSymbol
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma bufferTape_inputSymbol {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg k Bool S w) : bufferTape w ((c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1) = c.inputSymbol

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.virtualMove_correct
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma virtualMove_correct {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg k Bool S w) (b : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (m : SignType) :
    (c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1 + (virtualMove b c.inputSymbol m : ℤ) =
      ((moveInputPos c.inputPos m).val : ℤ) - 1 ∧
    VirtualTag (moveInputPos c.inputPos m)
      (virtualNextTag b (virtualMove b c.inputSymbol m))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header: def bufferedCompTM (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedFirstCfg
Turing.FinTM.bufferedFirstCfg_init
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma bufferedFirstCfg_init (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x = bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ (M₁.tm.initCfg x)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedFirstCfg_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma bufferedFirstCfg_step (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M₁.k Bool M₁.State x) (hs : c.state ≠ none) :
    (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.step (bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ c) =
      bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ (M₁.tm.step c)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedFirstCfg_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma bufferedFirstCfg_run (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M₁.k Bool M₁.State x) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ s, s < t → (M₁.tm.runFrom c s).state ≠ none) :
    (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ c) t =
      bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ (M₁.tm.runFrom c t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
def bufferedSecondCfg (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) :
    Cfg (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k Bool (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).State x

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_workTapes_cast
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
theorem bufferedSecondCfg_workTapes_cast (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ)
    (i : Fin (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k) :
    (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads).workTapes i =
      tapeBlocks tapes (bufferTape y) c.workTapes (Fin.cast (bufferedCompTM_k M₁ M₂) i)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_workTapePos_cast
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
theorem bufferedSecondCfg_workTapePos_cast (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ)
    (i : Fin (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k) :
    (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads).workTapePos i =
      tapeBlocks heads ((c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1) c.workTapePos
        (Fin.cast (bufferedCompTM_k M₁ M₂) i)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma bufferedSecondCfg_step (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) :
    ∃ b', VirtualTag (M₂.tm.step c).inputPos b' ∧
      (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.step (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads) =
        bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.step c) b' p tapes heads

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedSecondCfg_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma bufferedSecondCfg_run (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M₂.k Bool M₂.State y) (b : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ b', VirtualTag (M₂.tm.runFrom c t).inputPos b' ∧
      (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ c b p tapes heads) t =
        bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.runFrom c t) b' p tapes heads

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedScanCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
def bufferedScanCfg (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (y : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) (j : ℕ) :
    Cfg (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).k Bool (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).State x

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedScanCfg_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma bufferedScanCfg_run (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool} (y : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ) : ∀ j, j ≤ y.length →
    (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedScanCfg M₁ M₂ y p tapes heads j) (j + 1) =
      bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.initCfg y) true p tapes heads

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedFirstCfg_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma bufferedFirstCfg_rewind (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M₁.k Bool M₁.State x) (hs : c.state = none) :
    (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (bufferedFirstCfg M₁ M₂ c) (c.output.length + 2) =
      bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.initCfg c.output) true c.inputPos c.workTapes c.workTapePos

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedComp_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
lemma bufferedComp_start (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x y : List Bool) (t₁ : ℕ)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesInTime x y t₁) :
    ∃ (a : ℕ) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin M₁.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
      (heads : Fin M₁.k → ℤ), a ≤ t₁ + y.length + 2 ∧
      (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a =
        bufferedSecondCfg M₁ M₂ (M₂.tm.initCfg y) true p tapes heads

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.AgreeOn
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
def AgreeOn {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} (M N : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
    (Q : Set State) : Prop

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.agreeOn_iff
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
theorem agreeOn_iff {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type*} (M N : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
    (Q : Set State) :
    M.AgreeOn N Q ↔ ∀ q ∈ Q, ∀ inp work, M.tr q inp work = N.tr q inp work

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.name: Turing.MultiTapeTM.step_eq_of_agreeOn
Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_eq_of_agreeOn
Turing.FinTM.branchTM_runFrom_independent
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Simulati.header:
theorem branchTM_runFrom_independent (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b b' : Bool)
    {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x) (t : ℕ) :
    let view : Bool → MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) :=
      fun tag => by
        rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ tag, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ tag]
        exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ tag).tm
    (view b).runFrom c t = (view b').runFrom c t

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.TimeConstructible
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header: def TimeConstructible (T : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.timeConstructible_iff
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
theorem timeConstructible_iff (T : ℕ → ℕ) :
    TimeConstructible T ↔
      (∀ n, n ≤ T n) ∧ ∃ c : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ M : FinTM Bool, ∀ x : List Bool,
        M.ComputesInTime x (T x.length).bits (c * (T x.length + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counterInc
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header: private def counterInc : List Bool → List Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counterCarry
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header: private def counterCarry : List Bool → ℕ

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counterInc_potential
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counterInc_potential (bs : List Bool) :
    (counterInc bs).count true + counterCarry bs = bs.count true + 1

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counterInc_bits
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header: private lemma counterInc_bits (n : ℕ) : counterInc n.bits = (n + 1).bits

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counterInc_length
Complexity.counterBump
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header: private def counterBump (d : SignType) (w : Option Bool) : Action 1 Bool (Fin 4)

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header: def _root_.Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counterTape
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header: private def counterTape (bs : List Bool) (z : ℤ) : Option Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counterCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private def counterCfg (x : List Bool) (q : Fin 4) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (z : ℤ) (bs out : List Bool) : Cfg 1 Bool (Fin 4) x

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counterTape_read
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counterTape_read (pre bs : List Bool) :
    counterTape (pre ++ bs) pre.length = bs.head?

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counterTape_write
Complexity.counter_carry_step
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_carry_step (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (pre bs : List Bool) :
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.step (counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) []) =
      if bs.head? = some true then
        counterCfg x 1 p (pre.length + 1) (pre ++ false :: bs.tail) []
      else counterCfg x 2 p (pre.length - 1) (pre ++ true :: bs.tail) []

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counter_carry
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_carry (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ pre : List Bool,
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 1 p pre.length (pre ++ bs) [])
        (counterCarry bs + 1) =
      counterCfg x 2 p ((pre.length : ℤ) + counterCarry bs - 1)
        (pre ++ counterInc bs) []

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counter_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_rewind (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ bs.length),
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 2 p ((j : ℤ) - 1) bs []) (j + 1) =
      counterCfg x 0 p 0 bs []

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counter_start
Complexity.counter_increment
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_increment (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length)
    (bs : List Bool) :
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 bs [])
        (2 * counterCarry bs + 2) =
      counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ 0 (counterInc bs) []

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counter_count
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_count (x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length),
    ∃ t, t + 2 * i.bits.count true ≤ 4 * i ∧
      FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.initCfg x) t =
        counterCfg x 0 ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ 0 i.bits [] ∧
      ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j : Fin 1,
        (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos j ∈
          Finset.Icc (-(2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ)) (2 * (Nat.size x.length + 1) : ℤ)

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counter_emit_run
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_emit_run (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (bs : List Bool) : ∀ i (_hi : i ≤ bs.length),
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (counterCfg x 3 p 0 bs []) i =
      counterCfg x 3 p i bs (bs.take i)

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Complexity.counter_emit
Complexity.counter_emit_start
Complexity.counter_halt
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
private lemma counter_halt (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (hc : FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.initCfg x) t =
      counterCfg x 0 ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ 0 x.length.bits []) :
    FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.runFrom (FinTM.lengthBitsTM.tm.initCfg x) (t + 1) =
        counterCfg x 3 ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ 0 x.length.bits [] ∧
      FinTM.lengthBitsTM.ComputesInTime x x.length.bits
        ((t + 1) + (x.length.bits.length + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:
theorem _root_.Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_computes : FinTM.lengthBitsTM.ComputesFunInTime
    (fun x => Nat.bits x.length) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.name: Turing.FinTM.lengthBitsTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassP/TimeConstructib.header:

    (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .sweep)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) (t : ℕ) :
    (clearTM k i).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace (catalogClearF i d) (catalogClearR i d w.length)
        { d with state := some .done
                 workTapes := fun j q =>
                   if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
                     then none else d.workTapes j q } w.length t

Turing.catalog_trace_clauses
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma catalog_trace_clauses {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x)
    (touched : Fin k → Prop) [DecidablePred touched] (F R : ℕ → Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x)
    (D : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (L : ℕ)
    (htrace : ∀ t, M.runFrom d t = catalogTrace F R D L t)
    (hF : ∀ r, (F r).state = some .sweep ∧
      ∀ j, (F r).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if touched j then (r : ℤ) else 0)
    (hR : ∀ r, (R r).state = some .rewind ∧
      ∀ j, (R r).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if touched j then (r : ℤ) - 1 else 0)
    (hD : D.state = some .done ∧ D.workTapePos = d.workTapePos) :
    (∀ t < 2 * L + 2, (M.runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
    (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * L + 2 →
      if touched j then
        (M.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
          Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (L : ℤ))
      else (M.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.catalog_transferMap_trace
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma catalog_transferMap_trace {Symbol : Type*} {Δ : Type*} {x : List Symbol}
    (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (extract : Symbol → Δ)
    (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (rest : Symbol → Option Symbol) (w : List Symbol)
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .sweep)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) (t : ℕ) :
    (transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace
        (catalogSweepF src dst (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map
          fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ)) d)
        (catalogSweepResidueR src dst (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map
          fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ))
          (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos src)).bind rest) d w.length)
        { d with state := some .done
                 workTapes := (catalogSweepResidueR src dst
                   (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos dst)).map
                     fun γ => merge (d.workTapes dst q) (extract γ))
                   (fun q => (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos src)).bind rest)
                   d w.length 0).workTapes }
        w.length t

      (u[d]? = v[d]? ↔ u = v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.catalog_compare_trace
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private lemma catalog_compare_trace {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {x : List Symbol}
    (fst snd : Fin k) (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p)
    (hv : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (v.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p)
    (δ : ℕ) (hδ : δ ≤ min u.length v.length)
    (hp : ∀ r < δ, ∃ b, u[r]? = some b ∧ v[r]? = some b)
    (hs : ¬∃ b, u[δ]? = some b ∧ v[δ]? = some b)
    (he : (u[δ]? = v[δ]?) ↔ u = v) (t : ℕ) :
    (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace (catalogCompareF fst snd d)
        (catalogCompareR fst snd d (decide (u = v)))
        { d with state := some (.done (decide (u = v))) } δ t

    (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.transferMapTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem transferMapTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {Δ : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (extract : Symbol → Δ)
    (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (rest : Symbol → Option Symbol) (w : List Symbol)
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some SweepPhase.done
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = src ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).bind rest
            else if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).map
                fun γ => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract γ)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2,
        ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).state ≠
          some SweepPhase.done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
        if j = src ∨ j = dst then
          ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
        else ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).workTapePos j =
          d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.copyMapTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem copyMapTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {Δ : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (extract : Symbol → Δ)
    (merge : Option Symbol → Δ → Symbol) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some SweepPhase.done
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).map
                fun γ => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract γ)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2,
        ((copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
        if j = src ∨ j = dst then
          ((copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
        else ((copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d t).workTapePos j =
          d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.transferTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem transferTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k)
    (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (transferTM k src dst).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some SweepPhase.done
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = src ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then none
            else if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧
                q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2,
        ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
        if j = src ∨ j = dst then
          ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
        else ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (q q' : S)
    (w : Fin k → List Bool) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ dst) (hdst : w dst = []) :
    ({ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w) with
        state := some q'
        workTapes := fun j p =>
          if j = src ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧
              p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ)
            then none
          else if j = dst ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧
              p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ)
            then FinTM.bufferTape (w src) (p - (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j)
          else (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapes j p } : Cfg k Bool S x) =
      Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update (Function.update w src []) dst (w src))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.copyTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem copyTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k)
    (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (copyTM k src dst).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some SweepPhase.done
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = dst ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2,
        ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
        if j = src ∨ j = dst then
          ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
        else ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (q q' : S)
    (w : Fin k → List Bool) (src dst : Fin k) (hdst : w dst = []) :
    ({ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w) with
        state := some q'
        workTapes := fun j p =>
          if j = dst ∧ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j ≤ p ∧
              p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : ℤ)
            then FinTM.bufferTape (w src) (p - (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j)
          else (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapes j p } : Cfg k Bool S x) =
      Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update w dst (w src))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.clearTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem clearTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)
    (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (clearTM k i).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some SweepPhase.done
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then none
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2,
        ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
        if j = i then
          ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
        else ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.catalog_increment_framed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
private theorem catalog_increment_framed {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (w : List Bool) (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p)
    (p : ℕ) (tail : Option (List Bool))
    (hsplit : w = List.replicate p true ++ tail.elim [] (false :: ·)) :
    (incrementTM k i).runFrom d (2 * p + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some (FlagPhase.done tail.isSome)
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate p false ++ tail.elim [] (true :: ·))
                (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * p + 2, ∀ b : Bool,
        ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * p + 2 →
        if j = i then
          ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (p : ℤ))
        else ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

theorem incrementTM_run_succ_ofCfg {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (w v : List Bool) (hv : incFixed w = some v) (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x)

    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (incrementTM k i).runFrom d (2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some (FlagPhase.done true)
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape v (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2, ∀ b : Bool,
        ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2 →
        if j = i then
          ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1)
              (d.workTapePos j + ((w.takeWhile id).length : ℤ))
        else ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

theorem incrementTM_run_overflow_ofCfg {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k)
    (w : List Bool) (hv : incFixed w = none) (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem transferTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : ℕ) (src dst : Fin k)
    (hne : src ≠ dst) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) (t : ℕ) :
    (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t src
      ≤ (w src).length + 2 ∧
    (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t dst
      ≤ (w src).length + 2 ∧
    ∀ j : Fin k, j ≠ src → j ≠ dst →
      (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t j = 1

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem capture_visitedByTapeHead {k : ℕ} {S H : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool H)
    (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool),
      host.tr (emb s) inp w =
        captureAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp fun i => w i.castSucc))
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) :
    (∀ i : Fin k,
      host.visitedByTapeHead (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t i.castSucc
        = tm.visitedByTapeHead c₀ t i ∧
      host.spaceUsedByTape (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t i.castSucc
        = tm.spaceUsedByTape c₀ t i) ∧
    host.spaceUsedByTape (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t (Fin.last k)
      ≤ (tm.runFrom c₀ t).output.length - c₀.output.length + 1

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_splitSolve_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => [])
        (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ c * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool}
    {p : List Bool → Bool} {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool}
    {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ} (sD s₁ s₂ : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂)
    (hsD : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ sD x.length)
    (hs₁ : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      M₁.tm.spaceUsed (M₁.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s₁ x.length)
    (hs₂ : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      M₂.tm.spaceUsed (M₂.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s₂ x.length) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
        (fun n => c * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t
          ≤ sD x.length + max (s₁ x.length) (s₂ x.length) + c

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_loopTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem exists_loopTM_spaceUsed (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T S : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = [true]
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s)))
    (hFspace : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      F.tm.spaceUsed (F.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S x.length)
    (hstartSpace : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), t ≤ T x.length →
      body.tm.spaceUsed (body.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S x.length)
    (hroundSpace : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∀ t ≤ T x.length,
        body.tm.spaceUsed
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t
            ≤ S x.length) :
    ∃ (E : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      E.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any
          fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))])
        (fun n => c * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        E.tm.spaceUsed (E.tm.initCfg x) t
          ≤ c * (S x.length + T x.length + 1)

theorem step_of_tapeAction_move {Symbol State : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (i : Fin k)
    (inp m : SignType) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (htr : M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp none m q') :
    M.step c =
      { c with
        state := some q'
        inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp

    (inp : SignType) (s : Option Symbol) (m : SignType) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (htr : M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp (some s) m q') :
    M.step c =
      { c with
        state := some q'
        inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp
        workTapes := Function.update c.workTapes i
          (Function.update (c.workTapes i) (c.workTapePos i) s)
        workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + m) }

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.compareTM_run_stop_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem compareTM_run_stop_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {k : ℕ}
    {x : List Symbol} (fst snd : Fin k) (hne : fst ≠ snd) (u v : List Symbol)
    (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run)
    (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p)
    (hv : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (v.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) :
    (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d (2 * compareStop u v + 2) =
        { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))) } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * compareStop u v + 2, ∀ b,
        ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * compareStop u v + 2 →
        if j = fst ∨ j = snd then
          ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (compareStop u v : ℤ))
        else ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.compareTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem compareTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol}
    (fst snd : Fin k) (hne : fst ≠ snd) (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run)
    (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (u.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p)
    (hv : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (v.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) :
    ∃ δ ≤ min u.length v.length,
      (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d (2 * δ + 2) =
          { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))) } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * δ + 2, ∀ b,
          ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (FlagPhase.done b)) ∧
        (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * δ + 2 →
          if j = fst ∨ j = snd then
            ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
              Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (δ : ℤ))
          else ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

private theorem catalog_pass_contract {k : ℕ} {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} {S : Type*}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (F : ℕ → Cfg k Symbol S x) (D : Cfg k Symbol S x) (L : ℕ)
    (hF : ∀ r < L, M.step (F r) = F (r + 1)) (hexit : M.step (F L) = D) (hD : M.step D = D)
    (P Q : Cfg k Symbol S x → Prop) (hP : ∀ r ≤ L, P (F r)) (hQ : ∀ r ≤ L, Q (F r))
    (hQD : Q D) :
    M.runFrom (F 0) (L + 1) = D ∧ (∀ t < L + 1, P (M.runFrom (F 0) t)) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ L + 1, Q (M.runFrom (F 0) t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.walkTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem walkTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (src : Fin k)
    (moved : Fin k → Prop) [DecidablePred moved] (hsrc : moved src) (dir : SignType)
    (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ w.length →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + (dir : ℤ) * p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d (w.length + 1) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapePos := fun j =>
            d.workTapePos j + if moved j then (dir : ℤ) * ((w.length + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) else 0 } ∧
      (∀ t < w.length + 1, ((walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ w.length + 1 →
        ((walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d t).workTapePos j =
          d.workTapePos j + if moved j then (dir : ℤ) * (t : ℤ) else 0)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.name: Turing.skipTM_run_ofCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Ca.header:
theorem skipTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (skipTM k i).runFrom d (w.length + 1) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i
            (d.workTapePos i + w.length + 1) } ∧
      (∀ t < w.length + 1, ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ w.length + 1 →
        if j = i then
          ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + w.length + 1)
        else ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

theorem seekEndTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (ws : List (List Symbol)) (hne : ws ≠ []) (hws : ∀ u ∈ ws, u ≠ [])
