    (prependTM w).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => w ++ x) (fun n => w.length + n + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private def scanCfg {S : Type} (x : List Bool) (q : Option S)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) : Cfg 0 Bool S x

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanCfg_read
Turing.FinTM.scanCopy_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma scanCopy_run {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = match inp with
      | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some q⟩
      | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩)
    (x out : List Bool) : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ x.length),
    tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some q) 0 (by omega) out) j =
      scanCfg x (some q) j hj (out ++ x.take j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanCopy_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma scanCopy_finish {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = match inp with
      | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some q⟩
      | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩)
    (x out : List Bool) :
    tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some q) 0 (by omega) out) (x.length + 1) =
      scanCfg x none x.length (by omega) (out ++ x)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanCopy_suffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma scanCopy_suffix {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = match inp with
      | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some q⟩
      | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩)
    (x rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some q) pre.length (by simp [hx]) out) (rest.length + 1) =
      scanCfg x none x.length (by omega) (out ++ rest)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanTrues_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma scanTrues_run {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (emit : Bool)
    (htr : ∀ work, tm.tr q (some true) work =
      ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, if emit then some false else none, some q⟩)
    (x : List Bool) : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ x.length),
    x.take j = List.replicate j true →
    tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some q) 0 (by omega) []) j =
      scanCfg x (some q) j hj (if emit then List.replicate j false else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.incFixed_cases
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma incFixed_cases (x : List Bool) :
    (x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ incFixed x = none) ∨
      ∃ j rest, x = List.replicate j true ++ false :: rest ∧
        incFixed x = some (List.replicate j false ++ true :: rest)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.incFixedTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header: def incFixedTM : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.incFixedTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem incFixedTM_spaceUsed (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    incFixedTM.tm.spaceUsed (incFixedTM.tm.initCfg x) t = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.incFixedTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem incFixedTM_computes (x : List Bool) :
    incFixedTM.ComputesInTime x ((incFixed x).getD []) (3 * (x.length + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanStep_right
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma scanStep_right {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S)
    (x : List Bool) (q : S) (q' : Option S) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length)
    (out : List Bool) (emit : Option Bool)
    (htr : ∀ work, tm.tr q x[i]? work = ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, emit, q'⟩) :
    tm.step (scanCfg x (some q) i (by omega) out) =
      scanCfg x q' (i + 1) (by omega) (out ++ emit.toList)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairValidTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header: def pairValidTM : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairValidTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairValidTM_spaceUsed (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    pairValidTM.tm.spaceUsed (pairValidTM.tm.initCfg x) t = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairValid_block
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma pairValid_block (x pre rest : List Bool) (b c : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: c :: rest) :
    pairValidTM.tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some none) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) 2 =
      if b = c then scanCfg x (some none) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) []
      else scanCfg x none (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) [!b && c]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairValid_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma pairValid_run (x rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1,
      (pairValidTM.tm.runFrom
        (scanCfg x (some none) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) t).state = none ∧
      (pairValidTM.tm.runFrom
        (scanCfg x (some none) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) t).output =
          [(pairDecode rest).isSome]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairValidTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairValidTM_computes (x : List Bool) :
    pairValidTM.ComputesInTime x [(pairDecode x).isSome] (x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header: def pairExtractTM (first second : Bool) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extractCfg
Turing.FinTM.extractCfg_read
Turing.FinTM.extract_first
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_first (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.step
      (extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) =
      extractCfg x (some (.inl (some b))) (pre.length + 1) (by simp [hx]) a a.length []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_block
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_block (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b c : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: c :: rest) :
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) 2 =
      if b = c then extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx])
          (a ++ [b]) (a ++ [b]).length []
      else if b then extractCfg x none (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) a a.length []
      else extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_rewind (first second : Bool) (x a : List Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : ∀ j, j ≤ a.length →
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) i hi a ((j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) =
      extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferReplay_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma bufferReplay_run {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool S) (q : S) (emit : Bool)
    (htr : ∀ (inp : Option Bool) (bit : Bool), tm.tr q inp (fun _ => some bit) =
      ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), if emit then some bit else none, some q⟩)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a : List Bool) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ a.length),
    tm.runFrom (⟨some q, p, fun _ => bufferTape a, fun _ => 0, []⟩ : Cfg 1 Bool S x) j =
      (⟨some q, p, fun _ => bufferTape a, fun _ => (j : ℤ),
        if emit then a.take j else []⟩ : Cfg 1 Bool S x)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_replay
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_replay (first second : Bool) (x a : List Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ a.length),
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a 0 []) j =
      extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a j (if first then a.take j else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_replay_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_replay_finish (first second : Bool) (x a : List Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a 0 []) (a.length + 1) =
      extractCfg x (some (.inr 2)) i hi a a.length (if first then a else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_suffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_suffix (first : Bool) (x rest a : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    (pairExtractTM first true).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inr 2)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length out)
        (rest.length + 1) =
      extractCfg x none x.length (by omega) a a.length (out ++ rest)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_finish (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ rest) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * a.length + rest.length + 3,
      ((pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []) t).state = none ∧
      ((pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []) t).output =
          (if first then a else []) ++ (if second then rest else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_run (first second : Bool) (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre a (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    ∃ t ≤ 3 * rest.length + 2 * a.length + 5,
      ((pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) t).state = none ∧
      ((pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) t).output =
          match pairDecode rest with
          | some (b, c) => (if first then a ++ b else []) ++ (if second then c else [])
          | none => []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairExtractTM_computes (first second : Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (pairExtractTM first second).ComputesInTime x
      (match pairDecode x with
        | some (a, b) => (if first then a else []) ++ (if second then b else [])
        | none => []) (5 * (x.length + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_fst
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairExtractTM_fst :
    (pairExtractTM true false).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => ((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_snd
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairExtractTM_snd :
    (pairExtractTM false true).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => ((pairDecode x).map Prod.snd).getD []) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_concat
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairExtractTM_concat :
    (pairExtractTM true true).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun z => match pairDecode z with
        | some (a, b) => a ++ b
        | none => []) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extractCfg_congr
Turing.FinTM.extract_scan
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_scan (first second : Bool) (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ (w pre a : List Bool) (hx : x = pre ++ dbl w ++ rest),
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) (2 * w.length) =
      extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) (pre.length + 2 * w.length)
        (by simp [hx]) (a ++ w) (a ++ w).length []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_fst_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairExtractTM_fst_run (a b : List Bool) :
    (pairExtractTM true false).tm.runFrom
        ((pairExtractTM true false).tm.initCfg (pairEncode a b)) (4 * a.length + 5) =
      ⟨none, ⟨2 * a.length + 3, by simp [length_pairEncode]; omega⟩,
        fun _ => bufferTape a, fun _ => (a.length : ℤ), a⟩ ∧
    ∀ u < 4 * a.length + 5, ((pairExtractTM true false).tm.runFrom
        ((pairExtractTM true false).tm.initCfg (pairEncode a b)) u).state ≠ none

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_fst_run_budget
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairExtractTM_fst_run_budget (a b : List Bool) :
    let M := pairExtractTM true false
    let d := M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg (pairEncode a b)) (5 * ((pairEncode a b).length + 1))
    d.state = none ∧ d.output = a ∧ d.inputPos.val = 2 * a.length + 3 ∧
      ∀ j : Fin M.k, d.workTapes j = bufferTape a ∧ d.workTapePos j = (a.length : ℤ)

Turing.FinTM.catalogPolyMove_apply
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPolyMove_apply {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (s s' : CatalogPolyControl c C) (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (o : List Bool)
    (i : Fin (c + 1)) (d : SignType) :
    (catalogPolyMove i d s').apply (catalogPolyCfg x q s h o) =
      catalogPolyCfg x q s' (Function.update h i (h i + d.cast)) o

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_emit
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_emit {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ C) (o : List Bool),
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (catalogPolyCfg x q (.emit ⟨j, by omega⟩) h o) (j + 1) =
      catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance 0) h (o ++ List.replicate j true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_rewind {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (o : List Bool) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ q),
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (catalogPolyCfg x q (.rewind i) (Function.update h i ((j : ℤ) - 1)) o) (j + 1) =
      catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩) (Function.update h i 0) o

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_advance
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_advance {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (o : List Bool) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.step
      (catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) h o) =
      catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop i) (Function.update h i (h i + 1)) o

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPolyCost
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header: private def catalogPolyCost (q C : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_loop
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_loop {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) (_hq : 0 < q) :
    ∀ i (hi : i < c + 1) (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ)
      (_hh : ∀ k, k.val ≤ i → h k = 0) (o : List Bool) (r j : ℕ), j + r = q →
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop ⟨i, hi⟩) (Function.update h ⟨i, hi⟩ (j : ℤ)) o)
      (r * (catalogPolyCost q C i + 2) + q + 2) =
      catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩) h
        (o ++ List.replicate (r * (C * q ^ i)) true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPolyTape_write
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPolyTape_write (q : ℕ) :
    Function.update (catalogPolyTape q) (q : ℤ) (some true) = catalogPolyTape (q + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPolyCost_le
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPolyCost_le (q C : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) : ∀ r,
    catalogPolyCost q C r ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * r) * q ^ r

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_copy
Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_setup
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_setup (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ q),
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (catalogPolyCfg x q .setup (fun _ => (j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) =
      catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop (Fin.last c)) (fun _ => 0) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_start (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) :
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom ((catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.initCfg x)
      (2 * (x.length + 1)) =
      catalogPolyCfg x (x.length + 1) (.loop (Fin.last c)) (fun _ => 0) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_unary_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_unary_computes (c C : ℕ) :
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ (c + 1)) true)
      (fun n => (C + 5 * (c + 1) + 4) * (n + 1) ^ (c + 1))

Turing.FinTM.lenAction_apply
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma lenAction_apply (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (q q' : Option (pairCountTM M).State)
    (i j r s : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (hj : j ≤ x.length)
    (m d : SignType) (b : Option Bool)
    (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) m = ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩)
    (hd : (r : ℤ) - 1 + d.cast = (s : ℤ) - 1) :
    (lenAction M m d b q').apply (lenCfg M c q i hi r) =
      {lenCfg M c q' j hj s with output := b.toList}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.lenSuffix_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma lenSuffix_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest) r, r ≤ c.output.length →
    ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1,
      ((pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).state = none ∧
      ((pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).output =
          [decide (rest.length ≤ r)]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.lenParse_first
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma lenParse_first (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (pre rest : List Bool) (b : Bool) (r : ℕ)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    (pairCountTM M).tm.step
      (lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) =
      lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr (some b)))) (pre.length + 1) (by simp [hx]) r

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.lenParse_block
Turing.FinTM.lenParse_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma lenParse_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest) r, r ≤ c.output.length →
    ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1,
      ((pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).state = none ∧
      ((pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).output =
          [match pairDecode rest with
            | some (_, b) => decide (b.length ≤ r)
            | none => false]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.lenStart
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma lenStart (M : FinTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w T) :
    ∃ t ≤ T + x.length + 4, ∃ c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x,
      c.output = w ∧
      (pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom ((pairCountTM M).tm.initCfg x) t =
        lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) 0 (by omega) c.output.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairCount_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma pairCount_computes {M : FinTM Bool} {g : List Bool → List Bool}
    {T : ℕ → ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime g T) :
    (pairCountTM M).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => [match pairDecode x with
        | some (_, b) => decide (b.length ≤ (g x).length)
        | none => false]) (fun n => T n + 2 * n + 5)

Turing.FinTM.rawStrip_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma rawStrip_rewind (x a : List Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : ∀ j, j ≤ a.length →
    rawStripTM.tm.runFrom
      (stripCfg x (some 2) i hi a ((j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) =
      stripCfg x (some 3) i hi a 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.rawStrip_replay
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma rawStrip_replay (x a : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :

    rawStripTM.tm.runFrom (stripCfg x (some 3) i hi a 0 []) j =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.rawStrip_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma rawStrip_finish (x a : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :
    (rawStripTM.tm.runFrom (stripCfg x (some 2) i hi a (a.length - 1) [])
      (2 * (a.length + 1))).state = none ∧
    (rawStripTM.tm.runFrom (stripCfg x (some 2) i hi a (a.length - 1) [])
      (2 * (a.length + 1))).output = a

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.rawStrip_erase
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma rawStrip_erase (x w : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (b : Bool) :
    rawStripTM.tm.step
      (stripCfg x (some 1) i hi (w ++ [b]) ((w ++ [b]).length - 1) []) =
      stripCfg x (some (if b then 2 else 1)) i hi w (w.length - 1) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.rawStrip_trim
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma rawStrip_trim (x w : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :
    ∃ t ≤ 3 * (w.length + 1),
      (rawStripTM.tm.runFrom (stripCfg x (some 1) i hi w (w.length - 1) []) t).state = none ∧
      (rawStripTM.tm.runFrom (stripCfg x (some 1) i hi w (w.length - 1) []) t).output =
        (splitAtLastTrue w).getD []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.rawStrip_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma rawStrip_computes : rawStripTM.ComputesFunInTime
    (fun x => (splitAtLastTrue x).getD []) (fun n => 4 * (n + 1))

private lemma anyTrue_run (x rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest),

      (anyTrueTM.tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some ()) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) t).state = none ∧

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogMarker_cases
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogMarker_cases (v : List Bool) :
    (v.any id = false ∧ splitAtLastTrue v = none) ∨
      ∃ u, v.any id = true ∧ splitAtLastTrue v = some u ∧
        ∀ pre, splitAtLastTrue (pre ++ v) = some (pre ++ u)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_move (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (q q' : Option (FwdMapState M.State)) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (a b : List Bool) (ha hb : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (mi ma mb : SignType) (emit : Option Bool) :
    (fwdMapAct M mi (none, ma) (none, mb) emit q').apply
      (fwdMapCfg M x q p a b ha hb out) =
      fwdMapCfg M x q' (moveInputPos p mi) a b (ha + ma.cast) (hb + mb.cast)
        (out ++ emit.toList)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_first
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_first (M : FinTM Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.step
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] a.length 0 []) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse (some b))) ⟨pre.length + 2, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] a.length 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_block
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_block (M : FinTM Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b c : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: c :: rest) :
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] a.length 0 []) 2 =
      if b = c then fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none))
        ⟨pre.length + 3, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩ (a ++ [b]) [] (a ++ [b]).length 0 []
      else if b then fwdMapCfg M x none
        ⟨pre.length + 3, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩ a [] a.length 0 []
      else fwdMapCfg M x (some .copyB)
        ⟨pre.length + 3, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩ a [] (a.length - 1) 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_suffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_suffix (M : FinTM Bool) (x rest a : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre b (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some .copyB) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a b (a.length - 1) b.length []) (rest.length + 1) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some .backB) ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩
        a (b ++ rest) (a.length - 1) ((b ++ rest).length - 1) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_back
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_back (second : Bool) (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (other : ℤ) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ (if second then b else a).length →
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some (if second then .backB else .backA)) p a b
        (if second then other else (j : ℤ) - 1)
        (if second then (j : ℤ) - 1 else other) []) (j + 1) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some (if second then .backA else .emitA)) p a b
        (if second then other else 0) (if second then 0 else other) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_backB
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_backB (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ j, j ≤ b.length →
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some .backB) p a b (a.length - 1) ((j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some .backA) p a b (a.length - 1) 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_backA
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_backA (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ j, j ≤ a.length →
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some .backA) p a b ((j : ℤ) - 1) 0 []) (j + 1) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some .emitA) p a b 0 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_emit
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_emit (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b rest : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ pre out, a = pre ++ rest →
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some .emitA) p a b pre.length 0 out) (2 * rest.length + 2) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some (.run M.tm.q₀ true)) p a b a.length 0
        (out ++ rest.flatMap (fun d => [d, d]) ++ [false, true])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_finish (M : FinTM Bool) (x pre a b : List Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b) :
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some .copyB) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] (a.length - 1) 0 []) (3 * a.length + 2 * b.length + 5) =
      fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_parse
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_parse (M : FinTM Bool) (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre a (hx : x = pre ++ rest), ∃ t ≤ 3 * rest.length + 3 * a.length + 5,
      match pairDecode rest with
      | some (d, b) => (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
          (fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
            a [] a.length 0 []) t =
          fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩
            (a ++ d) (pairEncode (a ++ d) [])
      | none =>
          ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
            (fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
              a [] a.length 0 []) t).state = none ∧
          ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
            (fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
              a [] a.length 0 []) t).output = []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_setup
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_setup (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    ∃ t ≤ 5 * (x.length + 1),
      match pairDecode x with
      | some (a, b) => (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t =
          fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a [])
      | none => ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t).state = none ∧
          ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t).output = []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMapVirtual_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMapVirtual_step (M : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y) (tag : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos tag)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a pre : List Bool) :
    ∃ tag', VirtualTag (M.tm.step c).inputPos tag' ∧
      (fwdMapTM M true).tm.step (fwdMapVirtual M c tag p a pre) =
        fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.step c) tag' p a pre

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMapVirtual_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMapVirtual_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y) (tag : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos tag)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ tag', VirtualTag (M.tm.runFrom c t).inputPos tag' ∧
      (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom (fwdMapVirtual M c tag p a pre) t =
        fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.runFrom c t) tag' p a pre

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMapEntered
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:

Turing.FinTM.fwdMapSetup_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMapSetup_step (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}

    (h : ¬fwdMapEntered M c) :
    (fwdMapTM M true).tm.step c = (fwdMapTM M false).tm.step c

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMapSetup_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMapSetup_run (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ u < t, ¬fwdMapEntered M
      ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) u)) :
    (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) t =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMapSetup_head_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMapSetup_head_step (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMapSetup_heads
Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_launch
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_launch (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b : List Bool)
    (hd : pairDecode x = some (a, b)) :
    ∃ u ≤ 5 * (x.length + 1),
      (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u =
        fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a []) ∧
      ∀ v ≤ u, (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) v =
        (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) v

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_reject
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_reject (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (hd : pairDecode x = none) :
    ∃ u ≤ 5 * (x.length + 1),
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).state = none ∧
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).output = [] ∧
      ∀ v, (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) v =
        (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) v

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_space
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_space (M : FinTM Bool) (x y : List Bool) (t D S : ℕ)
    (hfirst : ∀ u ≤ t, -(D : ℤ) ≤
        ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.castAdd (1 + M.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ∧
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.castAdd (1 + M.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ≤ D)
    (hsecond : ∀ u ≤ t, -(D : ℤ) ≤
        ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd M.k (0 : Fin 1))) ∧
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd M.k (0 : Fin 1))) ≤ D)
    (hsource : ∀ i, (fwdMapTM M true).tm.visitedByTapeHead ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) t
        (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) ⊆ M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg y) t i)
    (hs : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg y) t ≤ S) :
    (fwdMapTM M true).tm.spaceUsed ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S + 2 * (2 * D + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairMapSndTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairMapSndTM_computes {Mg : FinTM Bool} {g : List Bool → List Bool} {Tg : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hg : Mg.ComputesFunInTime g Tg) (hTg : Monotone Tg) :
    (pairMapSndTM Mg).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun z => match pairDecode z with
        | some (a, b) => pairEncode a (g b)
        | none => [])
      (fun n => 22 * (n + 1 + Tg n))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed {Mg : FinTM Bool} (Sg : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hgs : ∀ (y : List Bool) (t : ℕ), Mg.tm.spaceUsed (Mg.tm.initCfg y) t ≤ Sg y.length)
    (hSg : Monotone Sg) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (pairMapSndTM Mg).tm.spaceUsed ((pairMapSndTM Mg).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      Sg x.length + 22 * (x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd {Mg : FinTM Bool}
    {g : List Bool → List Bool} {Tg : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hg : Mg.ComputesFunInTime g Tg) (hTg : Monotone Tg) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun z => match pairDecode z with
          | some (a, b) => pairEncode a (g b)
          | none => [])
        fun n => c * (n + 1 + Tg n)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairLenCheckTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairLenCheckTM_computes (C e : ℕ) :
    (pairLenCheckTM C e).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => [match pairDecode x with
        | some (a, b) => decide (b.length ≤ C * (a.length + 1) ^ e)
        | none => false])
      (fun n => (C + 5 * e + 17) * ((n + 1) ^ e + n + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => [match pairDecode x with
          | some (a, b) => decide (b.length ≤ C * (a.length + 1) ^ e)
          | none => false])
        fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)

theorem stripLastTM_computes :
    stripLastTM.ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => match pairDecode x with
        | some (a, v) =>
          match splitAtLastTrue v with
          | some u => pairEncode a u
          | none => []
        | none => [])
      (fun n => 150 * (n + 1))

    (emb : S → H) (anchor : H) (stop : S → Prop) [DecidablePred stop]

    (hfix : ∀ c : Cfg k Bool S w, (∃ q, c.state = some q ∧ stop q) → tm.step c = c)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSafe_one
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:

    (h1 : tm.runFrom c u = d) (hs1 : splitSafe tm anchor c u)
    (h2 : tm.runFrom d v = f) (hs2 : splitSafe tm anchor d v) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitBody_round
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitBody_round (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (w s out : List Bool)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : M.tm.runFrom (splitBank M s (some start) []) T = splitBank M s none out) :
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T + 5 * s.length + 3 * w.length + 20 ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < j → j < t →
        ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) j).state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      if decide (s.length + out.length = w.length) then
        ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t).state = none ∧
        ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t).output =
            pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
      else (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t =
          Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) (splitStep w s))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSolve_of_body
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitSolve_of_body (C e : ℕ) (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (A : ℕ)
    (hstart : ∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ A * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1),
      (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k []))
    (hround : ∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ A * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
            ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if splitAccept C e w s then
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output =
            pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (splitStep w s))) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with

          | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private theorem split_hyps (C e : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (B : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hsource : ∀ s : List Bool, M.tm.runFrom (splitBank M s (some start) []) (B s.length) =
      splitBank M s none (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ e) true))
    (hbound : ∀ l, B l ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * e) * (l + 1) ^ e + 1) :
    (∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1),
      (∀ t' < t, ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.initCfg w)
        t').state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.initCfg w) t =
        Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k [])) ∧
    (∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t').state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
        if splitAccept C e w s then
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t).state = none ∧
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t).output =
              pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k (splitStep w s)))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterSplit_of_body (f TE : ℕ → ℕ) (body : FinTM Bool)
    (anchor : body.State) (A : ℕ)
    (hstart : ∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ A * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2),
      (∀ j < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) j).state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k []))
    (hround : ∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ A * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) ∧
        (∀ j, 0 < j → j < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) j).state
            ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if emitterSplitAccept f w s then
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output =
            pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (splitStep w s))) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplitWith f w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => [])
        (fun n => c * (n + 1) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_phase {k l : ℕ} {S H : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (src : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM l Bool H)
    (index : Fin k ↪ Fin l) (emb : S ↪ H) (anchor : H)
    (haway : ∀ q, emb q ≠ anchor) (good : S → Prop)
    (hagree : ∀ q, good q → ∀ inp work,
      host.tr (emb q) inp work = ((embedEmitTM index src).tr q inp work).mapState emb)
    (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ)
    (c d : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ)
    (hguard : ∀ j < t, ∀ q, (src.runFrom c j).state = some q → good q)
    (hr : src.runFrom c t = d) :
    host.runFrom ((embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] c).mapState emb) t =
        (embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] d).mapState emb ∧
      splitSafe host anchor ((embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] c).mapState emb) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_call_phase

    (src : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM l Bool H)
    (index : Fin k ↪ Fin l) (emb : S ↪ H)
    (enter anchor : H) (henter : enter ≠ anchor) (haway : ∀ q, emb q ≠ anchor)
    (entry exit : S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, host.tr enter inp work =
      ((embedEmitTM index src).tr entry inp work).mapState emb)
    (hagree : ∀ q, q ≠ exit → ∀ inp work,
      host.tr (emb q) inp work = ((embedEmitTM index src).tr q inp work).mapState emb)
    (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ)
    (c d : Cfg k Bool S x) (hc : c.state = some entry) (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hguard : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < t → (src.runFrom c j).state ≠ some exit)
    (hr : src.runFrom c t = d) :
    let z := {(embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] c).mapState emb with state := some enter}
    host.runFrom z t = (embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] d).mapState emb ∧
      splitSafe host anchor z t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_frame
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_frame {k l : ℕ} {S H : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (q : S) (index : Fin k ↪ Fin l) (emb : S → H)
    (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (d : Cfg l Bool H x)
    (hs : c.state.map emb = d.state) (hi : c.inputPos = d.inputPos)
    (ho : c.output = d.output)
    (selected : ∀ i, c.workTapes i = d.workTapes (index i) ∧
      c.workTapePos i = d.workTapePos (index i))
    (frame : ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range index → tapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ heads j = d.workTapePos j) :
    (embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] c).mapState emb = d

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_bank_frame
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_bank_frame {S H : Type} (right : Bool) (k l : ℕ)
    (emb : S → H) (w s u v : List Bool) (q : S) :
    let index : Fin (if right then l else k) ↪ Fin (k + l + 1) :=
      match right with
      | false => emitterP2LeftIndex k l
      | true => emitterP2RightIndex k l
    (embedEmitCfg index
      (fun i => bufferTape (emitterP2Words k l s
        (if right then u else []) (if right then [] else v) i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) q
        (stateWord (if right then l else k) (if right then v else u)))).mapState emb =
          Cfg.ofWords (emb q) (emitterP2Words k l s u v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_left_frame
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_left_frame {S H : Type} (k l : ℕ) (emb : S → H)
    (w s u v : List Bool) (q : S) :
    (embedEmitCfg (emitterP2LeftIndex k l)
      (fun i => bufferTape (emitterP2Words k l s [] v i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) q (stateWord k u))).mapState emb =
        Cfg.ofWords (emb q) (emitterP2Words k l s u v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_right_frame {S H : Type} (k l : ℕ) (emb : S → H)
    (w s u v : List Bool) (q : S) :
    (embedEmitCfg (emitterP2RightIndex k l)
      (fun i => bufferTape (emitterP2Words k l s u [] i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) q (stateWord l v))).mapState emb =
        Cfg.ofWords (emb q) (emitterP2Words k l s u v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_one_frame
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_one_frame {l : ℕ} {S H : Type} (slot : Fin l) (emb : S → H)
    (words : Fin l → List Bool) (w u : List Bool) (q : S) :
    (embedEmitCfg (emitterP2OneIndex slot) (fun i => bufferTape (words i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) q (fun _ : Fin 1 => u))).mapState emb =
        Cfg.ofWords (emb q) (Function.update words slot u)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_index_injective
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_index_injective (candidate : Bool) (k l : ℕ)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hl : 0 < l) :
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin (if candidate then 3 else 2) =>
      if i.val = 0 then
        if candidate then (0 : Fin (k + l + 1)) else emitterP2LeftIndex k l ⟨0, hk⟩
      else if candidate then
        if i.val = 1 then emitterP2LeftIndex k l ⟨0, hk⟩
        else emitterP2RightIndex k l ⟨0, hl⟩
      else emitterP2RightIndex k l ⟨0, hl⟩)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_admin_frame
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_admin_frame {S H : Type} (candidate : Bool) (k l : ℕ)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hl : 0 < l)
    (index : Fin (if candidate then 3 else 2) ↪ Fin (k + l + 1))
    (hindex : ∀ i, index i =
      if i.val = 0 then
        if candidate then 0 else emitterP2LeftIndex k l ⟨0, hk⟩
      else if candidate then
        if i.val = 1 then emitterP2LeftIndex k l ⟨0, hk⟩
        else emitterP2RightIndex k l ⟨0, hl⟩
      else emitterP2RightIndex k l ⟨0, hl⟩)
    (emb : S → H) (w s u v : List Bool) (q : S) :
    (embedEmitCfg index
      (if candidate then fun _ _ => none
        else fun i => bufferTape (emitterP2Words k l s [] [] i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) q (fun i =>
        if candidate then if i.val = 0 then s else if i.val = 1 then u else v
        else if i.val = 0 then u else v))).mapState emb =
          Cfg.ofWords (emb q) (emitterP2Words k l s u v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_small_frame
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_small_frame {H : Type} (k l : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hl : 0 < l)
    (emb : Fin 9 × Bool → H) (w s u v : List Bool) (q : Fin 9) (over : Bool) :
    (embedEmitCfg (emitterP2SmallIndex k l hk hl) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
      (emitterP2PrepareCfg w s u v q over 1 0 0)).mapState emb =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_pair_frame
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_pair_frame {H : Type} (k l : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hl : 0 < l)
    (emb : Fin 3 × Bool → H) (w s u v : List Bool) (q : Fin 3) (b : Bool) :
    (embedEmitCfg (emitterP2PairIndex k l hk hl) (fun i => bufferTape (emitterP2Words k l s [] [] i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (emitterCompareCfg w u v 1 q b 0)).mapState emb =
        Cfg.ofWords (emb (q, b)) (emitterP2Words k l s u v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_start (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w : List Bool) :
    (emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx).tm.initCfg w =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_control
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_control {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (q r : S) (h : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = controlAction 0 (some r))
    (w : List Bool) (words : Fin k → List Bool) :
    tm.step (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) q words) = Cfg.ofWords r words

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_prepare
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_prepare (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s : List Bool) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    ∃ t ≤ 5 * (s.length + w.length + 3),
      B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.prepare (0, false))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] [])) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.prepare (8, decide (w.length < s.length)))
          (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s s (w.drop s.length)) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.prepare (0, false))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] [])) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_width
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_width (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hf : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < t → (C.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) j).state ≠ some cx)
    (hr : C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) t =
      Cfg.ofWords cx (stateWord C.k u)) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .widthStart (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s s v)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.width cx) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .widthStart (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s s v)) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_length
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_length (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v z : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hf : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < t → (D.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k v)) j).state ≠ some dx)
    (hr : D.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k v)) t =
      Cfg.ofWords dx (stateWord D.k z)) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .lengthStart (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.length dx) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u z) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .lengthStart (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_compare
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_compare (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * (max u.length v.length + 1),
      B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.compare (0, true))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.compare (2, decide (u = v))) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.compare (0, true))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_erase
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_erase (right : Bool) (C D : FinTM Bool)
    (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool) (ok : Bool) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let tag : Fin 3 → EmitterP2State C.State D.State :=
      if right then .eraseRight ok else .eraseLeft ok
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * ((if right then v else u).length + 1),
      B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (tag 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (tag 2) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s
          (if right then u else []) (if right then [] else v)) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (tag 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_erase_left
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_erase_left (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool) (ok : Bool) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * (u.length + 1),
      B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.eraseLeft ok 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.eraseLeft ok 2) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] v) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.eraseLeft ok 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_erase_right
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_erase_right (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool) (ok : Bool) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * (v.length + 1),
      B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.eraseRight ok 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.eraseRight ok 2) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u []) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.eraseRight ok 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_advance_initial
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_advance
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_advance (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s : List Bool) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * s.length + w.length + 5,
      B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.advance (0, false))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] [])) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.advance (4, false)) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k (splitStep w s) [] []) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.advance (0, false))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] [])) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_emit_initial
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_emit_initial (w s : List Bool) :
    splitEmitCfg 0 w s (some 0) 0 0 [] = Cfg.ofWords 0 (fun _ : Fin 1 => s)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_emit
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_emit (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s : List Bool) (hs : s.length ≤ w.length) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.emit 0) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] [])
    (B.tm.runFrom z (s.length + w.length + 3)).state = none ∧
      (B.tm.runFrom z (s.length + w.length + 3)).output =
        pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor z (s.length + w.length + 3)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_after
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_after {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c : Cfg k Bool S w)
    (t : ℕ) (q r : S) (words : Fin k → List Bool)
    (hr : tm.runFrom c t = Cfg.ofWords q words) (hs : splitSafe tm anchor c t)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = controlAction 0 (some r))
    (hq : q ≠ anchor) (hnext : r ≠ anchor) :
    tm.runFrom c (t + 1) = Cfg.ofWords r words ∧ splitSafe tm anchor c (t + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_test
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_test (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hfC : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < a → (C.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) j).state ≠ some cx)
    (hrC : C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) a =
      Cfg.ofWords cx (stateWord C.k u))
    (hfD : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < b → (D.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) j).state ≠ some dx)
    (hrD : D.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) b =
      Cfg.ofWords dx (stateWord D.k v)) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.prepare (8, false))
      (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s s (w.drop s.length))
    ∃ t ≤ a + b + 2 * (max u.length v.length + 1) + 4,
      B.tm.runFrom z t = Cfg.ofWords (.eraseLeft (decide (u = v)) 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v) ∧ splitSafe B.tm .anchor z t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_finish (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool) (ok : Bool)
    (hok : ok = true → s.length ≤ w.length) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.eraseLeft ok 0) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * u.length + 2 * v.length + 2 * s.length + w.length + 12,
      (∀ j < t, (B.tm.runFrom z j).state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      if ok then
        (B.tm.runFrom z t).state = none ∧
          (B.tm.runFrom z t).output = pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
      else B.tm.runFrom z t = Cfg.ofWords .anchor
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k (splitStep w s) [] [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_strict_join
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_strict_join {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d : Cfg k Bool S w) (a b : ℕ)
    (hr : tm.runFrom c a = d) (hs : splitSafe tm anchor c a)
    (hf : ∀ j < b, (tm.runFrom d j).state ≠ some anchor) :
    ∀ j < a + b, (tm.runFrom c j).state ≠ some anchor

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_round
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_round (f : ℕ → ℕ) (C D : FinTM Bool)
    (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k) (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State)
    (w s : List Bool) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hfC : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < a → (C.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) j).state ≠ some cx)
    (hrC : C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) a =
      Cfg.ofWords cx (stateWord C.k (Nat.bits (f s.length))))
    (hfD : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < b → (D.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) j).state ≠ some dx)
    (hrD : D.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) b =
      Cfg.ofWords dx (stateWord D.k (Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length))) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧
      t ≤ a + b + 10 * (s.length + w.length + (Nat.bits (f s.length)).length +
        (Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length).length + 10) ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < j → j < t → (B.tm.runFrom z j).state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      if emitterSplitAccept f w s then
        (B.tm.runFrom z t).state = none ∧
          (B.tm.runFrom z t).output = pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
      else B.tm.runFrom z t = Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord B.k (splitStep w s))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_closed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_closed (f : ℕ → ℕ) (E : FinTM Bool) (TE : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hTE : Monotone TE) (hE : E.ComputesFunInTime (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime
      (fun w => match solveSplitWith f w.length with
        | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
        | none => [])
      (fun n => c * (n + 1) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSolveWithTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem splitSolveWithTM_computes (f : ℕ → ℕ) (E : FinTM Bool) (TE : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hTE : Monotone TE) (hE : E.ComputesFunInTime (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE) :
    (splitSolveWithTM E).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun w => match solveSplitWith f w.length with
        | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
        | none => [])
      (fun n => 20 * (591 + 26 * E.k) * (n + 1) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_splitSolveWith
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_splitSolveWith (f : ℕ → ℕ) (E : FinTM Bool)

    (hE : E.ComputesFunInTime (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE) :

      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplitWith f w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => [])
        fun n => c * (n + 1) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2)

private lemma emitterToken_double (x pre rest out : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    unaryTokenTM.tm.runFrom
      (scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) out) 2 =
      scanCfg x (some (if b then (0 : Fin 6) else 3)) (pre ++ [b]).length
        (by simp [hx]) (out ++ [b, b])

Turing.FinTM.emitterToken_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterToken_run (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
      unaryTokenTM.tm.runFrom
        (scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) out)
        (2 * (unaryTokenSplit rest).1.length + (unaryTokenSplit rest).2.length + 3) =
        scanCfg x none x.length (by omega)
          (out ++ pairEncode (unaryTokenSplit rest).1 (unaryTokenSplit rest).2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostEmitTM_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostEmitTM_step (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (c : Cfg m Bool S y)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_buffer
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_buffer (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (vhostEmitTM M).visitedByTapeHead (vhostCfg c b p pre) t (vhostBuffer m) =
      (Finset.range (t + 1)).image
        (fun u => ((M.runFrom c u).inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostCfg_buffer_head_mem
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostCfg_buffer_head_mem (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ((vhostEmitTM M).runFrom (vhostCfg c b p pre) t).workTapePos
        (vhostBuffer m) ∈ Finset.Icc (-1 : ℤ) (y.length : ℤ)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostEmitTM_spaceUsed_le
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostEmitTM_spaceUsed_le (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (vhostEmitTM M).spaceUsed (vhostCfg c b p pre) t ≤
      M.spaceUsed c t + (y.length + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostEmitTM_emitting_halt
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostEmitTM_emitting_halt (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (q : S) (bit : Bool)
    (hq : c.state = some q)
    (ha : (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).state = none)
    (ho : (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).output = some bit) :
    ((vhostEmitTM M).step (vhostCfg c b p pre)).state = none ∧
      ((vhostEmitTM M).step (vhostCfg c b p pre)).output =
        pre ++ c.output ++ [bit]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostSilent_layout
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
private theorem vhostSilent_layout (j : Fin ((1 + m) + 1)) :
    (j ∈ Set.range (Fin.castAddEmb 1 : Fin (1 + m) ↪ Fin ((1 + m) + 1)) ↔
      j.val < 1 + m) ∧
    (j ∉ Set.range (Fin.castAddEmb 1 : Fin (1 + m) ↪ Fin ((1 + m) + 1)) ↔
      j = vhostCap m)

    (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (capPre out₀ : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ b', FinTM.VirtualTag (M.runFrom c t).inputPos b' ∧
      (vhostSilentTM M).runFrom (vhostSilentCfg c b p capPre out₀) t =
        vhostSilentCfg (M.runFrom c t) b' p capPre out₀

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostSilentTM_spaceUsed_le
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostSilentTM_spaceUsed_le (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (capPre out₀ : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (vhostSilentTM M).spaceUsed (vhostSilentCfg c b p capPre out₀) t ≤
      M.spaceUsed c t + (y.length + 2) +
        ((capPre ++ (M.runFrom c t).output).length + 1)

    (host : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool H) (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool),
      host.tr (emb s) inp w =
        captureAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp fun i => w i.castSucc))
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S input) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) :
    host.runFrom (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t =

    {x w : List Bool} {t : ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w t)
    (hlast : w.getLast? ≠ some haltOn) :
    ∀ u : ℕ, ¬((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_runFrom
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
theorem redirectTM_runFrom (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).state =
        (match (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).state with
          | some s => some (.inl (s, (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output.getLast?))
          | none =>
            if (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output.getLast? = some haltOn then none
            else some (.inr ())) ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).output = []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header: def timedCondTM (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private def timedBranchCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}

Turing.FinTM.timed_capture
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_capture (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}

    (hlive : ∀ s < t, ¬(D.tm.runFrom c s).Halted) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) t =
      timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom c t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_control_init
Turing.FinTM.timed_branch_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_branch_run (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b) t =
      timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.runFrom c t) tapes heads b

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timedReadyCfg
Turing.FinTM.timed_read
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_read (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) (hs : c.state = none) (ho : c.output = [b]) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) 2 =
      timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_start (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    ∃ a ≤ 2 * T + 5, ∃ (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
      (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a =
        timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ (show Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x from by
          simpa only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x)) tapes heads b

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
theorem timedCondTM_computes {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool}
    {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
      (fun n => 5 * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timedHeads
Turing.FinTM.timed_control_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_control_heads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) :
    (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c).workTapePos =
      timedHeads D M₁ M₂ c.workTapePos (fun _ => 0) c.output.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_branch_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_branch_heads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) :
    (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b).workTapePos =
      timedHeads D M₁ M₂ heads c.workTapePos 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timedReadyCfg_workTapePos
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timedReadyCfg_workTapePos (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) :
    (timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b).workTapePos =
      timedHeads D M₁ M₂ c.workTapePos (fun _ => 0) 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timedReady_dispatch
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timedReady_dispatch (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) :
    let V : MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := by
      rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ b, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ b]
      exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm
    ({timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b with
        state := some (.inr (.inr (.inr V.q₀))), inputPos := 1} :
      Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x) =
      timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ (V.initCfg x) c.workTapes c.workTapePos b

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_read_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_read_heads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) (hs : c.state = none) (ho : c.output = [b]) :
    ∀ u ≤ 2, ∃ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 1 ∧
      ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) u).workTapePos =
        timedHeads D M₁ M₂ c.workTapePos (fun _ => 0) z

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_ledger
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_ledger (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    let V : MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := by
      rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ b, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ b]
      exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm
    ∀ u, ∃ v ≤ T, ∃ w ≤ u, ∃ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 1 ∧
      ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos =
        timedHeads D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos
          (V.runFrom (V.initCfg x) w).workTapePos z

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
theorem timedCondTM_spaceUsed (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T t : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.spaceUsed ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) T +
        (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t + 2

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_cond {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool}
    {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
        (fun n => c * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: def serializeK {k n : ℕ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) : List Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.serializeK_eq

theorem serializeK_eq {k n : ℕ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.fin_cons_two
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.tableBitsK_two
Turing.codeSkipTable2_eq_codeSkipTableK

lemma codeSkipTable2_eq_codeSkipTableK (n : ℕ) (xs : List Bool) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: def MachineFormat.toFinTM (F : MachineFormat) (M : F.Code) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private lemma oneTape_serialize_eq (M : CodeTM) : M.serialize = serializeK M.tm

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: def oneTapeMachineFormat : MachineFormat

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.skipRepeat_consumes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma skipRepeat_consumes (r : List Bool → Option (List Bool)) (b : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ xs ys, r xs = some ys → b + ys.length ≤ xs.length)
    (m : ℕ) (xs ys : List Bool) (h : codeSkipRepeat r m xs = some ys) :
    b * m + ys.length ≤ xs.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.skipSymbols_consumes

    (j : ℕ) (xs ys : List Bool)
    (h : ((fun f => codeSkipRepeat f 3)^[j] r) xs = some ys) :
    b * 3 ^ j + ys.length ≤ xs.length

Turing.MachineFormat.scan_grammar_guard
