TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardedScan_eq
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private lemma guardedScan_eq (α : List Bool) : guardedScan F α = F.scan α

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.decode_of_grammar_guard
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma decode_of_grammar_guard (α bits rest : List Bool)
    (hp : pairDecode α = some (bits, rest))
    (hg : rest.length < (4 * F.k + 5) * 3 ^ (F.k + 1) * (codeBitsNat bits + 1)) :
    F.decode α = F.fallback

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.grammar_guard_states
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma grammar_guard_states (n s : ℕ)
    (h : (4 * F.k + 5) * 3 ^ (F.k + 1) * (n + 1) ≤ s) : n + 1 ≤ s

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonHeader
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonHeader (α : List Bool) : List Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonHeader_length
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private lemma canonHeader_length (α : List Bool) : (canonHeader α).length ≤ α.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonHeaderCall
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonHeaderCall :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (α.length + 1), 0 < t ∧
        (∀ u, 0 < u → u < t →
          (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠
            some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (canonHeader α))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardPhase
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def guardPhase (b u : ℕ) : Option (Fin (b + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlockTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def guardBlockTM (b : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool (Option (Fin (b + 1)))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardCfg
Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_step (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (u j : ℕ)
    (hu : u < b + 1) (hj : j < x.length) (out : List Bool) :
    (guardBlockTM b).step (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b u) j (by omega) out) =
      guardCfg b x (guardPhase b (u + 1)) (j + 1) (by omega) out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_run (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) (u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ≤ b + 1) (hlen : j + u ≤ x.length) :
    (guardBlockTM b).runFrom (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out) u =
      guardCfg b x (guardPhase b u) (j + u) hlen out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_blank
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_blank (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (u : ℕ) (out : List Bool) :
    (guardBlockTM b).step
        (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b u) x.length le_rfl out) =
      guardCfg b x none x.length le_rfl out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_short
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_short (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (hshort : x.length - j < b + 1) (out : List Bool) :
    (guardBlockTM b).runFrom (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out)
        (x.length - j + 1) = guardCfg b x none x.length le_rfl out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardTime
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private def guardTime (b : ℕ) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg 0 Bool (Option (Fin (b + 1))) x) : ℕ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_interior
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_interior (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) (u : ℕ) (hu : 0 < u)
    (ht : u < guardTime b (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out)) :
    ∃ s, ((guardBlockTM b).runFrom
        (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out) u).state = some s ∧
      s ≠ guardPhase b 0 ∧ s ≠ none

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.binaryGuardTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private def binaryGuardTM (b : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (CounterLoopState (Option (Fin (b + 1))))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.binaryGuardStart
Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_orbit
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_orbit (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) (r : ℕ)
    (hr : j + (b + 1) * r ≤ x.length) :
    counterLoopOrbit (guardBlockTM b) (guardTime b)
        (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out) r =
      guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) (j + (b + 1) * r) hr out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_segment
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_segment (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) :
    let c := guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out
    c.state = some (guardPhase b 0) ∧ 0 < guardTime b c ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < guardTime b c →
        ∃ s, ((guardBlockTM b).runFrom c u).state = some s ∧
          s ≠ guardPhase b 0 ∧ s ≠ none)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.binaryGuard_done
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma binaryGuard_done (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out w : List Bool)
    (hfit : j + (b + 1) * Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) ≤ x.length) :
    ∃ T ≤ 5 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2,
      let c := (binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) T
      c.state = some .done ∧ c.output = out ∧
        c.inputPos.val = j + (b + 1) * Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) + 1 ∧
        (∀ u < T,
          ((binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) u).state ≠
            some .done ∧
          ((binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) u).state ≠
            some .escape)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.binaryGuard_escape
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma binaryGuard_escape (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out w : List Bool)
    (hshort : x.length < j + (b + 1) * Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)) :
    ∃ T ≤ (b + 5) * (x.length + 1) + 2 * w.length,
      let c := (binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) T
      c.state = some .escape ∧ c.output = out ∧ c.inputPos.val = x.length + 1 ∧
        (∀ u < T,
          ((binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) u).state ≠
            some .done ∧
          ((binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) u).state ≠
            some .escape)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBitsOK
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonBitsOK (w : List Bool) : Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBits_fold
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBits_fold (w : List Bool) (a : Bool) :
    w.foldl (fun _ b => b) a = w.getLast?.getD a

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBits_of_last
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBits_of_last (w : List Bool) :
    canonBitsOK w = true → (w.foldr Nat.bit 0).bits = w

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBits_bits
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private lemma canonBits_bits (n : ℕ) : canonBitsOK n.bits = true

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBitsOK_iff
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBitsOK_iff (w : List Bool) :
    canonBitsOK w = true ↔ w = (w.foldr Nat.bit 0).bits

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonCount
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonCount (w : List Bool) : List Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonCount_spec
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonCount_spec (w : List Bool) :
    incFixed (w ++ [false]) = some (canonCount w) ∧
      (canonCount w).length = w.length + 1 ∧
      (canonCount w).foldr Nat.bit 0 = w.foldr Nat.bit 0 + 1

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBitsTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonBitsTM (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (ScanPhase Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBitsTM_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBitsTM_run (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (α : List Bool)
    (w : Fin k → List Bool) :
    (canonBitsTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) (.fwd true) w)
        (2 * (w i).length + 2) = Cfg.ofWords (.done (canonBitsOK (w i))) w ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * (w i).length + 2, ∀ b,
        ((canonBitsTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) (.fwd true) w) t).state ≠
          some (.done b))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonHeaderSeam
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonHeaderSeam :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (α.length + 1), 0 < t ∧
        (∀ u < t,
          (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠
            some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (canonHeader α))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonCountTM
Turing.MachineFormat.canonVerdictTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonVerdictTM (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (ScanPhase Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonVerdictTM_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonVerdictTM_run (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (α : List Bool)
    (w : Fin k → List Bool) :
    let c := (canonVerdictTM k i).runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) (.fwd true) w) (2 * (w i).length + 3)
    c.state = none ∧ c.output = [canonBitsOK (w i)]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonHeaderBitsTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonHeaderBitsTM :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (a : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun α => [canonBitsOK (canonHeader α)])
        (fun n => a * (n + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonHeaderOK
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonHeaderOK (α : List Bool) : Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonHeaderOK_iff
Turing.MachineFormat.scan_eq_none_of_canonHeaderOK

private lemma scan_eq_none_of_canonHeaderOK (F : MachineFormat) (α : List Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonGuardBlock (F : MachineFormat) : ℕ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGuardBlock_pos
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private lemma canonGuardBlock_pos (F : MachineFormat) : 0 < canonGuardBlock F

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.decode_of_canonGuard
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma decode_of_canonGuard (F : MachineFormat) (α bits rest : List Bool)
    (hp : pairDecode α = some (bits, rest))
    (hg : rest.length < canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1)) :
    F.decode α = F.fallback

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGuard_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonGuard_run (F : MachineFormat) (α bits rest : List Bool)
    (hp : pairDecode α = some (bits, rest)) :
    let B := canonGuardBlock F
    let j := 2 * bits.length + 2
    ∃ hj : j ≤ α.length, ∃ T ≤ (B + 4) * (α.length + 1) + 2 * (bits.length + 1),
      let c := (binaryGuardTM (B - 1)).runFrom
        (binaryGuardStart (B - 1) α j hj [] (canonCount bits)) T
      c.state = some (if B * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length then .done else .escape) ∧
        c.output = [] ∧
        c.inputPos.val = (if B * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
          then j + B * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) + 1 else α.length + 1) ∧
        (∀ u < T,
          ((binaryGuardTM (B - 1)).runFrom
            (binaryGuardStart (B - 1) α j hj [] (canonCount bits)) u).state ≠ some .done ∧
          ((binaryGuardTM (B - 1)).runFrom
            (binaryGuardStart (B - 1) α j hj [] (canonCount bits)) u).state ≠ some .escape)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStrictInstall
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStrictInstall (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool)
    (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ x arg : List Bool,
        ∃ t ≤ a * (T arg.length + arg.length + (f arg).length + 1),
          0 < t ∧
          (∀ u < t, (C.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f arg))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonEmbedEq
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonEmbedEq {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S x) (d : Cfg k Bool S x)
    (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin k → ℤ)
    (hs : c.state = d.state) (hp : c.inputPos = d.inputPos) (ho : c.output = d.output)
    (selected : ∀ i, c.workTapes i = d.workTapes (ι i) ∧
      c.workTapePos i = d.workTapePos (ι i))
    (outside : ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range ι →
      tapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ heads j = d.workTapePos j) :
    embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads [] c = d

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonEmbedWords
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonEmbedWords {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (q : S)
    (v : Fin m → List Bool) (ambient wanted : Fin k → List Bool)
    (selected : ∀ i, wanted (ι i) = v i)
    (outside : ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range ι → ambient j = wanted j) :
    embedEmitCfg ι (fun j => FinTM.bufferTape (ambient j)) (fun _ => 0) []
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q v) = Cfg.ofWords q wanted

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonPreserveInstall
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonPreserveInstall (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool)
    (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (dst : Fin C.k) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ),
      dst.val = 1 ∧ ∀ x arg : List Bool,
        ∃ t ≤ a * (T arg.length + arg.length + (f arg).length + 1),
          (∀ u < t, (C.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords exit (Function.update (stateWord C.k arg) dst (f arg))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonHeaderCountSeam
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonHeaderCountSeam :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (dst : Fin C.k) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ),
      dst.val = 1 ∧ ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (α.length + 1),
        (∀ u < t, (C.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (Function.update (stateWord C.k (canonHeader α)) dst
            (canonCount (canonHeader α)))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonOffset
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonOffset (w : List Bool) : List Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonOffset_spec
Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonOffsetTM
Turing.MachineFormat.canonReadyWords
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonReadyWords (k : ℕ) (header : List Bool) : Fin k → List Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonReadySeam
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonReadySeam :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ), 4 ≤ C.k ∧
      ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (α.length + 1),
        (∀ u < t, (C.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (canonReadyWords C.k (canonHeader α))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonSeekOnBank
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonSeekOnBank {k : ℕ} (ι : Fin 2 ↪ Fin k) :
    ∃ (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S)
      (R : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (entry exit : S) (a : ℕ),
      ∀ {x : List Bool} (p : ℕ) (w : List Bool),
        Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = p → ∀ hp : p ≤ x.length + 1,
        ∀ d : Cfg k Bool S x, d.state = some entry →
        (∀ q : ℤ, -1 ≤ q → q ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
          d.workTapes (ι 0) (d.workTapePos (ι 0) + q) = FinTM.bufferTape w q) →
        (∀ q, d.workTapes (ι 1) q = none) →
        ∃ t ≤ a * (w.length + d.inputPos.val + p + 1),
          (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          R.runFrom d t = { d with state := some exit, inputPos := ⟨p, by omega⟩ }

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonGuardFront
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonGuardFront (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry yes no : C.State) (a : ℕ), 4 ≤ C.k ∧ yes ≠ no ∧
      ∀ α bits rest : List Bool, pairDecode α = some (bits, rest) →
        ∃ t ≤ a * (α.length + 1),
          let d := C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) t
          d.state = some (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
            then yes else no) ∧ d.output = [] ∧
          d.inputPos.val = (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
            then 2 * bits.length + 3 else α.length + 1) ∧
          ∀ i : Fin C.k, i.val ≠ 1 →
            d.workTapes i = FinTM.bufferTape (canonReadyWords C.k bits i) ∧
              d.workTapePos i = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBoolPopTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonBoolPopTM (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Option Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBoolPop_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBoolPop_run (k : ℕ) (positive : 0 < k) (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (canonBoolPopTM k ⟨0, positive⟩).runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) none (stateWord k [b])) 1 =
      Cfg.ofWords (some b) (fun _ => [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonBoolBranch
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonBoolBranch (M : FinTM Bool) (p : List Bool → Bool)
    (c : ℕ) (computes : M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) (fun n => c * (n + 1))) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry : C.State) (exit : Bool → C.State) (a : ℕ),
      0 < C.k ∧ Function.Injective exit ∧
      ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1),
        (∀ u < t, ∀ b, (C.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠ some (exit b)) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords (exit (p x)) (fun _ => [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonHeaderBranch
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonHeaderBranch :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry : C.State) (exit : Bool → C.State) (a : ℕ),
      0 < C.k ∧ Function.Injective exit ∧
      ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1),
        (∀ u < t, ∀ b, (C.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠ some (exit b)) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords (exit (canonHeaderOK x)) (fun _ => [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.decode_of_canonHeader
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma decode_of_canonHeader (F : MachineFormat) (x : List Bool)
    (invalid : canonHeaderOK x = false) : F.decode x = F.fallback

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonSeam_avoids
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonSeam_avoids {k : ℕ} {S R : Type} [DecidableEq S]
    {x : List Bool} (A : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (leave : S)
    (B : MultiTapeTM k Bool R) (enter : R) (target : S ⊕ R)
    {d e : Cfg k Bool S x} {t v : ℕ}
    (run : A.runFrom d t = e) (atExit : e.state = some leave)
    (first : ∀ u < t, (A.runFrom d u).state ≠ some leave)
    (before : ∀ u ≤ t, ((A.runFrom d u).mapState (Sum.inl : S → S ⊕ R)).state ≠
      some target)
    (after : ∀ u < v,
      ((B.runFrom (e.mapState (fun _ => enter)) u).mapState (Sum.inr : R → S ⊕ R)).state ≠
        some target) :
    ∀ u < t + 1 + v,
      ((seamCompTM A leave B enter).runFrom (d.mapState Sum.inl) u).state ≠
        some target

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonCounterBank
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonCounterBank {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : Fin 1 ↪ Fin k

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGuard_onBank
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonGuard_onBank {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (F : MachineFormat)
    (x bits rest : List Bool) (pair : pairDecode x = some (bits, rest))
    (d : Cfg k Bool (CounterLoopState (Option (Fin (canonGuardBlock F - 1 + 1)))) x)
    (control : d.state = some (.dec .run))
    (position : d.inputPos.val = 2 * bits.length + 3)
    (counter : d.workTapes i = FinTM.bufferTape (canonCount bits))
    (home : d.workTapePos i = 0) (silent : d.output = []) :
    let G := embedEmitTM (canonCounterBank i) (binaryGuardTM (canonGuardBlock F - 1))
    ∃ t ≤ (canonGuardBlock F + 6) * (x.length + 1),
      let e := G.runFrom d t
      e.state = some (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
        then .done else .escape) ∧ e.output = [] ∧
      e.inputPos.val = (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
        then 2 * bits.length + 3 + canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1)
        else x.length + 1) ∧
      (∀ u < t, (G.runFrom d u).state ≠ some .done ∧
        (G.runFrom d u).state ≠ some .escape) ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ i → e.workTapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ e.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonGuardReady
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonGuardReady (F : MachineFormat) (k : ℕ) (hk : 4 ≤ k) :
    ∃ (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S)
      (C : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (entry : S) (exit : Bool → S) (a : ℕ),
      Function.Injective exit ∧ ∀ x bits rest : List Bool,
        pairDecode x = some (bits, rest) → ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1),
          let start := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (canonReadyWords k bits)
          let e := C.runFrom start t
          e.state = some (exit (decide
            (canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length))) ∧
          e.output = [] ∧ e.inputPos.val =
            (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
              then 2 * bits.length + 3 else x.length + 1) ∧
          (∀ u < t, ∀ b, (C.runFrom start u).state ≠ some (exit b)) ∧
          ∀ j, j.val ≠ 1 →
            e.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape (canonReadyWords k bits j) ∧
              e.workTapePos j = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonGuardFrontStrict
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonGuardFrontStrict (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry : C.State) (exit : Bool → C.State) (a : ℕ),
      4 ≤ C.k ∧ Function.Injective exit ∧ ∀ x bits rest : List Bool,
        pairDecode x = some (bits, rest) → ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1),
          let start := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])
          let e := C.tm.runFrom start t
          e.state = some (exit (decide
            (canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length))) ∧
          e.output = [] ∧ e.inputPos.val =
            (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
              then 2 * bits.length + 3 else x.length + 1) ∧
          (∀ u < t, ∀ b, (C.tm.runFrom start u).state ≠ some (exit b)) ∧
          ∀ j, j.val ≠ 1 →
            e.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape (canonReadyWords C.k bits j) ∧
              e.workTapePos j = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBlankLift
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBlankLift {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (bank : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (q : S) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (embedEmitTM bank M).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q (fun _ => [])) t =
      embedEmitCfg bank (fun _ => FinTM.bufferTape []) (fun _ => 0) []
        (M.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q (fun _ => [])) t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonCheckedFront
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonCheckedFront (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry : C.State) (exit : Option Bool → C.State) (a : ℕ),
      4 ≤ C.k ∧ Function.Injective exit ∧ ∀ x : List Bool,
        ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1), ∃ verdict : Option Bool,
          let start := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])
          let e := C.tm.runFrom start t
          e.state = some (exit verdict) ∧ e.output = [] ∧
          (∀ u < t, ∀ q, (C.tm.runFrom start u).state ≠ some (exit q)) ∧
          (verdict ≠ some true → F.decode x = F.fallback) ∧
          (verdict = some true → ∃ bits rest,
            pairDecode x = some (bits, rest) ∧ bits = (codeBitsNat bits).bits ∧
            canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length ∧
            e.inputPos.val = 2 * bits.length + 3 ∧
            ∀ j, j.val ≠ 1 →
              e.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape (canonReadyWords C.k bits j) ∧
                e.workTapePos j = 0)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonExitDispatch
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonExitDispatch {k : ℕ} {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (positive : 0 < k) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start : S)
    (exit : Option Bool → S) (distinct : Function.Injective exit) :
    ∃ (R : Type) (_ : Fintype R) (_ : DecidableEq R) (N : MultiTapeTM k Bool R)
      (entry : R) (leave : Bool → R), Function.Injective leave ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (v : Option Bool),
        let d := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start (fun _ => [])
        (M.runFrom d t).state = some (exit v) →
        (∀ u < t, ∀ q, (M.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (exit q)) →
        N.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords entry (fun _ => [])) (t + 1) =
          (M.runFrom d t).mapState (fun _ => leave (decide (v = some true))) ∧
        ∀ u < t + 1, ∀ b, (N.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠ some (leave b)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonParseFront
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonParseFront (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry : C.State) (exit : Bool → C.State) (a : ℕ),
      4 ≤ C.k ∧ Function.Injective exit ∧ ∀ x : List Bool,
        ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1), ∃ verdict : Bool,
          let start := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])
          let e := C.tm.runFrom start t
          e.state = some (exit verdict) ∧ e.output = [] ∧
          (∀ u < t, ∀ q, (C.tm.runFrom start u).state ≠ some (exit q)) ∧
          (verdict = false → F.decode x = F.fallback) ∧
          (verdict = true → ∃ bits rest,
            pairDecode x = some (bits, rest) ∧ bits = (codeBitsNat bits).bits ∧
            canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length ∧
            e.inputPos.val = 2 * bits.length + 3 ∧
            ∀ j, j.val ≠ 1 →
              e.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape (canonReadyWords C.k bits j) ∧
                e.workTapePos j = 0)

private lemma canonUnaryLoop {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg 1 Bool (Option Bool) x)
    (hs : d.state = some (some true)) (p r : ℕ) (hp : d.inputPos.val = p + 1)
    (hr : p + r ≤ x.length) (hprefix : ∀ i < r, x[p + i]? = some true)
    (stopped : x[p + r]? ≠ some true) (w : List Bool) :
    ∃ t ≤ 5 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 7, ∃ v q,
      v.length = w.length ∧ (q = CounterLoopState.done ∨ q = .escape) ∧
      (counterLoopTM (canonCellTM 1 true) (some true) (some (some false))).runFrom
          (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d (FinTM.bufferTape w) 0) t =
        counterLoopCfg (some q)
          { d with inputPos := ⟨p + min (counterValue w) r + 1, by
              have := Nat.min_le_right (counterValue w) r; omega⟩ }
          (FinTM.bufferTape v) 0 ∧
      ∀ u < t,
        ((counterLoopTM (canonCellTM 1 true) (some true) (some (some false))).runFrom
          (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d (FinTM.bufferTape w) 0) u).state ≠ some .done ∧
        ((counterLoopTM (canonCellTM 1 true) (some true) (some (some false))).runFrom
          (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d (FinTM.bufferTape w) 0) u).state ≠ some .escape

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonUnaryCore_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonUnaryCore_run {x : List Bool} (w : List Bool)
    (d : Cfg 2 Bool (Sigma canonUnaryPhase) x)
    (hs : d.state = some ⟨none, .dec .run⟩) (positive : 1 ≤ d.inputPos.val)
    (counter : d.workTapes 1 = FinTM.bufferTape w) (home : d.workTapePos 1 = 0) :
    ∃ t ≤ 12 * (x.length + w.length + 1),
      (canonUnaryCore.runFrom d t).state = some
        ⟨some (some (codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1)
          (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome), .done⟩ ∧
      (canonUnaryCore.runFrom d t).output = d.output ∧
      (∀ u < t, ∀ b,
        (canonUnaryCore.runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨some (some b), .done⟩) ∧
      (canonUnaryCore.runFrom d t).workTapes =
        Function.update d.workTapes 1 (FinTM.bufferTape []) ∧
      (canonUnaryCore.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
      ∀ ys, codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1)) = some ys →
        (canonUnaryCore.runFrom d t).inputPos.val = x.length + 1 - ys.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonUnaryTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonUnaryTM :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (U : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
      (entry : S) (exit : Bool → S) (bound : Fin m) (a : ℕ), Function.Injective exit ∧
      ∀ (x w : List Bool) (d : Cfg m Bool S x), d.state = some entry →
        1 ≤ d.inputPos.val →
        d.workTapes bound = FinTM.bufferTape w → d.workTapePos bound = 0 →
        (∀ j, j ≠ bound → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) →
        ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + w.length + 1),
          (U.runFrom d t).state =
            some (exit (codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome) ∧
          (U.runFrom d t).output = d.output ∧
          (∀ u < t, ∀ v, (U.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (exit v)) ∧
          (U.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
          (U.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
          ∀ ys, codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1)) = some ys →
            (U.runFrom d t).inputPos.val = x.length + 1 - ys.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonNativeSuffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonNativeSuffix {m : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg m Bool S x) (p : ℕ) (pos : d.inputPos.val = p + 1)
    (range : p ≤ x.length) :
    d.inputSymbol = (x.drop p).head? ∧
      ∀ b ys, x.drop p = b :: ys →
        (moveInputPos d.inputPos 1).val = p + 2 ∧ x.drop (p + 1) = ys

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonPairs_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonPairs_run {m : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (vs : List (Bool → Bool → Bool))
    (j : Fin (vs.length + 1))
    (d : Cfg m Bool (Bool ⊕ (Fin (vs.length + 1) × Option Bool)) x)
    (p : ℕ) (pos : d.inputPos.val = p + 1) (range : p ≤ x.length)
    (state : d.state = some (Sum.inr (j, none))) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * (vs.length - j.val) + 1,
      ((canonPairsTM m vs).runFrom d t).state =
        some (Sum.inl (canonPairs (vs.drop j.val) (x.drop p)).isSome) ∧
      ((canonPairsTM m vs).runFrom d t).output = d.output ∧
      (∀ u < t, ∀ b, ((canonPairsTM m vs).runFrom d u).state ≠ some (Sum.inl b)) ∧
      ((canonPairsTM m vs).runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
      ((canonPairsTM m vs).runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
      1 ≤ ((canonPairsTM m vs).runFrom d t).inputPos.val ∧
      ∀ ys, canonPairs (vs.drop j.val) (x.drop p) = some ys →
        ((canonPairsTM m vs).runFrom d t).inputPos.val = x.length + 1 - ys.length

private lemma exists_canonRecordTM (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (R : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
      (entry : S) (exit : Bool → S) (bound : Fin m) (a : ℕ), Function.Injective exit ∧

        (∀ j, j ≠ bound → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) →
        ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + w.length + 1),
          (R.runFrom d t).state =
            some (exit (codeSkipActionK k (counterValue w) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome) ∧
          (R.runFrom d t).output = d.output ∧
          (∀ u < t, ∀ v, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (exit v)) ∧

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonEmitVerdict
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonEmitVerdict {k : ℕ} {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (entry : S) (exit : Option Bool → S)
    (injective : Function.Injective exit) :
    ∃ D : FinTM Bool, ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (v : Option Bool),
      let d := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])
      (M.runFrom d t).state = some (exit v) → (M.runFrom d t).output = [] →
      (∀ u < t, ∀ q, (M.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (exit q)) →
      D.ComputesInTime x [decide (v = some true)] (t + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonReturnAdapter
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonReturnAdapter {m : ℕ} {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (entry : S) (exit : Bool → S)
    (distinct : Function.Injective exit) :
    ∃ (H : Type) (_ : Fintype H) (_ : DecidableEq H) (N : MultiTapeTM m Bool H)
      (anchor escape : H), escape ≠ anchor ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (d : Cfg m Bool S x), d.state = some entry →
        ∀ (t : ℕ) (v : Bool), (M.runFrom d t).state = some (exit v) →
          (∀ u < t, ∀ b, (M.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (exit b)) →
          0 < t + 2 ∧
          N.runFrom (d.mapState (fun _ => anchor)) (t + 2) =
            (M.runFrom d t).mapState (fun _ => if v then anchor else escape) ∧
          ∀ u, 0 < u → u < t + 2 →
            ∃ q, (N.runFrom (d.mapState (fun _ => anchor)) u).state = some q ∧
              q ≠ anchor ∧ q ≠ escape

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonRecordRound
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonRecordRound (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (H : Type) (_ : Fintype H) (_ : DecidableEq H) (N : MultiTapeTM m Bool H)
      (anchor escape : H) (bound : Fin m) (a : ℕ), escape ≠ anchor ∧
      ∀ (x w : List Bool) (d : Cfg m Bool H x), d.state = some anchor →
        1 ≤ d.inputPos.val →
        d.workTapes bound = FinTM.bufferTape w → d.workTapePos bound = 0 →
        (∀ j, j ≠ bound → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) →
        ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + w.length + 1), 0 < t ∧
          (N.runFrom d t).state = some
            (if (codeSkipActionK k (counterValue w) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome
              then anchor else escape) ∧
          (N.runFrom d t).output = d.output ∧
          (∀ u, 0 < u → u < t →
            ∃ q, (N.runFrom d u).state = some q ∧ q ≠ anchor ∧ q ≠ escape) ∧
          (N.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
          (N.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
          ∀ ys, codeSkipActionK k (counterValue w) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1)) = some ys →
            (N.runFrom d t).inputPos.val = x.length + 1 - ys.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonRepeat_last
Turing.MachineFormat.canonRepeat_orbit
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonRepeat_orbit {m : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (anchor escape : S) (τ : Cfg m Bool S x → ℕ)
    (valid : Cfg m Bool S x → Prop) (tail : Cfg m Bool S x → List Bool)
    (r : List Bool → Option (List Bool))
    (step : ∀ c, valid c → c.state = some anchor →
      (M.runFrom c (τ c)).state = some (if (r (tail c)).isSome then anchor else escape) ∧
      ∀ ys, r (tail c) = some ys → valid (M.runFrom c (τ c)) ∧
        tail (M.runFrom c (τ c)) = ys)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S x) (hc : valid c) (ha : c.state = some anchor) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ j ≤ n,
      (∀ i < j, valid (roundOrbit M τ c i) ∧ (roundOrbit M τ c i).state = some anchor) ∧
      ((j = n ∧ valid (roundOrbit M τ c j) ∧
          (roundOrbit M τ c j).state = some anchor ∧
          codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c) = some (tail (roundOrbit M τ c j))) ∨
        (0 < j ∧ (roundOrbit M τ c j).state = some escape ∧
          codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c) = none))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonCounterRepeat
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonCounterRepeat {m : ℕ} {S : Type} [DecidableEq S] {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (anchor escape : S) (different : escape ≠ anchor)
    (τ : Cfg m Bool S x → ℕ) (valid : Cfg m Bool S x → Prop)
    (tail : Cfg m Bool S x → List Bool) (r : List Bool → Option (List Bool)) (B : ℕ)
    (spec : ∀ d, valid d → d.state = some anchor →
      0 < τ d ∧ τ d ≤ B ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < τ d →
        ∃ q, (M.runFrom d u).state = some q ∧ q ≠ anchor ∧ q ≠ escape) ∧
      (M.runFrom d (τ d)).state = some (if (r (tail d)).isSome then anchor else escape) ∧
      ∀ ys, r (tail d) = some ys → valid (M.runFrom d (τ d)) ∧
        tail (M.runFrom d (τ d)) = ys)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S x) (hc : valid c) (ha : c.state = some anchor)
    (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ)
    (word : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      ct (cp + z) = FinTM.bufferTape w z)
    (n : ℕ) (value : Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = n) :
    ∃ T ≤ n * (B + 4) + 2 * w.length + 2, ∃ j ≤ n,
      T = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, τ (roundOrbit M τ c i)) +
        counterOverhead w (j + if (codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c)).isSome then 1 else 0) ∧
      (counterLoopTM M anchor (some escape)).runFrom
          (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct cp) T =
        counterLoopCfg (some (if (codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c)).isSome then .done else .escape))
          (roundOrbit M τ c j)
          (fun z => if cp ≤ z ∧ z < cp + (w.length : ℤ) then
            if (codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c)).isSome then some true
            else FinTM.bufferTape (counterWord w j) (z - cp) else ct z) cp ∧
      (∀ u < T,
        ((counterLoopTM M anchor (some escape)).runFrom
          (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some .done ∧
        ((counterLoopTM M anchor (some escape)).runFrom
          (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some .escape) ∧
      (∀ ys, codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c) = some ys →
        j = n ∧ valid (roundOrbit M τ c j) ∧ tail (roundOrbit M τ c j) = ys) ∧
      (codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c) = none →
        0 < j ∧ (roundOrbit M τ c j).state = some escape)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageRoundSpec
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageRoundSpec (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (H : Type) (_ : Fintype H) (_ : DecidableEq H) (N : MultiTapeTM m Bool H)
      (anchor escape : H) (bound : Fin m) (B : ℕ), escape ≠ anchor ∧
      ∀ (x w : List Bool), ∃ τ : Cfg m Bool H x → ℕ,
        ∀ d : Cfg m Bool H x,
          (d.output = [] ∧ 1 ≤ d.inputPos.val ∧
            d.workTapes bound = FinTM.bufferTape w ∧ d.workTapePos bound = 0 ∧
            (∀ j, j ≠ bound → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0)) →
          d.state = some anchor →
          0 < τ d ∧ τ d ≤ B * (x.length + w.length + 1) ∧
          (∀ u, 0 < u → u < τ d →
            ∃ q, (N.runFrom d u).state = some q ∧ q ≠ anchor ∧ q ≠ escape) ∧
          (N.runFrom d (τ d)).state = some
            (if (codeSkipActionK k (counterValue w) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome
              then anchor else escape) ∧
          (N.runFrom d (τ d)).output = [] ∧
          ∀ ys, codeSkipActionK k (counterValue w) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1)) = some ys →
            (((N.runFrom d (τ d)).output = [] ∧ 1 ≤ (N.runFrom d (τ d)).inputPos.val ∧
              (N.runFrom d (τ d)).workTapes bound = FinTM.bufferTape w ∧
              (N.runFrom d (τ d)).workTapePos bound = 0 ∧
              (∀ j, j ≠ bound → (N.runFrom d (τ d)).workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧
                (N.runFrom d (τ d)).workTapePos j = 0)) ∧
            x.drop ((N.runFrom d (τ d)).inputPos.val - 1) = ys)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageInnerSpec
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageInnerSpec (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (H : Type) (_ : Fintype H) (_ : DecidableEq H) (N : MultiTapeTM (m + 1) Bool H)
      (anchor escape : H) (bound : Fin m) (B : ℕ), escape ≠ anchor ∧
      ∀ (x w : List Bool), ∃ τ : Cfg (m + 1) Bool H x → ℕ,
        ∀ d : Cfg (m + 1) Bool H x,
          (d.output = [] ∧ 1 ≤ d.inputPos.val ∧
            d.workTapes bound.castSucc = FinTM.bufferTape w ∧
            d.workTapePos bound.castSucc = 0 ∧
            (∀ j : Fin m, j ≠ bound → d.workTapes j.castSucc = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧
              d.workTapePos j.castSucc = 0) ∧
            (∀ q : ℤ, q < 0 ∨ ((3 ^ (k + 1) : ℕ).bits.length : ℤ) ≤ q →
              d.workTapes (Fin.last m) q = none) ∧
            d.workTapePos (Fin.last m) = 0) →
          d.state = some anchor →
          0 < τ d ∧ τ d ≤ B * (x.length + w.length + 1) ∧
          (∀ u, 0 < u → u < τ d →
            ∃ q, (N.runFrom d u).state = some q ∧ q ≠ anchor ∧ q ≠ escape) ∧
          (N.runFrom d (τ d)).state = some
            (if (codeSkipRepeat (codeSkipActionK k (counterValue w)) (3 ^ (k + 1))
                (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome
              then anchor else escape) ∧
          (N.runFrom d (τ d)).output = [] ∧
          ∀ ys, codeSkipRepeat (codeSkipActionK k (counterValue w)) (3 ^ (k + 1))
              (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1)) = some ys →
            (((N.runFrom d (τ d)).output = [] ∧ 1 ≤ (N.runFrom d (τ d)).inputPos.val ∧
              (N.runFrom d (τ d)).workTapes bound.castSucc = FinTM.bufferTape w ∧
              (N.runFrom d (τ d)).workTapePos bound.castSucc = 0 ∧
              (∀ j : Fin m, j ≠ bound →
                (N.runFrom d (τ d)).workTapes j.castSucc = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧
                (N.runFrom d (τ d)).workTapePos j.castSucc = 0) ∧
              (∀ q : ℤ, q < 0 ∨ ((3 ^ (k + 1) : ℕ).bits.length : ℤ) ≤ q →
                (N.runFrom d (τ d)).workTapes (Fin.last m) q = none) ∧
              (N.runFrom d (τ d)).workTapePos (Fin.last m) = 0) ∧
            x.drop ((N.runFrom d (τ d)).inputPos.val - 1) = ys)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageBlock_consumes
Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageOuterSpec
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageOuterSpec (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (H : Type) (_ : Fintype H) (_ : DecidableEq H) (P : MultiTapeTM (m + 2) Bool H)
      (anchor escape : H) (bound : Fin m) (A : ℕ), escape ≠ anchor ∧
      ∀ (x w u : List Bool), Nat.ofDigits 2 (u.map Bool.toNat) = counterValue w + 1 →
        ∃ τ : Cfg (m + 2) Bool H x → ℕ,
          ∀ d : Cfg (m + 2) Bool H x,
            (d.output = [] ∧ 1 ≤ d.inputPos.val ∧
              d.workTapes bound.castSucc.castSucc = FinTM.bufferTape w ∧
              d.workTapePos bound.castSucc.castSucc = 0 ∧
              (∀ j : Fin m, j ≠ bound →
                d.workTapes j.castSucc.castSucc = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧
                d.workTapePos j.castSucc.castSucc = 0) ∧
              (∀ q : ℤ, q < 0 ∨ ((3 ^ (k + 1) : ℕ).bits.length : ℤ) ≤ q →
                d.workTapes (Fin.last m).castSucc q = none) ∧
              d.workTapePos (Fin.last m).castSucc = 0 ∧
              d.workTapes (Fin.last (m + 1)) = FinTM.bufferTape u ∧
              d.workTapePos (Fin.last (m + 1)) = 0) →
            d.state = some anchor →
            0 < τ d ∧ τ d ≤ A * (x.length + w.length + u.length + 1) ^ 2 ∧
            (∀ v, 0 < v → v < τ d →
              ∃ q, (P.runFrom d v).state = some q ∧ q ≠ anchor ∧ q ≠ escape) ∧
            (P.runFrom d (τ d)).state = some
              (if (codeSkipTableK k (counterValue w) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome
                then anchor else escape) ∧
            (P.runFrom d (τ d)).output = [] ∧
            ∀ ys, codeSkipTableK k (counterValue w) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1)) = some ys →
              (P.runFrom d (τ d)).output = [] ∧ 1 ≤ (P.runFrom d (τ d)).inputPos.val ∧
              x.drop ((P.runFrom d (τ d)).inputPos.val - 1) = ys

    (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ) (w : List Bool) :
    (canonStageBank M header ctrOuter q ip ct cp w).workTapes header = FinTM.bufferTape w ∧
    (canonStageBank M header ctrOuter q ip ct cp w).workTapePos header = 0 ∧
    (canonStageBank M header ctrOuter q ip ct cp w).workTapes ctrOuter = ct ∧

    (d : Cfg M Bool (Σ j, canonStagePh SU j) x) (A B : ℕ) (i : Fin 9) (hi : i.val ≠ 8)

    (vt : ℕ) (h1 : A ≤ vt) (h2 : vt ≤ A + B) (b : Bool) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageLeg0
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageLeg0 {M mU : ℕ} {SU : Type} [Fintype SU] [DecidableEq SU]
    (U : MultiTapeTM mU Bool SU) (ue : SU) (ux : Bool → SU)
    (header ctrOuter : Fin M) (σ : Fin mU ↪ Fin M) (hhc : header ≠ ctrOuter)
    (x w : List Bool) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
    (∀ u ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
      (canonStageFr M mU SU U ue ux header ctrOuter σ).runFrom
        (((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some SweepPhase.sweep) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape []) 0 w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) u =
      ((copyTM M header ctrOuter).runFrom
        (canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some SweepPhase.sweep) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape []) 0 w) u).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) ∧
    (canonStageFr M mU SU U ue ux header ctrOuter σ).runFrom
      (((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some SweepPhase.sweep) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape []) 0 w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) (2 * w.length + 2 +
          1) =
      ((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some SeekPhase.run) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape w) 0 w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageLeg1
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:

      (FinTM.bufferTape w) 0 w) u).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) ∧

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageLeg2
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageLeg2 {M mU : ℕ} {SU : Type} [Fintype SU] [DecidableEq SU]
    (U : MultiTapeTM mU Bool SU) (ue : SU) (ux : Bool → SU)
    (header ctrOuter : Fin M) (σ : Fin mU ↪ Fin M) (hhc : header ≠ ctrOuter)
    (x w : List Bool) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) :

      (FinTM.bufferTape w) (w.length + 1) w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) u =
      ((walkTM M ctrOuter (· = ctrOuter) .neg).runFrom

      (FinTM.bufferTape w) (w.length + 1) w) u).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) ∧
    (canonStageFr M mU SU U ue ux header ctrOuter σ).runFrom
      (((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some SeekPhase.run) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape w) (w.length + 1) w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) (([] :
          List Bool).length + 1 + 1) =
      ((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some (WritePhase.wr 0) : Option (WritePhase 1)) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape w) (w.length) w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨3, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageLeg3
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageLeg3 {M mU : ℕ} {SU : Type} [Fintype SU] [DecidableEq SU]
    (U : MultiTapeTM mU Bool SU) (ue : SU) (ux : Bool → SU)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageLeg4
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageLeg4 {M mU : ℕ} {SU : Type} [Fintype SU] [DecidableEq SU]
    (U : MultiTapeTM mU Bool SU) (ue : SU) (ux : Bool → SU)

          9))) ∧

      (FinTM.bufferTape (w ++ [false])) (w.length) w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨4, by omega⟩ : Fin 9)))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageLeg5
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageLeg5 {M mU : ℕ} {SU : Type} [Fintype SU] [DecidableEq SU]
    (U : MultiTapeTM mU Bool SU) (ue : SU) (ux : Bool → SU)
    (header ctrOuter : Fin M) (σ : Fin mU ↪ Fin M) (hhc : header ≠ ctrOuter)
    (x w : List Bool) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
    (∀ u ≤ (w ++ [false]).length + 3,
      (canonStageFr M mU SU U ue ux header ctrOuter σ).runFrom
        (((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some SeekPhase.run) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape (w ++ [false])) (w.length + 2) w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨5, by omega⟩ : Fin
          9))) u =
      ((skipBackTM M ctrOuter).runFrom
        (canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some SeekPhase.run) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape (w ++ [false])) (w.length + 2) w) u).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨5, by omega⟩ : Fin
          9))) ∧
    (canonStageFr M mU SU U ue ux header ctrOuter σ).runFrom
      (((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some SeekPhase.run) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape (w ++ [false])) (w.length + 2) w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨5, by omega⟩ : Fin
          9))) ((w ++ [false]).length + 3 + 1) =
      ((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some FlagPhase.run) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape (w ++ [false])) 0 w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨6, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageLeg6
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageLeg6 {M mU : ℕ} {SU : Type} [Fintype SU] [DecidableEq SU]
    (U : MultiTapeTM mU Bool SU) (ue : SU) (ux : Bool → SU)
    (header ctrOuter : Fin M) (σ : Fin mU ↪ Fin M) (hhc : header ≠ ctrOuter)
    (x w : List Bool) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (v : List Bool) (hv : incFixed (w ++ [false]) = some v) :
    (∀ u ≤ 2 * ((w ++ [false]).takeWhile id).length + 2,
      (canonStageFr M mU SU U ue ux header ctrOuter σ).runFrom
        (((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some FlagPhase.run) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape (w ++ [false])) 0 w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨6, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) u =
      ((incrementTM M ctrOuter).runFrom
        (canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some FlagPhase.run) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape (w ++ [false])) 0 w) u).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨6, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) ∧
    (canonStageFr M mU SU U ue ux header ctrOuter σ).runFrom
      (((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some FlagPhase.run) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape (w ++ [false])) 0 w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨6, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))) (2 * ((w
          ++ [false]).takeWhile id).length + 2 + 1) =
      ((canonStageBank M header ctrOuter (some ue) ip
      (FinTM.bufferTape v) 0 w)).mapState (Sigma.mk (⟨7, by omega⟩ : Fin 9))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStageFrontSpec
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStageFrontSpec {M mU : ℕ} {SU : Type} [Fintype SU] [DecidableEq SU]
    (U : MultiTapeTM mU Bool SU) (ue : SU) (ux : Bool → SU) (uBound : Fin mU) (ua : ℕ)
    (uinj : Function.Injective ux)
    (unary : ∀ (x w : List Bool) (d : Cfg mU Bool SU x), d.state = some ue →
      1 ≤ d.inputPos.val →
      d.workTapes uBound = FinTM.bufferTape w → d.workTapePos uBound = 0 →
      (∀ j, j ≠ uBound → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) →
      ∃ t ≤ ua * (x.length + w.length + 1),
        (U.runFrom d t).state =
          some (ux (codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1)
            (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome) ∧
        (U.runFrom d t).output = d.output ∧
        (∀ u < t, ∀ v, (U.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (ux v)) ∧
        (U.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
        (U.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
        ∀ ys, codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1)) = some ys →
          (U.runFrom d t).inputPos.val = x.length + 1 - ys.length)
    (header ctrOuter : Fin M) (σ : Fin mU ↪ Fin M) (hσb : σ uBound = header)
    (hσc : ∀ i, σ i ≠ ctrOuter) (hhc : header ≠ ctrOuter) :
    ∃ (H : Type) (_ : Fintype H) (_ : DecidableEq H) (Fr : MultiTapeTM M Bool H)
      (entry : H) (exit : Bool → H) (A : ℕ), Function.Injective exit ∧
      ∀ (x w : List Bool) (d : Cfg M Bool H x), d.state = some entry → d.output = [] →
        1 ≤ d.inputPos.val →
        d.workTapes header = FinTM.bufferTape w → d.workTapePos header = 0 →
        (∀ j, j ≠ header → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) →
        ∃ t ≤ A * (x.length + w.length + 1), ∃ u : List Bool,
          Nat.ofDigits 2 (u.map Bool.toNat) = counterValue w + 1 ∧
          u.length = w.length + 1 ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).state = some (exit (codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1)
            (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome) ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).output = [] ∧
          (∀ v < t, ∀ b, (Fr.runFrom d v).state ≠ some (exit b)) ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapes header = FinTM.bufferTape w ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapePos header = 0 ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapes ctrOuter = FinTM.bufferTape u ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapePos ctrOuter = 0 ∧
          (∀ j, j ≠ header → j ≠ ctrOuter →
            (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧
            (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = 0) ∧
          ∀ ys, codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1)) = some ys →
            (Fr.runFrom d t).inputPos.val = x.length + 1 - ys.length

    (d : Cfg M Bool (Σ j, canonGramPh HF H₃ j) x) (A B : ℕ) (i : Fin 4) (hi : i.val ≠ 3)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGramLedger
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonGramLedger (AF A₃ X t₁ t₂ t₃ : ℕ)
    (h₁ : t₁ ≤ AF * (2 * (X + 1))) (h₂ : t₂ ≤ A₃ * (3 * (X + 1)) ^ 2)
    (h₃ : t₃ ≤ X + 2) :
    t₁ + 1 + (t₂ + 1) + (t₃ + 1) ≤

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonGrammarStage
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonGrammarStage (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (G : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
      (entry : S) (exit : Bool → S) (a : ℕ) (header : Fin m), Function.Injective exit ∧
      ∀ (x bits rest : List Bool), pairDecode x = some (bits, rest) →
        bits = (codeBitsNat bits).bits →
        canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length →
        ∀ d : Cfg m Bool S x, d.state = some entry → d.output = [] →
          d.inputPos.val = 2 * bits.length + 3 →
          d.workTapes header = FinTM.bufferTape bits → d.workTapePos header = 0 →
          (∀ j, j ≠ header → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) →
          ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1) ^ a,
            (G.runFrom d t).state =
              some (exit (canonGrammar F.k (codeBitsNat bits) rest).isSome) ∧
            (G.runFrom d t).output = [] ∧
            ∀ u < t, ∀ v, (G.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (exit v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonDecider
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonDecider (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (D : FinTM Bool) (a : ℕ), ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ b : Bool,
      D.ComputesInTime α [b] (a * (α.length + 1) ^ a) ∧
        (b = false → F.decode α = F.fallback) ∧
        (b = true → ∃ tail, F.scan α = some tail)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_polyCanonizer
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
theorem exists_polyCanonizer :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (d : ℕ),
      C.ComputesFunInTime (fun α => F.serialize (F.decode α)) fun n => d * (n + 1) ^ d

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.summaryClock
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private def summaryClock {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q)
    {x : List Bool} : ℕ → Cfg k Bool Q x → Option Bool → Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.summaryClock_correct
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma summaryClock_correct {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q)
    {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (t : ℕ) :
    summaryClock M t c (outputSummary c.output) =
      ((M.runFrom c t).state.isNone &&
        (outputSummary (M.runFrom c t).output == some true))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.summaryClock_accepts
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma summaryClock_accepts (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    summaryClock M.tm t (M.tm.initCfg x) none = true ↔ M.ComputesInTime x [true] t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.summaryClock_zero
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma summaryClock_zero (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    summaryClock M.tm 0 (M.tm.initCfg x) none = false

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.h1HostedVerdictTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private def h1HostedVerdictTM (k : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM (1 + (k + 2 + 1)) Bool (CounterLoopState (Σ key, Ph k key) × Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.h1HostedVerdict_effect
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem h1HostedVerdict_effect {k n : ℕ} {x z : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some (exit k true))
    (rel : Rep M.tr (M.initCfg x) d) (t : ℕ)
    (p : Fin (z.length + 2)) :
    ∃ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) + 4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3,
      let e := (h1HostedVerdictTM k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T
      e.state = none ∧ e.inputPos = p ∧
        e.output = d.output ++ [summaryClock M t (M.initCfg x) none]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.h1HostedVerdict_accepts
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem h1HostedVerdict_accepts (F : MachineFormat) (α x z : List Bool)
    (d : Cfg (F.k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph F.k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some (exit F.k true))
    (rel : Rep (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr
      ((F.machine (F.decode α)).initCfg x) d) (t : ℕ)
    (p : Fin (z.length + 2)) :
    ∃ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).state = none ∧
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).output = d.output ++ [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_install
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_install :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a d : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ x α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * ((α.length + 1) ^ d + α.length +
          max α.length (F.serialize F.fallback).length + 1), 0 < t ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k α)) t').state ≠
            some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k α)) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (serializeK (F.machine (F.decode α))))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_locality
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_locality {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (x : List Bool)
    (t : ℕ) :
    (M.runFrom (M.initCfg (x.take t)) t).state = (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).state ∧
      (M.runFrom (M.initCfg (x.take t)) t).output = (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).output

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_verdict
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_verdict (S : FinTM Bool) (z : List Bool) (T B : ℕ) (answer : Bool) (P : Prop)
    (hT : T ≤ B) (halt : (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg z) T).state = none)
    (out : (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg z) T).output = [answer]) (hans : answer = true ↔ P) :
    (P → S.ComputesInTime z [true] B) ∧ (¬P → S.ComputesInTime z [false] B)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_table_le
Turing.MachineFormat.us_window_verdict
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_window_verdict (α x z : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (d : Cfg (F.k + 2) Bool (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) (x.take t))
    (entry : d.state = some (StepBlock.exit F.k true))
    (rel : StepBlock.Rep (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr
      ((F.machine (F.decode α)).initCfg (x.take t)) d)
    (p : Fin (z.length + 2)) (silent : d.output = []) :
    ∃ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).state = none ∧
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).output = [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_ledger
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_ledger (a d₀ A B L αl xl t T₁ T₂ s m tb bl : ℕ)
    (hm : m ≤ αl + L) (hs : s ≤ m) (htb : tb ≤ m) (hbl : bl ≤ t)
    (hT₁ : T₁ ≤ a * ((αl + 1) ^ d₀ + αl + m + 1) + A * (αl + s + 1) +
      B * (bl + min t xl + 1))
    (hT₂ : T₂ ≤ t * (50 * (tb + 1)) + 4 * t + 2 * bl + 3) :
    T₁ + 1 + T₂ ≤ (a * (L + 4) + A * (L + 3) + 3 * B + 50 * L + 110 + d₀ + 2) *
      (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (a * (L + 4) + A * (L + 3) + 3 * B + 50 * L + 110 + d₀ + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_bank
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_bank {k K : ℕ} (ιP : Fin k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (hcw : jctr ≠ jwin) (hct : jctr ≠ jtbl) (hcs : jctr ≠ jsm) (hwt : jwin ≠ jtbl)
    (hws : jwin ≠ jsm) (hts : jtbl ≠ jsm) (hcP : jctr ∉ Set.range ιP)
    (hwP : jwin ∉ Set.range ιP) (htP : jtbl ∉ Set.range ιP) (hsP : jsm ∉ Set.range ιP) :
    ∃ g : Fin (1 + (k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K,
      g (Fin.castAdd (k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin ∧
      (∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i) ∧
      g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd k 0))) = jtbl ∧
      g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd k 1))) = jsm ∧
      g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (k + 2))) = jctr

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_junction
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_junction {K : ℕ} {Q : Type} {z : List Bool} (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (g : Fin (1 + (F.k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K) (ιP : Fin F.k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (gw : g (Fin.castAdd (F.k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin)
    (gP : ∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i)
    (gt : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 0))) = jtbl)
    (gs : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 1))) = jsm)
    (gc : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (F.k + 2))) = jctr)
    (c : Cfg K Bool Q z) (done : Q) (hst : c.state = some done) (hout : c.output = [])
    (hctr : c.workTapes jctr = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) (hctrp : c.workTapePos jctr = 0)
    (hwin : c.workTapes jwin = FinTM.bufferTape (x.take t)) (hwinp : c.workTapePos jwin = 0)
    (htbl : c.workTapes jtbl = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr))
    (htblp : c.workTapePos jtbl = 0)
    (hsm : c.workTapes jsm =
      StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀))
    (hsmp : c.workTapePos jsm = 0)
    (hpas : ∀ i, c.workTapes (ιP i) = (fun _ => none) ∧ c.workTapePos (ιP i) = 0) :
    ∃ d : Cfg (F.k + 2) Bool (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) (x.take t),
      d.state = some (StepBlock.exit F.k true) ∧
      StepBlock.Rep (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr
        ((F.machine (F.decode α)).initCfg (x.take t)) d ∧
      d.output = [] ∧
      c.mapState (fun _ => ((CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true) :
          CounterLoopState (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) × Bool)) =
        embedEmitCfg g c.workTapes c.workTapePos []
          (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) d
            (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true c.inputPos [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_tail
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_tail {K : ℕ} {Q : Type} [DecidableEq Q] (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (U : MultiTapeTM K Bool Q) (done : Q) (g : Fin (1 + (F.k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K)
    (ιP : Fin F.k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (gw : g (Fin.castAdd (F.k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin)
    (gP : ∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i)
    (gt : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 0))) = jtbl)
    (gs : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 1))) = jsm)
    (gc : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (F.k + 2))) = jctr)
    (c₀ c : Cfg K Bool Q (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x)) (T₁ : ℕ)
    (run : U.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c) (hst : c.state = some done)
    (cut : ∀ u < T₁, (U.runFrom c₀ u).state ≠ some done) (hout : c.output = [])
    (hctr : c.workTapes jctr = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) (hctrp : c.workTapePos jctr = 0)
    (hwin : c.workTapes jwin = FinTM.bufferTape (x.take t)) (hwinp : c.workTapePos jwin = 0)
    (htbl : c.workTapes jtbl = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr))
    (htblp : c.workTapePos jtbl = 0)
    (hsm : c.workTapes jsm =
      StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀))
    (hsmp : c.workTapePos jsm = 0)
    (hpas : ∀ i, c.workTapes (ιP i) = (fun _ => none) ∧ c.workTapePos (ιP i) = 0) :
    ∃ T₂ ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      ((seamCompTM U done (embedEmitTM g (h1HostedVerdictTM F.k))
          (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true)).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl)
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).state = none ∧
      ((seamCompTM U done (embedEmitTM g (h1HostedVerdictTM F.k))
          (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true)).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl)
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).output = [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_start {K : ℕ} {Q R : Type} (W : MultiTapeTM K Bool (Q ⊕ R)) (entry : Q)
    (z : List Bool) :
    ({ W with q₀ := Sum.inl entry } : MultiTapeTM K Bool (Q ⊕ R)).initCfg z =
      (⟨some entry, 1, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ : Cfg K Bool Q z).mapState Sum.inl

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.us_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private theorem us_run {K : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] (α x : List Bool)
    (t : ℕ) (U : MultiTapeTM K Bool Q) (entry done : Q) (g : Fin (1 + (F.k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K)
    (ιP : Fin F.k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (gw : g (Fin.castAdd (F.k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin)
    (gP : ∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i)
    (gt : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 0))) = jtbl)
    (gs : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 1))) = jsm)
    (gc : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (F.k + 2))) = jctr)
    (c : Cfg K Bool Q (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x)) (T₁ : ℕ)
    (run : U.runFrom ⟨some entry, 1, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ T₁ = c)
    (hst : c.state = some done)
    (cut : ∀ u < T₁, (U.runFrom (⟨some entry, 1, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ :
      Cfg K Bool Q (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x)) u).state ≠ some done)
    (hout : c.output = [])
    (hctr : c.workTapes jctr = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) (hctrp : c.workTapePos jctr = 0)
    (hwin : c.workTapes jwin = FinTM.bufferTape (x.take t)) (hwinp : c.workTapePos jwin = 0)
    (htbl : c.workTapes jtbl = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr))
    (htblp : c.workTapePos jtbl = 0)
    (hsm : c.workTapes jsm =
      StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀))
    (hsmp : c.workTapePos jsm = 0)
    (hpas : ∀ i, c.workTapes (ιP i) = (fun _ => none) ∧ c.workTapePos (ιP i) = 0) :
    let S : FinTM Bool :=
      { k := K, State := Q ⊕ (CounterLoopState (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) × Bool),
        tm := { seamCompTM U done (embedEmitTM g (h1HostedVerdictTM F.k))
          (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true) with q₀ := Sum.inl entry } }
    ∃ T₂ ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x))
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).state = none ∧
      (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x))
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).output = [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_uniformSimulator
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
theorem exists_uniformSimulator :
    ∃ (S : FinTM Bool) (d : ℕ), ∀ (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      ((F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t →
        S.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [true]
          (d * (α.length + x.length + t + 1) ^ d)) ∧
      (¬(F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t →
        S.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [false]
          (d * (α.length + x.length + t + 1) ^ d))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.ifEqTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header: def ifEqTM (w₀ u v : List Bool) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.ifEq_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma ifEq_finish (w₀ u v x : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (cfg : Cfg 0 Bool (ifEqTM w₀ u v).State x)
    (hs : cfg.state = some (.inr (cond b (.inl 0) (.inr 0)))) (ho : cfg.output = []) :
    ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg ((cond b u v).length + 1)).state = none ∧
    ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg ((cond b u v).length + 1)).output = cond b u v

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.ifEq_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma ifEq_run (w₀ u v x : List Bool) : ∀ (r i : ℕ) (hlen : w₀.length = i + r), i ≤ x.length → x.take i = w₀.take i →
    ∀ (cfg : Cfg 0 Bool (ifEqTM w₀ u v).State x),
      cfg.state = some (.inl ⟨i, by omega⟩) → cfg.inputPos.val = i + 1 → cfg.output = [] →
      ∃ t, t ≤ r + max u.length v.length + 2 ∧
        ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg t).state = none ∧
        ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg t).output = if x = w₀ then u else v

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.ifEqTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem ifEqTM_computes (w₀ u v : List Bool) :
    (ifEqTM w₀ u v).ComputesFunInTime (fun w => if w = w₀ then u else v)
      (fun n => (w₀.length + max u.length v.length + 3) * (n + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_ifEq
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_ifEq (w₀ u v : List Bool) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => if w = w₀ then u else v) fun n => c * (n + 1)

Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime
Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_comp
Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime_on_image
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime_on_image (M U : FinTM Bool)
    (f g : List Bool → List Bool) (T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T₁)
    (hU : ∀ x, U.ComputesInTime (f x) (g x) (T₂ x.length)) :
    (bufferedCompTM M U).ComputesFunInTime g (fun n => 2 * T₁ n + T₂ n + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_comp_on_image
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem exists_comp_on_image (M U : FinTM Bool) (f g : List Bool → List Bool)
    (T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T₁)
    (hU : ∀ x, U.ComputesInTime (f x) (g x) (T₂ x.length)) :
    ∃ N : FinTM Bool, N.ComputesFunInTime g (fun n => 2 * T₁ n + T₂ n + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computes_iff
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem bufferedCompTM_computes_iff (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) :
    (∃ t, (bufferedCompTM M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t) ↔
      ∃ y : List Bool, (∃ t, M₁.ComputesInTime x y t) ∧ ∃ t, M₂.ComputesInTime y w t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_comp_partial
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem exists_comp_partial (M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) :
    ∃ M : FinTM Bool, ∀ x w : List Bool,
      (∃ t, M.ComputesInTime x w t) ↔
        ∃ y : List Bool,
          (∃ t, M₁.ComputesInTime x y t) ∧ ∃ t, M₂.ComputesInTime y w t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header: def condTM (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.controlCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private def controlCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) : Cfg (condTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (condTM D M₁ M₂).State x

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.controlCfg_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma controlCfg_step (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (hs : c.state ≠ none) :
    (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step (controlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) =
      controlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.step c)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.controlCfg_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma controlCfg_run (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ s, s < t → (D.tm.runFrom c s).state ≠ none) :
    (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (controlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) t =
      controlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom c t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.condTM_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma condTM_start (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hD : ∃ t, D.ComputesInTime x [b] t) :
    ∃ (t : ℕ) (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
      (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t =
        rightCfg (fun q => .inr (.inr q)) (show Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x from by
          simpa only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x)) tapes heads

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.condTM_branch_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
private lemma condTM_branch_run (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (b : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (t : ℕ) :
    let V : Bool → MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) :=
      fun tag => by
        rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ tag, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ tag]
        exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ tag).tm
    (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom
        (rightCfg (fun q => .inr (.inr q)) c tapes heads) t =
      rightCfg (fun q => .inr (.inr q)) ((V b).runFrom c t) tapes heads

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.condTM_computes_iff
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem condTM_computes_iff (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (p : List Bool → Bool)
    (hD : D.Computes fun x => [p x]) (x w : List Bool) :
    (∃ t, (condTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t) ↔
      ∃ t, (cond (p x) M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_cond
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Composit.header:
theorem exists_cond (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (p : List Bool → Bool)
    (hD : D.Computes fun x => [p x]) :
    ∃ M : FinTM Bool, ∀ x w : List Bool,
      (∃ t, M.ComputesInTime x w t) ↔
        ∃ t, (cond (p x) M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x w t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.name: Turing.pairDiag_double
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.header:
private lemma pairDiag_double (x : List Bool) : ∀ t, (ht : t ≤ x.length) →
    pairDiagTM.tm.runFrom (pairDiagTM.tm.initCfg x) (2 * t) =
      pairDiagCfg x (some 0) ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩ ((x.take t).flatMap fun b => [b, b])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.name: Turing.pairDiag_rewind

private lemma pairDiag_rewind (x out : List Bool) : ∀ j, (hj : j ≤ x.length) →
    pairDiagTM.tm.runFrom (pairDiagCfg x (some 4) ⟨j, by omega⟩ out) (j + 1) =
      pairDiagCfg x (some 5) 1 out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Encoding.name: Turing.pairDiag_copy
