private lemma loopHost_release (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) :
    (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.step
        (loopCall body F anchor true {c with state := none} false (some false) word fuel) =
      loopCall body F anchor false {c with state := some anchor} true none word fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_start (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (s : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x)
    (hguard : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) u).state ≠ some anchor)
    (hend : body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) :
    (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.runFrom (loopReady body F fuel) (t + 2) =
      loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s))
        true none fuel.output fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_halt_return
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_halt_return (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (t : ℕ) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hlive : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ none)
    (hanchor : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < t → (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor)
    (hend : (body.tm.runFrom c t).state = none) :
    (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (loopCall body F anchor false c true none word fuel) t =
      loopCall body F anchor false (body.tm.runFrom c t) false (some true) word fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopCall_reframe
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopCall_reframe (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (startup startup' release release' : Bool) (flag flag' : Option Bool)
    (word word' : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (q : Option body.State) :
    loopFrame body F (loopCall body F anchor startup c release flag word fuel)
        (loopCall body F anchor startup' {c with state := q} release' flag' word' fuel).state
        c.inputPos (fun z => if z = 0 then flag' else none) (bufferTape word')
        (bufferTape c.output) 0 c.output.length [] =
      loopCall body F anchor startup' {c with state := q} release' flag' word' fuel

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopCall_frame
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopCall_frame (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    {x : List Bool} (startup : Bool) (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (release : Bool) (flag : Option Bool) (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) :
    loopCall body F anchor startup c release flag word fuel =
      loopFrame body F (loopCall body F anchor startup c release flag word fuel)
        (loopCall body F anchor startup c release flag word fuel).state c.inputPos
        (fun z => if z = 0 then flag else none) (bufferTape word) (bufferTape c.output)
        0 c.output.length []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_borrow_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_borrow_step (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre rest : List Bool) :
    (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.step
      (loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 8))) p (bufferTape [])
        (bufferTape (pre ++ rest)) (bufferTape []) pre.length 0 []) =
      match rest with
      | [] => loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 10))) p (bufferTape [])
          (bufferTape pre) (bufferTape []) (pre.length - 1) 0 []
      | true :: us => loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 9))) p (bufferTape [])
          (bufferTape (pre ++ false :: us)) (bufferTape []) (pre.length - 1) 0 []
      | false :: us => loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 8))) p (bufferTape [])
          (bufferTape (pre ++ true :: us)) (bufferTape []) (pre.length + 1) 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_borrow_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_borrow_run (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (word : List Bool) : ∀ pre,
    (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.runFrom
        (loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 8))) p (bufferTape [])
          (bufferTape (pre ++ word)) (bufferTape []) pre.length 0 [])
        (loopBorrowPos word + 1) =
      loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr (if (loopDebit word).2 then 9 else 10)))) p
        (bufferTape []) (bufferTape (pre ++ (loopDebit word).1)) (bufferTape [])
        ((pre.length : ℤ) + loopBorrowPos word - 1) 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_borrow_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_borrow_rewind (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (word : List Bool) (success : Bool) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ word.length →
    (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.runFrom
        (loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr (if success then 9 else 10)))) p
          (bufferTape []) (bufferTape word) (bufferTape []) ((j : ℤ) - 1) 0 []) (j + 1) =
      loopFrame body F base
        (some (if success then .inr (.inl (false, (anchor, true))) else .inr (.inr 11))) p
        (bufferTape []) (bufferTape word) (bufferTape []) 0 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_borrow
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_borrow (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (word : List Bool) :
    2 * loopBorrowPos word + 2 ≤ 2 * word.length + 2 ∧
    (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.runFrom
        (loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 8))) p (bufferTape [])
          (bufferTape word) (bufferTape []) 0 0 []) (2 * loopBorrowPos word + 2) =
      loopFrame body F base
        (some (if (loopDebit word).2 then .inr (.inl (false, (anchor, true)))
          else .inr (.inr 11))) p
        (bufferTape []) (bufferTape (loopDebit word).1) (bufferTape []) 0 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopFrame_flag
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopFrame_flag (body F : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)
    (q : Option (LoopHostState body F)) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (flag counter payload : ℤ → Option Bool) (ch ph : ℤ) (out : List Bool) :
    (loopFrame body F base q p flag counter payload ch ph out).workTapeSymbols
        ⟨body.k, by omega⟩ = flag 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopFlag_clear
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopFlag_clear (flag : Option Bool) :
    loopWrite (fun z : ℤ => if z = 0 then flag else none) 0 (some none) = bufferTape []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_reject
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_reject (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x)
    (hc : c.state = none) (ho : c.output = []) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * word.length + 4,
      if (loopDebit word).2 then
        (loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.runFrom
            (loopCall body F anchor false c false (some false) word fuel) t =
          loopCall body F anchor false {c with state := some anchor} true none (loopDebit word).1 fuel
      else
        ((loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.runFrom
          (loopCall body F anchor false c false (some false) word fuel) t).state = none ∧
        ((loopHostM body F anchor forward findMode).tm.runFrom
          (loopCall body F anchor false c false (some false) word fuel) t).output =
            (if findMode then [] else [false])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_frame_replay
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_frame_replay (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (flag counter : ℤ → Option Bool) (ch : ℤ) (word : List Bool) :
    let c := loopFrame body F base (some (.inr (.inr 13))) p flag counter (bufferTape word) ch 0 []
    ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom c (word.length + 1)).state = none ∧
    ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom c (word.length + 1)).output = word

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_accept
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_accept (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (hc : c.state = none) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * c.output.length + 3,
      ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (loopCall body F anchor false c false (some true) word fuel) t).state = none ∧
      ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (loopCall body F anchor false c false (some true) word fuel) t).output =
          (if findMode then c.output else [true])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_round
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_round (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) {x : List Bool} (s next payload : List Bool) (accepted : Bool)
    (word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hanchor : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < t →
      (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) u).state ≠ some anchor)
    (hend : if accepted then
      (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧
      (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = payload
      else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next)) :
    ∃ v ≤ 3 * t + 2 * word.length + 5,
      let start := loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel
      if accepted then
        ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom start v).state = none ∧
        ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom start v).output =
          (if findMode then payload else [true])
      else if (loopDebit word).2 then
        (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom start v =
          loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next))
            true none (loopDebit word).1 fuel
      else ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom start v).state = none ∧
        ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom start v).output =
          (if findMode then [] else [false])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopCall_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopCall_heads (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (x s word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x) (B : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ i, -(B : ℤ) ≤ fuel.workTapePos i ∧ fuel.workTapePos i ≤ B) :
    ∀ i, -(B : ℤ) ≤ (loopCall body F anchor false
        (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel).workTapePos i ∧
      (loopCall body F anchor false
        (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel).workTapePos i ≤ B

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_bound
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header: private def loopHost_bound : ℕ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHost_contracts
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma loopHost_contracts (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (findMode : Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = out x s
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    ∀ x : List Bool,
      ∃ (cfg : ℕ → Cfg (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).k Bool
          (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).State x) (startup : ℕ),
        startup ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) ∧
        (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
          ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0 ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, (cfg i).output = []) ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).state = none ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).output = (if findMode then [] else [false]) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∃ t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1),
          if acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) then
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output =
              (if findMode then out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) else [true])
          else (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = cfg (i + 1)) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∀ j,
          -(T x.length : ℤ) ≤ (cfg i).workTapePos j ∧
          (cfg i).workTapePos j ≤ T x.length) ∧
        (∀ j, -((T x.length + 10 * (T x.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤
          (cfg (R x.length + 1)).workTapePos j ∧
          (cfg (R x.length + 1)).workTapePos j ≤
            (T x.length + 10 * (T x.length + 1) : ℕ))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.segment_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma segment_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x) (N B H : ℕ)
    (hseam : ∀ j < N, ∀ i, -(H : ℤ) ≤ (cfg j).workTapePos i ∧
      (cfg j).workTapePos i ≤ H)
    (hend : (cfg N).state = none)
    (hterminal : ∀ i, -((H + B : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (cfg N).workTapePos i ∧
      (cfg N).workTapePos i ≤ (H + B : ℕ))
    (hsegment : ∀ j < N, ∃ u ≤ B,
      (tm.runFrom (cfg j) u).state = none ∨ tm.runFrom (cfg j) u = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∀ t i, -((H + B : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).workTapePos i ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).workTapePos i ≤ (H + B : ℕ)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.seamed_space
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma seamed_space (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (cfg : ℕ → Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (N B H startup : ℕ)
    (hstart : startup ≤ B) (hinit : M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0)
    (hseam : ∀ j < N, ∀ i, -(H : ℤ) ≤ (cfg j).workTapePos i ∧
      (cfg j).workTapePos i ≤ H)
    (hend : (cfg N).state = none)
    (hterminal : ∀ i, -((H + B : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (cfg N).workTapePos i ∧
      (cfg N).workTapePos i ≤ (H + B : ℕ))
    (hsegment : ∀ j < N, ∃ u ≤ B,
      (M.tm.runFrom (cfg j) u).state = none ∨ M.tm.runFrom (cfg j) u = cfg (j + 1))
    (t : ℕ) : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ M.k * (2 * (H + B) + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.loopHostTM_contracts
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
theorem loopHostTM_contracts (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (findMode : Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = out x s
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    ∀ x : List Bool,
      ∃ (cfg : ℕ → Cfg (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).k Bool
          (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).State x) (startup : ℕ),
        startup ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) ∧
        (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
          ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0 ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, (cfg i).output = []) ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).state = none ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).output = (if findMode then [] else [false]) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∃ t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1),
          if acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) then
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output =
              (if findMode then out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) else [true])
          else (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = cfg (i + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_loopCfgTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
theorem exists_loopCfgTM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = [true]
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    ∃ (E : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), ∀ x : List Bool,
      ∃ (cfg : ℕ → Cfg E.k Bool E.State x) (startup : ℕ),
        startup ≤ c * (T x.length + 1) ∧
        E.tm.runFrom (E.tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0 ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, (cfg i).output = []) ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).state = none ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).output = [false] ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∃ t ≤ c * (T x.length + 1),
          if acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) then
            (E.tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧
            (E.tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output = [true]
          else E.tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = cfg (i + 1))

    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)

    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then

            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧

            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = [true]

            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    (loopHostTM body F anchor false).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any
        fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))])
      (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_first_entry {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (stop : S → Prop) [DecidablePred stop]
    (c d : Cfg k Bool S w) (T : ℕ)
    (hfix : ∀ z : Cfg k Bool S w, (∃ q, z.state = some q ∧ stop q) → tm.step z = z)
    (hd : ∃ q, d.state = some q ∧ stop q) (hT : tm.runFrom c T = d) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (∀ j < t, ¬∃ q, (tm.runFrom c j).state = some q ∧ stop q) ∧
      tm.runFrom c t = d

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_clear_first
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_clear_first (M : FinTM Bool) (x w : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (w.length + 2)) (T : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ 6 * T + 7 ∧
      (∀ j < t, (emCallClearTM.tm.runFrom
        (emCallClearCfg w p 0 ((M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T).workTapes i)
          (emCallSpan (emCallLo M x T i) (emCallHi M x T i)) (bufferTape [true])
          ((M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T).workTapePos i)) j).state ≠ some (3 : Fin 4)) ∧
      emCallClearTM.tm.runFrom
        (emCallClearCfg w p 0 ((M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T).workTapes i)
          (emCallSpan (emCallLo M x T i) (emCallHi M x T i)) (bufferTape [true])
          ((M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T).workTapePos i)) t =
        emCallClearCfg w p 3 (fun _ => none) (fun _ => none) (fun _ => none) 0

      (emCallRightTM M).tm.runFrom (emCallRightScan M c (some true) j hj) (r + 1) =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:

    (hM : M.ComputesInTime x out T) :
    (emCallRightTM M).ComputesInTime x out (T + x.length + 2) ∧
      ((emCallRightTM M).tm.runFrom ((emCallRightTM M).tm.initCfg x)
        (T + x.length + 2)).inputPos.val = x.length + 1

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_prepared_eval_first
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_prepared_eval_first (M : FinTM Bool) (w s out : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hM : M.ComputesInTime s out T) :
    let R := emCallRightTM (emCallTrackTM M)
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ 1 + 2 * T + s.length + 2 ∧
      (∀ j < t, ((emCallEvalTM R).tm.runFrom
        (emCallEvalCfg (w := w) R (R.tm.initCfg s) true 1) j).state ≠ some (.inr ())) ∧
      (emCallEvalTM R).tm.runFrom
        (emCallEvalCfg (w := w) R (R.tm.initCfg s) true 1) t =
          emCallEvalCfg (w := w) R
            (emCallRightScan (emCallTrackTM M)
              (emCallTrackCfg M (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg s) T)
                (emCallLo M s T) (emCallHi M s T)) none s.length (le_refl _)) false 1

private lemma emCall_finish_arg (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool)

    (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 1
        (bufferTape (if emit then arg else pre)) (bufferTape cap)
        ((pre.length : ℤ) - 1) cap.length []) (pre.length + 1) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 2 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else []))
        (bufferTape cap) 0 ((cap.length : ℤ) - 1) []

    (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 2 arg (bufferTape cap) 0
        ((pre.length : ℤ) - 1) []) (pre.length + 1) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 3 arg (bufferTape cap) 0 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_finish_transfer
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_finish_transfer (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ rest pre : List Bool, cap = pre ++ rest →
    (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 3 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else pre))
        (bufferTape cap) (if emit then 0 else pre.length) pre.length
        (if emit then pre else [])) (rest.length + 1) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 4 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else cap))
        (bufferTape cap) (if emit then 0 else (cap.length : ℤ) - 1)
        ((cap.length : ℤ) - 1) (if emit then cap else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_finish_erase
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_finish_erase (emit : Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (arg : ℤ → Option Bool) (out : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre : List Bool, (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 4 arg (bufferTape pre)
        (if emit then 0 else (pre.length : ℤ) - 1) ((pre.length : ℤ) - 1) out)
        (pre.length + 1) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 5 arg (fun _ => none) 0 0 out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_finish_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_finish_run (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
    (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 0 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap)
        arg.length cap.length []) (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 5) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 5 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else cap))
        (fun _ => none) 0 0 (if emit then cap else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_bank_embed (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) (j : ℕ) (q : Fin 4)
    (hrest : ∀ l : Fin M.k, l ≠ i → (l.val < i.val ↔ l.val < j)) :
    let frame := emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T i.val (.inr (.inl (i.castSucc, 0)))
    emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallTripleEmbedding M i) (fun s => .inr (.inl (i.castSucc, s)))
      frame.workTapes frame.workTapePos
      (emCallClearCfg x 1 q
        (if i.val < j then fun _ => none else
          (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T).workTapes i)
        (if i.val < j then fun _ => none else
          emCallSpan (emCallLo M arg T i) (emCallHi M arg T i))
        (if i.val < j then fun _ => none else bufferTape [true])
        (if i.val < j then 0 else (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T).workTapePos i)) =
      emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T j (.inr (.inl (i.castSucc, q)))

    emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallTripleEmbedding M i) (fun q => .inr (.inl (i.castSucc, q)))
      frame.workTapes frame.workTapePos
      (emCallClearCfg x 1 0 ((M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T).workTapes i)
        (emCallSpan (emCallLo M arg T i) (emCallHi M arg T i)) (bufferTape [true])
        ((M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T).workTapePos i)) = frame

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:

    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
    let frame := emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T i.val (.inr (.inl (i.castSucc, 0)))
    emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallTripleEmbedding M i) (fun q => .inr (.inl (i.castSucc, q)))
      frame.workTapes frame.workTapePos
      (emCallClearCfg x 1 3 (fun _ => none) (fun _ => none) (fun _ => none) 0) =
      emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T (i.val + 1) (.inr (.inl (i.castSucc, 3)))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_bank_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_bank_step (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
    ∃ t ≤ 6 * T + 8,
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_banks_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:

    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ M.k),
    ∃ t ≤ j * (6 * T + 8),
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T 0 (.inr (.inl (0, 0)))) t =

Turing.FinTM.emCall_prepare_final
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:

    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hout : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T).output = cap) :
    emCallEmbeddedCfg (Function.Embedding.refl _) (Sum.inl : (emCallSource M).State → emCallState M)
      (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
      (emCallEvalCfg (w := x) (emCallRightTM (emCallTrackTM M))
        (emCallRightScan (emCallTrackTM M)
          (emCallTrackCfg M (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T)
            (emCallLo M arg T) (emCallHi M arg T)) none arg.length (le_refl _)) false 1) =
      emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T 0 (.inl (.inr ()))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_prepare_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_prepare_run (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * T + arg.length + 4,
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T 0 (.inr (.inl (0, 0)))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_finish_initial
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_finish_initial (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool)
    (T : ℕ) :
    emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallPairEmbedding M) (fun q => .inr (.inr q) : Fin 6 → emCallState M)
      (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x 1 0 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap) arg.length cap.length []) =
      emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T M.k (.inr (.inr 0))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_finish_final
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_finish_final (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool) :
    emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallPairEmbedding M) (fun q => .inr (.inr q) : Fin 6 → emCallState M)
      (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x 1 5 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else cap))
        (fun _ => none) 0 0 (if emit then cap else [])) =
      { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)) : emCallState M)
          (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
        with output := if emit then cap else [] }

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_finalize_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_finalize_run (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) :
    (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T M.k (.inr (.inl (Fin.last M.k, 0))))
      (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 6) =
      { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)) : emCallState M)
          (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
        with output := if emit then cap else [] }

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_complete
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_complete (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)) : emCallState M)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] }

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_exit_fixed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:

    (z : Cfg (callTM M emit).k Bool (callTM M emit).State x)
    (hz : z.state = some (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)))) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emCall_first
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emCall_first (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      0 < t ∧
      (∀ j < t, ((callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) j).state
          ≠ some (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)))) ∧
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)) : emCallState M)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] }

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emLoopHost
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private abbrev emLoopHost (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (findMode : Bool) :
    FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emitLoopTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header: abbrev emitLoopTM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emLoopHost_round
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emLoopHost_round (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    {x : List Bool} (s next chunk word : List Bool) (fuel : Cfg F.k Bool F.State x)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hanchor : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < t →
      (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) u).state ≠ some anchor)
    (hend : body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
      { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k next) with output := chunk }) :
    ∃ v ≤ t + 2 * word.length + 5,
      if (loopDebit word).2 then
        (emLoopHost body F anchor true).tm.runFrom
          (loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) v =
          {loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k next))
            true none (loopDebit word).1 fuel with output := chunk}
      else
        ((emLoopHost body F anchor true).tm.runFrom
          (loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) v).state = none ∧
        ((emLoopHost body F anchor true).tm.runFrom
          (loopCall body F anchor false (Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k s)) true none word fuel) v).output = chunk

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emLoop_sum
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
private lemma emLoop_sum {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (chunk : ℕ → List Bool) (B : ℕ) : ∀ N,
    (∀ i < N, (cfg i).output = []) →
    (∀ i < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if i + 1 < N then tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = {cfg (i + 1) with output := chunk i}
      else (tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧ (tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output = chunk i) →
    0 < N → ∀ pre, ∃ t ≤ N * B,
      (tm.runFrom {cfg 0 with output := pre} t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom {cfg 0 with output := pre} t).output =
        pre ++ (List.range N).flatMap chunk

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.emitLoopTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
theorem emitLoopTM_computes (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF emitF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        body.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
            { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))
                with output := emitF x s }) :
    (emitLoopTM body F anchor).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => (List.range (R x.length + 1)).flatMap
        (fun i => emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))))
      (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_emitLoopTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
theorem exists_emitLoopTM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF emitF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        body.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
            { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))
                with output := emitF x s }) :
    ∃ (E : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      E.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun x => (List.range (R x.length + 1)).flatMap
          (fun i => emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))))
        (fun n => c * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.callTM_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
theorem callTM_run (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      0 < t ∧
      (∀ j < t, ((callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) j).state
          ≠ some (callExit M emit)) ∧
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callExit M emit)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] }

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_installCallTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
theorem exists_installCallTM (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool)
    (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (c : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ (x arg : List Bool),
        ∃ t ≤ c * (T arg.length + arg.length + (f arg).length + 1),
          0 < t ∧
          (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
            (C.tm.runFrom
              (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t').state
                ≠ some exit) ∧
          C.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f arg))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.name: Turing.FinTM.exists_emitCallTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Lo.header:
theorem exists_emitCallTM (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool)
    (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (c : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ (x arg : List Bool),
        ∃ t ≤ c * (T arg.length + arg.length + (f arg).length + 1),
          0 < t ∧
          (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
            (C.tm.runFrom
              (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t').state
                ≠ some exit) ∧
          C.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t =
              { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) exit (stateWord C.k arg)
                  with output := f arg }

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.prependTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header: def prependTM (w : List Bool) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.prependTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem prependTM_spaceUsed (w x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (prependTM w).tm.spaceUsed ((prependTM w).tm.initCfg x) t = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPrefixCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private def catalogPrefixCfg (w x : List Bool) (q : Option (Fin (w.length + 1)))
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (out : List Bool) : Cfg 0 Bool (Fin (w.length + 1)) x

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPrefixTM_emit
Turing.FinTM.catalogPrefixTM_copy
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPrefixTM_copy (w x : List Bool) : ∀ i (hi : i ≤ x.length),
    (prependTM w).tm.runFrom
      (catalogPrefixCfg w x (some ⟨w.length, by omega⟩) 1 w) i =
      catalogPrefixCfg w x (some ⟨w.length, by omega⟩) ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩
        (w ++ x.take i)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.prependTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem prependTM_computes (w : List Bool) :
    (prependTM w).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => w ++ x) (fun n => w.length + n + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanCfg
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private def scanCfg {S : Type} (x : List Bool) (q : Option S)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) : Cfg 0 Bool S x

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanCfg_read
Turing.FinTM.scanCopy_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma scanCopy_run {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = match inp with
      | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some q⟩
      | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩)
    (x out : List Bool) : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ x.length),
    tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some q) 0 (by omega) out) j =
      scanCfg x (some q) j hj (out ++ x.take j)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanCopy_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma scanCopy_finish {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = match inp with
      | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some q⟩
      | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩)
    (x out : List Bool) :
    tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some q) 0 (by omega) out) (x.length + 1) =
      scanCfg x none x.length (by omega) (out ++ x)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanCopy_suffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma scanCopy_suffix {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = match inp with
      | some b => ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, some b, some q⟩
      | none => ⟨0, fun j => j.elim0, none, none⟩)
    (x rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some q) pre.length (by simp [hx]) out) (rest.length + 1) =
      scanCfg x none x.length (by omega) (out ++ rest)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanTrues_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma scanTrues_run {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S) (q : S)
    (emit : Bool)
    (htr : ∀ work, tm.tr q (some true) work =
      ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, if emit then some false else none, some q⟩)
    (x : List Bool) : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ x.length),
    x.take j = List.replicate j true →
    tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some q) 0 (by omega) []) j =
      scanCfg x (some q) j hj (if emit then List.replicate j false else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.incFixed_cases
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma incFixed_cases (x : List Bool) :
    (x = List.replicate x.length true ∧ incFixed x = none) ∨
      ∃ j rest, x = List.replicate j true ++ false :: rest ∧
        incFixed x = some (List.replicate j false ++ true :: rest)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.incFixedTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header: def incFixedTM : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.incFixedTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem incFixedTM_computes (x : List Bool) :
    incFixedTM.ComputesInTime x ((incFixed x).getD []) (3 * (x.length + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.scanStep_right
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma scanStep_right {S : Type} (tm : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool S)
    (x : List Bool) (q : S) (q' : Option S) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length)
    (out : List Bool) (emit : Option Bool)
    (htr : ∀ work, tm.tr q x[i]? work = ⟨.pos, fun j => j.elim0, emit, q'⟩) :
    tm.step (scanCfg x (some q) i (by omega) out) =
      scanCfg x q' (i + 1) (by omega) (out ++ emit.toList)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairValidTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header: def pairValidTM : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairValidTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairValidTM_spaceUsed (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    pairValidTM.tm.spaceUsed (pairValidTM.tm.initCfg x) t = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairValid_block
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma pairValid_block (x pre rest : List Bool) (b c : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: c :: rest) :
    pairValidTM.tm.runFrom (scanCfg x (some none) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) 2 =
      if b = c then scanCfg x (some none) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) []
      else scanCfg x none (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) [!b && c]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairValid_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma pairValid_run (x rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1,
      (pairValidTM.tm.runFrom
        (scanCfg x (some none) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) t).state = none ∧
      (pairValidTM.tm.runFrom
        (scanCfg x (some none) pre.length (by simp [hx]) []) t).output =
          [(pairDecode rest).isSome]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairValidTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairValidTM_computes (x : List Bool) :
    pairValidTM.ComputesInTime x [(pairDecode x).isSome] (x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header: def pairExtractTM (first second : Bool) : FinTM Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extractCfg
Turing.FinTM.extractCfg_read
Turing.FinTM.extract_first
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_first (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.step
      (extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) =
      extractCfg x (some (.inl (some b))) (pre.length + 1) (by simp [hx]) a a.length []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_block
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_block (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b c : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: c :: rest) :
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) 2 =
      if b = c then extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx])
          (a ++ [b]) (a ++ [b]).length []
      else if b then extractCfg x none (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) a a.length []
      else extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) (pre.length + 2) (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_rewind (first second : Bool) (x a : List Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : ∀ j, j ≤ a.length →
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) i hi a ((j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) =
      extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.bufferReplay_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma bufferReplay_run {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool S) (q : S) (emit : Bool)
    (htr : ∀ (inp : Option Bool) (bit : Bool), tm.tr q inp (fun _ => some bit) =
      ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), if emit then some bit else none, some q⟩)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a : List Bool) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ a.length),
    tm.runFrom (⟨some q, p, fun _ => bufferTape a, fun _ => 0, []⟩ : Cfg 1 Bool S x) j =
      (⟨some q, p, fun _ => bufferTape a, fun _ => (j : ℤ),
        if emit then a.take j else []⟩ : Cfg 1 Bool S x)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_replay
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_replay (first second : Bool) (x a : List Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ a.length),
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a 0 []) j =
      extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a j (if first then a.take j else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_replay_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_replay_finish (first second : Bool) (x a : List Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inr 1)) i hi a 0 []) (a.length + 1) =
      extractCfg x (some (.inr 2)) i hi a a.length (if first then a else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_suffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_suffix (first : Bool) (x rest a : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    (pairExtractTM first true).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inr 2)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length out)
        (rest.length + 1) =
      extractCfg x none x.length (by omega) a a.length (out ++ rest)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_finish (first second : Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ rest) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * a.length + rest.length + 3,
      ((pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []) t).state = none ∧
      ((pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (extractCfg x (some (.inr 0)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a (a.length - 1) []) t).output =
          (if first then a else []) ++ (if second then rest else [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.extract_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_run (first second : Bool) (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre a (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    ∃ t ≤ 3 * rest.length + 2 * a.length + 5,
      ((pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) t).state = none ∧
      ((pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
        (extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) t).output =
          match pairDecode rest with
          | some (b, c) => (if first then a ++ b else []) ++ (if second then c else [])
          | none => []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairExtractTM_computes (first second : Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (pairExtractTM first second).ComputesInTime x
      (match pairDecode x with
        | some (a, b) => (if first then a else []) ++ (if second then b else [])
        | none => []) (5 * (x.length + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_fst
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairExtractTM_fst :
    (pairExtractTM true false).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => ((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1))

      (fun z => match pairDecode z with

        | none => []) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1))

Turing.FinTM.extract_scan
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma extract_scan (first second : Bool) (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ (w pre a : List Bool) (hx : x = pre ++ dbl w ++ rest),
    (pairExtractTM first second).tm.runFrom
      (extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) a a.length []) (2 * w.length) =
      extractCfg x (some (.inl none)) (pre.length + 2 * w.length)
        (by simp [hx]) (a ++ w) (a ++ w).length []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_fst_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairExtractTM_fst_run (a b : List Bool) :
    (pairExtractTM true false).tm.runFrom
        ((pairExtractTM true false).tm.initCfg (pairEncode a b)) (4 * a.length + 5) =
      ⟨none, ⟨2 * a.length + 3, by simp [length_pairEncode]; omega⟩,
        fun _ => bufferTape a, fun _ => (a.length : ℤ), a⟩ ∧
    ∀ u < 4 * a.length + 5, ((pairExtractTM true false).tm.runFrom
        ((pairExtractTM true false).tm.initCfg (pairEncode a b)) u).state ≠ none

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairExtractTM_fst_run_budget
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairExtractTM_fst_run_budget (a b : List Bool) :
    let M := pairExtractTM true false
    let d := M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg (pairEncode a b)) (5 * ((pairEncode a b).length + 1))
    d.state = none ∧ d.output = a ∧ d.inputPos.val = 2 * a.length + 3 ∧
      ∀ j : Fin M.k, d.workTapes j = bufferTape a ∧ d.workTapePos j = (a.length : ℤ)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPolyMove_apply {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (s s' : CatalogPolyControl c C) (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (o : List Bool)
    (i : Fin (c + 1)) (d : SignType) :
    (catalogPolyMove i d s').apply (catalogPolyCfg x q s h o) =
      catalogPolyCfg x q s' (Function.update h i (h i + d.cast)) o

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_emit
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_emit {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ C) (o : List Bool),
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (catalogPolyCfg x q (.emit ⟨j, by omega⟩) h o) (j + 1) =
      catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance 0) h (o ++ List.replicate j true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_rewind
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_rewind {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (o : List Bool) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ q),
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (catalogPolyCfg x q (.rewind i) (Function.update h i ((j : ℤ) - 1)) o) (j + 1) =
      catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩) (Function.update h i 0) o

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_advance
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_advance {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ)
    (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ) (o : List Bool) (i : Fin (c + 1)) :
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.step
      (catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) h o) =
      catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop i) (Function.update h i (h i + 1)) o

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPolyCost
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header: private def catalogPolyCost (q C : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_loop
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_loop {c C : ℕ} (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) (_hq : 0 < q) :
    ∀ i (hi : i < c + 1) (h : Fin (c + 1) → ℤ)
      (_hh : ∀ k, k.val ≤ i → h k = 0) (o : List Bool) (r j : ℕ), j + r = q →
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (catalogPolyCfg x q (.loop ⟨i, hi⟩) (Function.update h ⟨i, hi⟩ (j : ℤ)) o)
      (r * (catalogPolyCost q C i + 2) + q + 2) =
      catalogPolyCfg x q (.advance ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩) h
        (o ++ List.replicate (r * (C * q ^ i)) true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPolyTape_write (q : ℕ) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPolyCost_le
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPolyCost_le (q C : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) : ∀ r,
    catalogPolyCost q C r ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * r) * q ^ r

Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_setup
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_setup (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (q : ℕ) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ q),
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (catalogPolyCfg x q .setup (fun _ => (j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma catalogPoly_start (c C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.catalogPoly_unary_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:

    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ (c + 1)) true)
      (fun n => (C + 5 * (c + 1) + 4) * (n + 1) ^ (c + 1))

Turing.FinTM.lenAction_apply
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma lenAction_apply (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (q q' : Option (pairCountTM M).State)
    (i j r s : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (hj : j ≤ x.length)
    (m d : SignType) (b : Option Bool)
    (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) m = ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩)
    (hd : (r : ℤ) - 1 + d.cast = (s : ℤ) - 1) :
    (lenAction M m d b q').apply (lenCfg M c q i hi r) =
      {lenCfg M c q' j hj s with output := b.toList}

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.lenSuffix_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma lenSuffix_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest) r, r ≤ c.output.length →
    ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1,
      ((pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).state = none ∧
      ((pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inl 3))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).output =
          [decide (rest.length ≤ r)]

private lemma lenParse_first (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (pre rest : List Bool) (b : Bool) (r : ℕ)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    (pairCountTM M).tm.step
      (lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) =
      lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr (some b)))) (pre.length + 1) (by simp [hx]) r

Turing.FinTM.lenParse_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma lenParse_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre (hx : x = pre ++ rest) r, r ≤ c.output.length →
    ∃ t ≤ rest.length + 1,
      ((pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).state = none ∧
      ((pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom
        (lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) pre.length (by simp [hx]) r) t).output =
          [match pairDecode rest with
            | some (_, b) => decide (b.length ≤ r)
            | none => false]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.lenStart
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma lenStart (M : FinTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w T) :
    ∃ t ≤ T + x.length + 4, ∃ c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x,
      c.output = w ∧
      (pairCountTM M).tm.runFrom ((pairCountTM M).tm.initCfg x) t =
        lenCfg M c (some (.inr (.inr none))) 0 (by omega) c.output.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairCount_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma pairCount_computes {M : FinTM Bool} {g : List Bool → List Bool}
    {T : ℕ → ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime g T) :
    (pairCountTM M).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => [match pairDecode x with
        | some (_, b) => decide (b.length ≤ (g x).length)
        | none => false]) (fun n => T n + 2 * n + 5)

      (2 * (a.length + 1))).state = none ∧

      (2 * (a.length + 1))).output = a

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.rawStrip_erase

      (stripCfg x (some 1) i hi (w ++ [b]) ((w ++ [b]).length - 1) []) =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.rawStrip_trim

private lemma rawStrip_trim (x w : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) :

      (rawStripTM.tm.runFrom (stripCfg x (some 1) i hi w (w.length - 1) []) t).output =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:

    (c : Cfg (d + 1) Bool (CatalogPolyControl d C) x)

    (hp : polyHeads q c.state c.workTapePos) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_move (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (q q' : Option (FwdMapState M.State)) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (a b : List Bool) (ha hb : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (mi ma mb : SignType) (emit : Option Bool) :
    (fwdMapAct M mi (none, ma) (none, mb) emit q').apply
      (fwdMapCfg M x q p a b ha hb out) =
      fwdMapCfg M x q' (moveInputPos p mi) a b (ha + ma.cast) (hb + mb.cast)
        (out ++ emit.toList)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_first
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_first (M : FinTM Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.step
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] a.length 0 []) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse (some b))) ⟨pre.length + 2, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] a.length 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_block
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_block (M : FinTM Bool) (x pre rest a : List Bool) (b c : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: c :: rest) :
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] a.length 0 []) 2 =
      if b = c then fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none))
        ⟨pre.length + 3, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩ (a ++ [b]) [] (a ++ [b]).length 0 []
      else if b then fwdMapCfg M x none
        ⟨pre.length + 3, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩ a [] a.length 0 []
      else fwdMapCfg M x (some .copyB)
        ⟨pre.length + 3, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩ a [] (a.length - 1) 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_suffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_suffix (M : FinTM Bool) (x rest a : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre b (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some .copyB) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a b (a.length - 1) b.length []) (rest.length + 1) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some .backB) ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩
        a (b ++ rest) (a.length - 1) ((b ++ rest).length - 1) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_back
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_back (second : Bool) (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (other : ℤ) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ (if second then b else a).length →
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some (if second then .backB else .backA)) p a b
        (if second then other else (j : ℤ) - 1)
        (if second then (j : ℤ) - 1 else other) []) (j + 1) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some (if second then .backA else .emitA)) p a b
        (if second then other else 0) (if second then 0 else other) []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_backB
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_backB (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ j, j ≤ b.length →
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some .backB) p a b (a.length - 1) ((j : ℤ) - 1) []) (j + 1) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some .backA) p a b (a.length - 1) 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_backA
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_backA (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ j, j ≤ a.length →
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some .backA) p a b ((j : ℤ) - 1) 0 []) (j + 1) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some .emitA) p a b 0 0 []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_emit
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_emit (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b rest : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ pre out, a = pre ++ rest →
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some .emitA) p a b pre.length 0 out) (2 * rest.length + 2) =
      fwdMapCfg M x (some (.run M.tm.q₀ true)) p a b a.length 0
        (out ++ rest.flatMap (fun d => [d, d]) ++ [false, true])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_finish (M : FinTM Bool) (x pre a b : List Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b) :
    (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
      (fwdMapCfg M x (some .copyB) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
        a [] (a.length - 1) 0 []) (3 * a.length + 2 * b.length + 5) =
      fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_parse
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_parse (M : FinTM Bool) (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre a (hx : x = pre ++ rest), ∃ t ≤ 3 * rest.length + 3 * a.length + 5,
      match pairDecode rest with
      | some (d, b) => (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
          (fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
            a [] a.length 0 []) t =
          fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩
            (a ++ d) (pairEncode (a ++ d) [])
      | none =>
          ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
            (fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
              a [] a.length 0 []) t).state = none ∧
          ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom
            (fwdMapCfg M x (some (.parse none)) ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hx] <;> omega⟩
              a [] a.length 0 []) t).output = []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_setup
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_setup (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    ∃ t ≤ 5 * (x.length + 1),
      match pairDecode x with
      | some (a, b) => (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t =
          fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a [])
      | none => ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t).state = none ∧
          ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t).output = []

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMapVirtual_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMapVirtual_step (M : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y) (tag : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos tag)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a pre : List Bool) :
    ∃ tag', VirtualTag (M.tm.step c).inputPos tag' ∧
      (fwdMapTM M true).tm.step (fwdMapVirtual M c tag p a pre) =
        fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.step c) tag' p a pre

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMapVirtual_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMapVirtual_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y) (tag : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos tag)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ tag', VirtualTag (M.tm.runFrom c t).inputPos tag' ∧
      (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom (fwdMapVirtual M c tag p a pre) t =
        fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.runFrom c t) tag' p a pre

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMapSetup_run

Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_launch
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_launch (M : FinTM Bool) (x a b : List Bool)
    (hd : pairDecode x = some (a, b)) :
    ∃ u ≤ 5 * (x.length + 1),
      (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u =
        fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a []) ∧
      ∀ v ≤ u, (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) v =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_reject
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_reject (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool)

    ∃ u ≤ 5 * (x.length + 1),
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).state = none ∧
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).output = [] ∧
      ∀ v, (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) v =
        (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) v

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.fwdMap_space
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma fwdMap_space (M : FinTM Bool) (x y : List Bool) (t D S : ℕ)
    (hfirst : ∀ u ≤ t, -(D : ℤ) ≤
        ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.castAdd (1 + M.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ∧
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.castAdd (1 + M.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ≤ D)
    (hsecond : ∀ u ≤ t, -(D : ℤ) ≤
        ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd M.k (0 : Fin 1))) ∧
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd M.k (0 : Fin 1))) ≤ D)
    (hsource : ∀ i, (fwdMapTM M true).tm.visitedByTapeHead ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) t
        (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) ⊆ M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg y) t i)
    (hs : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg y) t ≤ S) :
    (fwdMapTM M true).tm.spaceUsed ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) t ≤ S + 2 * (2 * D + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairMapSndTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairMapSndTM_computes {Mg : FinTM Bool} {g : List Bool → List Bool} {Tg : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hg : Mg.ComputesFunInTime g Tg) (hTg : Monotone Tg) :
    (pairMapSndTM Mg).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun z => match pairDecode z with
        | some (a, b) => pairEncode a (g b)
        | none => [])
      (fun n => 22 * (n + 1 + Tg n))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed {Mg : FinTM Bool} (Sg : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hgs : ∀ (y : List Bool) (t : ℕ), Mg.tm.spaceUsed (Mg.tm.initCfg y) t ≤ Sg y.length)
    (hSg : Monotone Sg) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (pairMapSndTM Mg).tm.spaceUsed ((pairMapSndTM Mg).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      Sg x.length + 22 * (x.length + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.pairLenCheckTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem pairLenCheckTM_computes (C e : ℕ) :
    (pairLenCheckTM C e).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => [match pairDecode x with
        | some (a, b) => decide (b.length ≤ C * (a.length + 1) ^ e)
        | none => false])
      (fun n => (C + 5 * e + 17) * ((n + 1) ^ e + n + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck (C e : ℕ) :

        (fun x => [match pairDecode x with
          | some (a, b) => decide (b.length ≤ C * (a.length + 1) ^ e)
          | none => false])
        fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.stripLastTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem stripLastTM_computes :
    stripLastTM.ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => match pairDecode x with
        | some (a, v) =>
          match splitAtLastTrue v with
          | some u => pairEncode a u
          | none => []
        | none => [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_stripLast

theorem computesFunInTime_stripLast :

          | some (a, v) =>
            match splitAtLastTrue v with
            | some u => pairEncode a u
            | none => []
          | none => [])

Turing.FinTM.splitLoop_result
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitLoop_result (C e : ℕ) (w : List Bool) :
    (match (List.range (w.length + 1)).find?
        (fun i => splitAccept C e w ((splitStep w)^[i] [])) with
      | some i => pairEncode (w.take ((splitStep w)^[i] []).length)
          (w.drop ((splitStep w)^[i] []).length)
      | none => []) =
    (match solveSplit C e w.length with
      | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
      | none => [])

Turing.FinTM.splitCount_apply

    (w s : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S []) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    (splitCountAction emb ret (decide (w.length < s.length + c.output.length))

    (emb : S → Bool → H) (ret : Bool → H)
    (hagree : ∀ q over inp work, host.tr (emb q over) inp work =
      splitCountAction emb ret over inp (tm.tr q none (fun i => work i.succ)))
    (w s : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S []) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ j < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c j).Halted) :
    host.runFrom (splitCountCfg emb ret w s c) t =
      splitCountCfg emb ret w s (tm.runFrom c t)

    (hd : d.state = some q) (hT : tm.runFrom c T = d) :

        ≠ some (4, false)) ∧
      (splitRestoreTM k).tm.runFrom (splitRestoreScan k w s 0) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (4, false) (stateWord (k + 1) (splitStep w s))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitCount_accept

    (!decide (w.length < s.length + c.output.length) &&
      (splitCountCfg emb ret w s c).inputSymbol.isNone) =

private lemma splitEmbed_cut {k : ℕ} {S H : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM k Bool H)
    (emb : S → H) (anchor : H) (stop : S → Prop) [DecidablePred stop]
    (haway : ∀ q, emb q ≠ anchor)
    (hfix : ∀ c : Cfg k Bool S w, (∃ q, c.state = some q ∧ stop q) → tm.step c = c)
    (hagree : ∀ q, ¬stop q → ∀ inp work,
      host.tr (emb q) inp work = (tm.tr q inp work).mapState emb)
    (c d : Cfg k Bool S w) (T : ℕ)
    (hd : ∃ q, d.state = some q ∧ stop q) (hT : tm.runFrom c T = d) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, host.runFrom (c.mapState emb) t = d.mapState emb ∧
      splitSafe host anchor (c.mapState emb) t

Turing.FinTM.splitBody_prepare
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitBody_prepare (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (w s : List Bool) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * (s.length + 1),
      (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (.prepare (0, false)) (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) (t + 1) =
          splitCountCfg SplitBodyState.count SplitBodyState.check w s
            (splitBank M s (some start) []) ∧
      splitSafe (splitBodyTM M start).tm .anchor
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.prepare (0, false)) (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) (t + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitBody_count
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:

    (out : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hT : M.tm.runFrom (splitBank M s (some start) []) T = splitBank M s none out) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
      (splitCountCfg SplitBodyState.count SplitBodyState.check w s (splitBank M s (some start) [])) t =
      splitCountCfg SplitBodyState.count SplitBodyState.check w s (splitBank M s none out) ∧
      splitSafe (splitBodyTM M start).tm .anchor
        (splitCountCfg SplitBodyState.count SplitBodyState.check w s (splitBank M s (some start) [])) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitBody_rewind

private lemma splitBody_rewind (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (w : List Bool)
    (ok : Bool) (c : Cfg (M.k + 1) Bool (Fin 3) w)
    (hc : c.state = some 0) :
    ∃ t ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (c.mapState (SplitBodyState.rewind ok)) t =
        ({c with state := some (2 : Fin 3), inputPos := 1}).mapState (SplitBodyState.rewind ok) ∧
      splitSafe (splitBodyTM M start).tm .anchor (c.mapState (SplitBodyState.rewind ok)) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
