      (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
        ((splitRestoreScan M.k w s 0).mapState SplitBodyState.restore) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.restore (4, false)) (stateWord (M.k + 1) (splitStep w s)) ∧

        ((splitRestoreScan M.k w s 0).mapState SplitBodyState.restore) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:

    ∀ j, j ≤ s.length → (splitEmitTM k).tm.runFrom
      (splitEmitCfg k w s (some 0) 0 0 []) (2 * j) =
      splitEmitCfg k w s (some 0) j j ((w.take j).flatMap fun b => [b, b])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitEmit_separator
Turing.FinTM.splitEmit_suffix
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:

    ∀ pre out h, w = pre ++ rest → (splitEmitTM k).tm.runFrom
      (splitEmitCfg k w s (some 3) pre.length h out) (rest.length + 1) =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitEmit_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitEmit_run (k : ℕ) (w s : List Bool) (hs : s.length ≤ w.length) :
    (splitEmitTM k).tm.runFrom (splitEmitCfg k w s (some 0) 0 0 [])
      (s.length + w.length + 3) =
      splitEmitCfg k w s none w.length s.length
        (pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSafe_one
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitSafe_one {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d : Cfg k Bool S w)
    (he : tm.step c = d) (hc : c.state ≠ some anchor) (hd : d.state ≠ some anchor) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSafe_join
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitSafe_join {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d f : Cfg k Bool S w) (u v : ℕ)
    (h1 : tm.runFrom c u = d) (hs1 : splitSafe tm anchor c u)
    (h2 : tm.runFrom d v = f) (hs2 : splitSafe tm anchor d v) :
    tm.runFrom c (u + v) = f ∧ splitSafe tm anchor c (u + v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitBody_round
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitBody_round (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (w s out : List Bool)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : M.tm.runFrom (splitBank M s (some start) []) T = splitBank M s none out) :
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T + 5 * s.length + 3 * w.length + 20 ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < j → j < t →
        ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) j).state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      if decide (s.length + out.length = w.length) then
        ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t).state = none ∧
        ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t).output =
            pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
      else (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) s)) t =
          Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (M.k + 1) (splitStep w s))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSolve_of_body
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitSolve_of_body (C e : ℕ) (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (A : ℕ)
    (hstart : ∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ A * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1),
      (∀ t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k []))
    (hround : ∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ A * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
            ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if splitAccept C e w s then
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output =
            pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (splitStep w s))) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSource_poly
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitSource_poly (c C : ℕ) (s : List Bool) :
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C).tm.runFrom
      (splitBank (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C) s (some (.loop (Fin.last c))) [])
      (catalogPolyCost (s.length + 1) C (c + 1) + 1) =
      splitBank (catalogPolyUnaryTM c C) s none
        (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ (c + 1)) true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSource_constant
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitSource_constant (C : ℕ) (s : List Bool) :
    (prependTM (List.replicate C true)).tm.runFrom
      (splitBank (prependTM (List.replicate C true)) s
        (some (0 : Fin ((List.replicate C true).length + 1))) []) (C + 1) =
      splitBank (prependTM (List.replicate C true)) s none (List.replicate C true)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitBody_envelope
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitBody_envelope (C e l n T : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ n + 1)
    (hT : T ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * e) * (l + 1) ^ e + 1) :
    T + 5 * l + 3 * n + 20 ≤
      ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSolve_source
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitSolve_source (C e : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State)
    (B : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hsource : ∀ s : List Bool, M.tm.runFrom (splitBank M s (some start) []) (B s.length) =
      splitBank M s none (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ e) true))
    (hbound : ∀ l, B l ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * e) * (l + 1) ^ e + 1) :
    ∃ (N : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      N.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSolve_closed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma splitSolve_closed (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => [])
        fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.split_hyps
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private theorem split_hyps (C e : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (B : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hsource : ∀ s : List Bool, M.tm.runFrom (splitBank M s (some start) []) (B s.length) =
      splitBank M s none (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ e) true))
    (hbound : ∀ l, B l ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * e) * (l + 1) ^ e + 1) :
    (∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1),
      (∀ t' < t, ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.initCfg w)
        t').state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.initCfg w) t =
        Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k [])) ∧
    (∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t').state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
        if splitAccept C e w s then
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t).state = none ∧
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t).output =
              pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k (splitStep w s)))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.split_sources
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private theorem split_sources (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (B : ℕ → ℕ),
      splitSolveTM C e = loopHostTM (splitBodyTM M start) lengthBitsTM .anchor true ∧
      (∀ s : List Bool, M.tm.runFrom (splitBank M s (some start) []) (B s.length) =
        splitBank M s none (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ e) true)) ∧
      (∀ l, B l ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * e) * (l + 1) ^ e + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.split_fuel
Turing.FinTM.splitSolveTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem splitSolveTM_computes (C e : ℕ) :
    (splitSolveTM C e).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with
        | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
        | none => [])
      (fun n => 20 * ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 46) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSolveTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem splitSolveTM_spaceUsed (C e : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (splitSolveTM C e).tm.spaceUsed ((splitSolveTM C e).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      23 * (splitSolveTM C e).k * ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 46) * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_splitSolve
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_splitSolve (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => [])
        fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_incFixed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_incFixed :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => (incFixed x).getD []) fun n => c * (n + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header: private def emitterSplitAccept (f : ℕ → ℕ) (w s : List Bool) : Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterSplit_find
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterSplit_find (f : ℕ → ℕ) (w : List Bool) :
    (List.range (w.length + 1)).find?
      (fun i => emitterSplitAccept f w ((splitStep w)^[i] [])) =
        solveSplitWith f w.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterSplit_result
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterSplit_result (f : ℕ → ℕ) (w : List Bool) :
    (match (List.range (w.length + 1)).find?
        (fun i => emitterSplitAccept f w ((splitStep w)^[i] [])) with
      | some i => pairEncode (w.take ((splitStep w)^[i] []).length)
          (w.drop ((splitStep w)^[i] []).length)
      | none => []) =
    (match solveSplitWith f w.length with
      | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
      | none => [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterSplit_loop_bound
Turing.FinTM.emitterSplit_of_body
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterSplit_of_body (f TE : ℕ → ℕ) (body : FinTM Bool)
    (anchor : body.State) (A : ℕ)
    (hstart : ∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ A * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2),
      (∀ j < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) j).state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg w) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k []))
    (hround : ∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ A * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) ∧
        (∀ j, 0 < j → j < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) j).state
            ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if emitterSplitAccept f w s then
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output =
            pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (splitStep w s))) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplitWith f w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => [])
        (fun n => c * (n + 1) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2))

    (c d : Cfg k Bool S w) (T : ℕ)
    (hfix : ∀ z : Cfg k Bool S w, (∃ q, z.state = some q ∧ stop q) → tm.step z = z)
    (hd : ∃ q, d.state = some q ∧ stop q) (hT : tm.runFrom c T = d) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (∀ j < t, ¬∃ q, (tm.runFrom c j).state = some q ∧ stop q) ∧
      tm.runFrom c t = d

      emitterCompareTM.tm.runFrom (emitterCompareCfg w u v p 0 true 0) t =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitter_width_budget

private lemma emitter_width_budget (f : ℕ → ℕ) (E : FinTM Bool)

    (hE : E.ComputesFunInTime (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE)
    (w s : List Bool) (hs : s.length ≤ w.length + 1) :
    E.ComputesInTime s (Nat.bits (f s.length)) (TE s.length) ∧
      (Nat.bits (f s.length)).length ≤ TE s.length ∧ TE s.length ≤ TE (w.length + 1)

          (if candidate then (j : ℤ) - 1 else other)
          (if candidate then other else (j : ℤ) - 1)) (j + 1) =
        emitterP2PrepareCfg w s s v (if candidate then 4 else 6) over p
          (if candidate then 0 else other) (if candidate then other else 0)

      emitterP2PrepareTM.tm.runFrom (emitterP2PrepareCfg w s [] [] 0 false 1 0 0) t =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_phase {k l : ℕ} {S H : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (src : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM l Bool H)
    (index : Fin k ↪ Fin l) (emb : S ↪ H) (anchor : H)
    (haway : ∀ q, emb q ≠ anchor) (good : S → Prop)
    (hagree : ∀ q, good q → ∀ inp work,
      host.tr (emb q) inp work = ((embedEmitTM index src).tr q inp work).mapState emb)
    (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ)
    (c d : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ)
    (hguard : ∀ j < t, ∀ q, (src.runFrom c j).state = some q → good q)
    (hr : src.runFrom c t = d) :
    host.runFrom ((embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] c).mapState emb) t =
        (embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] d).mapState emb ∧
      splitSafe host anchor ((embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] c).mapState emb) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_call_phase
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_call_phase {k l : ℕ} {S H : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (src : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM l Bool H)
    (index : Fin k ↪ Fin l) (emb : S ↪ H)
    (enter anchor : H) (henter : enter ≠ anchor) (haway : ∀ q, emb q ≠ anchor)
    (entry exit : S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, host.tr enter inp work =
      ((embedEmitTM index src).tr entry inp work).mapState emb)
    (hagree : ∀ q, q ≠ exit → ∀ inp work,
      host.tr (emb q) inp work = ((embedEmitTM index src).tr q inp work).mapState emb)
    (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ)
    (c d : Cfg k Bool S x) (hc : c.state = some entry) (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hguard : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < t → (src.runFrom c j).state ≠ some exit)
    (hr : src.runFrom c t = d) :
    let z := {(embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] c).mapState emb with state := some enter}
    host.runFrom z t = (embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] d).mapState emb ∧
      splitSafe host anchor z t

    (q : S) (index : Fin k ↪ Fin l) (emb : S → H)
    (tapes : Fin l → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin l → ℤ)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (d : Cfg l Bool H x)
    (hs : c.state.map emb = d.state) (hi : c.inputPos = d.inputPos)
    (ho : c.output = d.output)
    (selected : ∀ i, c.workTapes i = d.workTapes (index i) ∧
      c.workTapePos i = d.workTapePos (index i))
    (frame : ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range index → tapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ heads j = d.workTapePos j) :
    (embedEmitCfg index tapes heads [] c).mapState emb = d

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_bank_frame
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_bank_frame {S H : Type} (right : Bool) (k l : ℕ)
    (emb : S → H) (w s u v : List Bool) (q : S) :
    let index : Fin (if right then l else k) ↪ Fin (k + l + 1) :=
      match right with
      | false => emitterP2LeftIndex k l
      | true => emitterP2RightIndex k l
    (embedEmitCfg index
      (fun i => bufferTape (emitterP2Words k l s
        (if right then u else []) (if right then [] else v) i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) q
        (stateWord (if right then l else k) (if right then v else u)))).mapState emb =
          Cfg.ofWords (emb q) (emitterP2Words k l s u v)

    (w s u v : List Bool) (q : S) :
    (embedEmitCfg (emitterP2LeftIndex k l)
      (fun i => bufferTape (emitterP2Words k l s [] v i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) q (stateWord k u))).mapState emb =
        Cfg.ofWords (emb q) (emitterP2Words k l s u v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_right_frame

    (w s u v : List Bool) (q : S) :
    (embedEmitCfg (emitterP2RightIndex k l)
      (fun i => bufferTape (emitterP2Words k l s u [] i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) q (stateWord l v))).mapState emb =
        Cfg.ofWords (emb q) (emitterP2Words k l s u v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_one_frame {l : ℕ} {S H : Type} (slot : Fin l) (emb : S → H)
    (words : Fin l → List Bool) (w u : List Bool) (q : S) :
    (embedEmitCfg (emitterP2OneIndex slot) (fun i => bufferTape (words i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) q (fun _ : Fin 1 => u))).mapState emb =
        Cfg.ofWords (emb q) (Function.update words slot u)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_index_injective
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_index_injective (candidate : Bool) (k l : ℕ)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hl : 0 < l) :
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin (if candidate then 3 else 2) =>
      if i.val = 0 then
        if candidate then (0 : Fin (k + l + 1)) else emitterP2LeftIndex k l ⟨0, hk⟩
      else if candidate then
        if i.val = 1 then emitterP2LeftIndex k l ⟨0, hk⟩
        else emitterP2RightIndex k l ⟨0, hl⟩
      else emitterP2RightIndex k l ⟨0, hl⟩)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_admin_frame
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_admin_frame {S H : Type} (candidate : Bool) (k l : ℕ)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hl : 0 < l)
    (index : Fin (if candidate then 3 else 2) ↪ Fin (k + l + 1))
    (hindex : ∀ i, index i =
      if i.val = 0 then
        if candidate then 0 else emitterP2LeftIndex k l ⟨0, hk⟩
      else if candidate then
        if i.val = 1 then emitterP2LeftIndex k l ⟨0, hk⟩
        else emitterP2RightIndex k l ⟨0, hl⟩
      else emitterP2RightIndex k l ⟨0, hl⟩)
    (emb : S → H) (w s u v : List Bool) (q : S) :
    (embedEmitCfg index
      (if candidate then fun _ _ => none
        else fun i => bufferTape (emitterP2Words k l s [] [] i)) (fun _ => 0) []
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) q (fun i =>
        if candidate then if i.val = 0 then s else if i.val = 1 then u else v
        else if i.val = 0 then u else v))).mapState emb =
          Cfg.ofWords (emb q) (emitterP2Words k l s u v)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_pair_frame {H : Type} (k l : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hl : 0 < l)
    (emb : Fin 3 × Bool → H) (w s u v : List Bool) (q : Fin 3) (b : Bool) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_prepare
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_prepare (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s : List Bool) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    ∃ t ≤ 5 * (s.length + w.length + 3),
      B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.prepare (0, false))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] [])) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.prepare (8, decide (w.length < s.length)))
          (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s s (w.drop s.length)) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.prepare (0, false))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] [])) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_compare
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_compare (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * (max u.length v.length + 1),
      B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.compare (0, true))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.compare (2, decide (u = v))) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.compare (0, true))
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_erase
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_erase (right : Bool) (C D : FinTM Bool)
    (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool) (ok : Bool) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let tag : Fin 3 → EmitterP2State C.State D.State :=
      if right then .eraseRight ok else .eraseLeft ok
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * ((if right then v else u).length + 1),
      B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (tag 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (tag 2) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s
          (if right then u else []) (if right then [] else v)) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (tag 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_erase_left
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_erase_left (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool) (ok : Bool) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * (u.length + 1),
      B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.eraseLeft ok 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords (.eraseLeft ok 2) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] v) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.eraseLeft ok 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)) t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_erase_right
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_advance
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_advance (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s : List Bool) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_emit
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_emit (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s : List Bool) (hs : s.length ≤ w.length) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.emit 0) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s [] [])
    (B.tm.runFrom z (s.length + w.length + 3)).state = none ∧
      (B.tm.runFrom z (s.length + w.length + 3)).output =
        pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length) ∧
      splitSafe B.tm .anchor z (s.length + w.length + 3)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_after
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_after {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c : Cfg k Bool S w)
    (t : ℕ) (q r : S) (words : Fin k → List Bool)
    (hr : tm.runFrom c t = Cfg.ofWords q words) (hs : splitSafe tm anchor c t)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = controlAction 0 (some r))
    (hq : q ≠ anchor) (hnext : r ≠ anchor) :
    tm.runFrom c (t + 1) = Cfg.ofWords r words ∧ splitSafe tm anchor c (t + 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_test
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_test (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hfC : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < a → (C.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) j).state ≠ some cx)
    (hrC : C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) a =
      Cfg.ofWords cx (stateWord C.k u))
    (hfD : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < b → (D.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) j).state ≠ some dx)
    (hrD : D.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) b =
      Cfg.ofWords dx (stateWord D.k v)) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.prepare (8, false))
      (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s s (w.drop s.length))
    ∃ t ≤ a + b + 2 * (max u.length v.length + 1) + 4,
      B.tm.runFrom z t = Cfg.ofWords (.eraseLeft (decide (u = v)) 0)
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v) ∧ splitSafe B.tm .anchor z t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_finish
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_finish (C D : FinTM Bool) (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k)
    (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State) (w s u v : List Bool) (ok : Bool)
    (hok : ok = true → s.length ≤ w.length) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) (.eraseLeft ok 0) (emitterP2Words C.k D.k s u v)
    ∃ t ≤ 2 * u.length + 2 * v.length + 2 * s.length + w.length + 12,
      (∀ j < t, (B.tm.runFrom z j).state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      if ok then
        (B.tm.runFrom z t).state = none ∧
          (B.tm.runFrom z t).output = pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
      else B.tm.runFrom z t = Cfg.ofWords .anchor
        (emitterP2Words C.k D.k (splitStep w s) [] [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_strict_join
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_strict_join {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d : Cfg k Bool S w) (a b : ℕ)
    (hr : tm.runFrom c a = d) (hs : splitSafe tm anchor c a)
    (hf : ∀ j < b, (tm.runFrom d j).state ≠ some anchor) :
    ∀ j < a + b, (tm.runFrom c j).state ≠ some anchor

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_body_round
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_body_round (f : ℕ → ℕ) (C D : FinTM Bool)
    (hk : 0 < C.k) (hl : 0 < D.k) (ce cx : C.State) (de dx : D.State)
    (w s : List Bool) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hfC : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < a → (C.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) j).state ≠ some cx)
    (hrC : C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) a =
      Cfg.ofWords cx (stateWord C.k (Nat.bits (f s.length))))
    (hfD : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < b → (D.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) j).state ≠ some dx)
    (hrD : D.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) b =
      Cfg.ofWords dx (stateWord D.k (Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length))) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧
      t ≤ a + b + 10 * (s.length + w.length + (Nat.bits (f s.length)).length +
        (Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length).length + 10) ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < j → j < t → (B.tm.runFrom z j).state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      if emitterSplitAccept f w s then
        (B.tm.runFrom z t).state = none ∧
          (B.tm.runFrom z t).output = pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
      else B.tm.runFrom z t = Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord B.k (splitStep w s))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterP2_closed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterP2_closed (f : ℕ → ℕ) (E : FinTM Bool) (TE : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hTE : Monotone TE) (hE : E.ComputesFunInTime (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesFunInTime
      (fun w => match solveSplitWith f w.length with
        | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
        | none => [])
      (fun n => c * (n + 1) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.splitSolveWithTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem splitSolveWithTM_computes (f : ℕ → ℕ) (E : FinTM Bool) (TE : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hTE : Monotone TE) (hE : E.ComputesFunInTime (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE) :
    (splitSolveWithTM E).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun w => match solveSplitWith f w.length with
        | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
        | none => [])
      (fun n => 20 * (591 + 26 * E.k) * (n + 1) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_splitSolveWith
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_splitSolveWith (f : ℕ → ℕ) (E : FinTM Bool)
    (TE : ℕ → ℕ) (hTE : Monotone TE)
    (hE : E.ComputesFunInTime (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime
        (fun w => match solveSplitWith f w.length with
          | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
          | none => [])
        fun n => c * (n + 1) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterToken_double (x pre rest out : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (hx : x = pre ++ b :: rest) :
    unaryTokenTM.tm.runFrom
      (scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) out) 2 =
      scanCfg x (some (if b then (0 : Fin 6) else 3)) (pre ++ [b]).length
        (by simp [hx]) (out ++ [b, b])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.name: Turing.FinTM.emitterToken_separator
Turing.FinTM.emitterToken_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Pr.header:
private lemma emitterToken_run (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest),
      unaryTokenTM.tm.runFrom
        (scanCfg x (some (0 : Fin 6)) pre.length (by simp [hx]) out)
        (2 * (unaryTokenSplit rest).1.length + (unaryTokenSplit rest).2.length + 3) =
        scanCfg x none x.length (by omega)
          (out ++ pairEncode (unaryTokenSplit rest).1 (unaryTokenSplit rest).2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostSilentCfg_eq

theorem vhostSilentCfg_eq (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (capPre out₀ : List Bool) :
    vhostSilentCfg c b p capPre out₀ =
      embedSilentCfg (Fin.castAddEmb 1) (vhostCap m) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostEmitTM_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostEmitTM_step (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (c : Cfg m Bool S y)
    (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (pre : List Bool) :
    ∃ b', FinTM.VirtualTag (M.step c).inputPos b' ∧
      (vhostEmitTM M).step (vhostCfg c b p pre) =
        vhostCfg (M.step c) b' p pre

    (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ b', FinTM.VirtualTag (M.runFrom c t).inputPos b' ∧
      (vhostEmitTM M).runFrom (vhostCfg c b p pre) t =
        vhostCfg (M.runFrom c t) b' p pre

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:

    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin m) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_buffer
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_buffer (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (vhostEmitTM M).visitedByTapeHead (vhostCfg c b p pre) t (vhostBuffer m) =
      (Finset.range (t + 1)).image
        (fun u => ((M.runFrom c u).inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostCfg_buffer_head_mem
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostCfg_buffer_head_mem (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ((vhostEmitTM M).runFrom (vhostCfg c b p pre) t).workTapePos
        (vhostBuffer m) ∈ Finset.Icc (-1 : ℤ) (y.length : ℤ)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostEmitTM_spaceUsed_le
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostEmitTM_spaceUsed_le (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (vhostEmitTM M).spaceUsed (vhostCfg c b p pre) t ≤
      M.spaceUsed c t + (y.length + 2)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostEmitTM_emitting_halt
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostEmitTM_emitting_halt (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (pre : List Bool) (q : S) (bit : Bool)
    (hq : c.state = some q)
    (ha : (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).state = none)
    (ho : (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).output = some bit) :
    ((vhostEmitTM M).step (vhostCfg c b p pre)).state = none ∧
      ((vhostEmitTM M).step (vhostCfg c b p pre)).output =
        pre ++ c.output ++ [bit]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostSilent_layout
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
private theorem vhostSilent_layout (j : Fin ((1 + m) + 1)) :
    (j ∈ Set.range (Fin.castAddEmb 1 : Fin (1 + m) ↪ Fin ((1 + m) + 1)) ↔
      j.val < 1 + m) ∧
    (j ∉ Set.range (Fin.castAddEmb 1 : Fin (1 + m) ↪ Fin ((1 + m) + 1)) ↔
      j = vhostCap m)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostSilentTM_runFrom
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostSilentTM_runFrom (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (c : Cfg m Bool S y)
    (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (capPre out₀ : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ b', FinTM.VirtualTag (M.runFrom c t).inputPos b' ∧
      (vhostSilentTM M).runFrom (vhostSilentCfg c b p capPre out₀) t =
        vhostSilentCfg (M.runFrom c t) b' p capPre out₀

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.name: Turing.vhostSilentTM_spaceUsed_le
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Vi.header:
theorem vhostSilentTM_spaceUsed_le (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (capPre out₀ : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (vhostSilentTM M).spaceUsed (vhostSilentCfg c b p capPre out₀) t ≤
      M.spaceUsed c t + (y.length + 2) +
        ((capPre ++ (M.runFrom c t).output).length + 1)

theorem capture_run {input : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (host : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool H) (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool),
      host.tr (emb s) inp w =
        captureAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp fun i => w i.castSucc))
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S input) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) :
    host.runFrom (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t =
      captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ (tm.runFrom c₀ t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:

    (host : MultiTapeTM k Bool H) (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin k → Option Bool),
      host.tr (emb s) inp w = emitAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp w))
    (pre : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S input) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) :
    host.runFrom (emitCfg emb ret pre c₀) t =
      emitCfg emb ret pre (tm.runFrom c₀ t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.redirect_apply

Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
theorem redirectTM_computes {M : FinTM Bool} {haltOn : Bool}
    {x w : List Bool} {t : ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w t)
    (hlast : w.getLast? = some haltOn) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).ComputesInTime x [] t

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_live
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
theorem redirectTM_live {M : FinTM Bool} {haltOn : Bool}
    {x w : List Bool} {t : ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w t)
    (hlast : w.getLast? ≠ some haltOn) :
    ∀ u : ℕ, ¬((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) u).Halted

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_runFrom
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
theorem redirectTM_runFrom (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).state =
        (match (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).state with
          | some s => some (.inl (s, (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output.getLast?))
          | none =>
            if (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output.getLast? = some haltOn then none
            else some (.inr ())) ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).output = []

    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) (t : ℕ) :

    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) 2 =

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_start
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_start (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    ∃ a ≤ 2 * T + 5, ∃ (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
      (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a =
        timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) tapes heads b

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_computes
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
theorem timedCondTM_computes {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool}
    {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
      (fun n => 5 * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timedHeads
Turing.FinTM.timed_control_heads

    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) :
    (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c).workTapePos =
      timedHeads D M₁ M₂ c.workTapePos (fun _ => 0) c.output.length

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_branch_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_branch_heads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) :
    (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b).workTapePos =
      timedHeads D M₁ M₂ heads c.workTapePos 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timedReadyCfg_workTapePos
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timedReadyCfg_workTapePos (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) :
    (timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b).workTapePos =
      timedHeads D M₁ M₂ c.workTapePos (fun _ => 0) 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timedReady_dispatch
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timedReady_dispatch (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) :
    let V : MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := by
      rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ b, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ b]
      exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm
    ({timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b with
        state := some (.inr (.inr (.inr V.q₀))), inputPos := 1} :
      Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x) =
      timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ (V.initCfg x) c.workTapes c.workTapePos b

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_read_heads
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_read_heads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) (hs : c.state = none) (ho : c.output = [b]) :
    ∀ u ≤ 2, ∃ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 1 ∧
      ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) u).workTapePos =
        timedHeads D M₁ M₂ c.workTapePos (fun _ => 0) z

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timed_ledger
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
private lemma timed_ledger (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    let V : MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := by
      rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ b, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ b]
      exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm
    ∀ u, ∃ v ≤ T, ∃ w ≤ u, ∃ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 1 ∧
      ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos =
        timedHeads D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos
          (V.runFrom (V.initCfg x) w).workTapePos z

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_spaceUsed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
theorem timedCondTM_spaceUsed (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T t : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.spaceUsed ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) T +
        (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t + 2

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.name: Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Wr.header:
theorem computesFunInTime_cond {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool}
    {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
        (fun n => c * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonHeaderCall
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonHeaderCall :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (α.length + 1), 0 < t ∧
        (∀ u, 0 < u → u < t →
          (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠
            some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (canonHeader α))

Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_step
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_step (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (u j : ℕ)
    (hu : u < b + 1) (hj : j < x.length) (out : List Bool) :
    (guardBlockTM b).step (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b u) j (by omega) out) =
      guardCfg b x (guardPhase b (u + 1)) (j + 1) (by omega) out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_run (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) (u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ≤ b + 1) (hlen : j + u ≤ x.length) :
    (guardBlockTM b).runFrom (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out) u =
      guardCfg b x (guardPhase b u) (j + u) hlen out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_blank
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_blank (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (u : ℕ) (out : List Bool) :
    (guardBlockTM b).step
        (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b u) x.length le_rfl out) =
      guardCfg b x none x.length le_rfl out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_short
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:

    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (hshort : x.length - j < b + 1) (out : List Bool) :
    (guardBlockTM b).runFrom (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out)
        (x.length - j + 1) = guardCfg b x none x.length le_rfl out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardTime
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private def guardTime (b : ℕ) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg 0 Bool (Option (Fin (b + 1))) x) : ℕ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_interior
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_interior (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) (u : ℕ) (hu : 0 < u)
    (ht : u < guardTime b (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out)) :
    ∃ s, ((guardBlockTM b).runFrom
        (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out) u).state = some s ∧
      s ≠ guardPhase b 0 ∧ s ≠ none

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.binaryGuardTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private def binaryGuardTM (b : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM 1 Bool (CounterLoopState (Option (Fin (b + 1))))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.binaryGuardStart
Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_orbit
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_orbit (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) (r : ℕ)
    (hr : j + (b + 1) * r ≤ x.length) :
    counterLoopOrbit (guardBlockTM b) (guardTime b)
        (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out) r =
      guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) (j + (b + 1) * r) hr out

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.guardBlock_segment
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma guardBlock_segment (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) :
    let c := guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out
    c.state = some (guardPhase b 0) ∧ 0 < guardTime b c ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < guardTime b c →
        ∃ s, ((guardBlockTM b).runFrom c u).state = some s ∧
          s ≠ guardPhase b 0 ∧ s ≠ none)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.binaryGuard_done
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma binaryGuard_done (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out w : List Bool)
    (hfit : j + (b + 1) * Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) ≤ x.length) :
    ∃ T ≤ 5 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2,
      let c := (binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) T
      c.state = some .done ∧ c.output = out ∧
        c.inputPos.val = j + (b + 1) * Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) + 1 ∧
        (∀ u < T,
          ((binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) u).state ≠
            some .done ∧
          ((binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) u).state ≠
            some .escape)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.binaryGuard_escape
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma binaryGuard_escape (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out w : List Bool)
    (hshort : x.length < j + (b + 1) * Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)) :
    ∃ T ≤ (b + 5) * (x.length + 1) + 2 * w.length,
      let c := (binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) T
      c.state = some .escape ∧ c.output = out ∧ c.inputPos.val = x.length + 1 ∧
        (∀ u < T,
          ((binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) u).state ≠
            some .done ∧
          ((binaryGuardTM b).runFrom (binaryGuardStart b x j hj out w) u).state ≠
            some .escape)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBitsOK
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonBitsOK (w : List Bool) : Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBits_fold
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBits_fold (w : List Bool) (a : Bool) :

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBits_of_last
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBits_of_last (w : List Bool) :
    canonBitsOK w = true → (w.foldr Nat.bit 0).bits = w

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBits_bits
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private lemma canonBits_bits (n : ℕ) : canonBitsOK n.bits = true

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBitsOK_iff
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBitsOK_iff (w : List Bool) :
    canonBitsOK w = true ↔ w = (w.foldr Nat.bit 0).bits

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonCount
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonCount (w : List Bool) : List Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonCount_spec
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonCount_spec (w : List Bool) :
    incFixed (w ++ [false]) = some (canonCount w) ∧
      (canonCount w).length = w.length + 1 ∧
      (canonCount w).foldr Nat.bit 0 = w.foldr Nat.bit 0 + 1

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBitsTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonBitsTM (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (ScanPhase Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBitsTM_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBitsTM_run (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (α : List Bool)
    (w : Fin k → List Bool) :
    (canonBitsTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) (.fwd true) w)
        (2 * (w i).length + 2) = Cfg.ofWords (.done (canonBitsOK (w i))) w ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * (w i).length + 2, ∀ b,
        ((canonBitsTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) (.fwd true) w) t).state ≠
          some (.done b))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonHeaderSeam
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonHeaderSeam :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (α.length + 1), 0 < t ∧
        (∀ u < t,
          (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠
            some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (canonHeader α))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonCountTM
Turing.MachineFormat.canonVerdictTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonVerdictTM (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (ScanPhase Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonVerdictTM_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonVerdictTM_run (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (α : List Bool)
    (w : Fin k → List Bool) :
    let c := (canonVerdictTM k i).runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) (.fwd true) w) (2 * (w i).length + 3)
    c.state = none ∧ c.output = [canonBitsOK (w i)]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonHeaderBitsTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonHeaderBitsTM :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (a : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun α => [canonBitsOK (canonHeader α)])
        (fun n => a * (n + 1))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonHeaderOK
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonHeaderOK (α : List Bool) : Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonHeaderOK_iff
Turing.MachineFormat.scan_eq_none_of_canonHeaderOK
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma scan_eq_none_of_canonHeaderOK (F : MachineFormat) (α : List Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonHeaderOKTM
Turing.MachineFormat.canonGuardBlock
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonGuardBlock (F : MachineFormat) : ℕ

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGuardBlock_pos
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private lemma canonGuardBlock_pos (F : MachineFormat) : 0 < canonGuardBlock F

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.decode_of_canonGuard
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma decode_of_canonGuard (F : MachineFormat) (α bits rest : List Bool)
    (hp : pairDecode α = some (bits, rest))
    (hg : rest.length < canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1)) :
    F.decode α = F.fallback

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGuard_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonGuard_run (F : MachineFormat) (α bits rest : List Bool)
    (hp : pairDecode α = some (bits, rest)) :
    let B := canonGuardBlock F
    let j := 2 * bits.length + 2
    ∃ hj : j ≤ α.length, ∃ T ≤ (B + 4) * (α.length + 1) + 2 * (bits.length + 1),
      let c := (binaryGuardTM (B - 1)).runFrom
        (binaryGuardStart (B - 1) α j hj [] (canonCount bits)) T
      c.state = some (if B * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length then .done else .escape) ∧
        c.output = [] ∧
        c.inputPos.val = (if B * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
          then j + B * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) + 1 else α.length + 1) ∧
        (∀ u < T,
          ((binaryGuardTM (B - 1)).runFrom
            (binaryGuardStart (B - 1) α j hj [] (canonCount bits)) u).state ≠ some .done ∧
          ((binaryGuardTM (B - 1)).runFrom
            (binaryGuardStart (B - 1) α j hj [] (canonCount bits)) u).state ≠ some .escape)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStrictInstall
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStrictInstall (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool)
    (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ x arg : List Bool,
        ∃ t ≤ a * (T arg.length + arg.length + (f arg).length + 1),
          0 < t ∧
          (∀ u < t, (C.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f arg))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonEmbedEq
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonEmbedEq {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S x) (d : Cfg k Bool S x)
    (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin k → ℤ)
    (hs : c.state = d.state) (hp : c.inputPos = d.inputPos) (ho : c.output = d.output)
    (selected : ∀ i, c.workTapes i = d.workTapes (ι i) ∧
      c.workTapePos i = d.workTapePos (ι i))
    (outside : ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range ι →
      tapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ heads j = d.workTapePos j) :
    embedEmitCfg ι tapes heads [] c = d

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonEmbedWords
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonEmbedWords {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (q : S)
    (v : Fin m → List Bool) (ambient wanted : Fin k → List Bool)
    (selected : ∀ i, wanted (ι i) = v i)
    (outside : ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range ι → ambient j = wanted j) :
    embedEmitCfg ι (fun j => FinTM.bufferTape (ambient j)) (fun _ => 0) []
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q v) = Cfg.ofWords q wanted

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonPreserveInstall
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonPreserveInstall (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool)
    (T : ℕ → ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (dst : Fin C.k) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ),
      dst.val = 1 ∧ ∀ x arg : List Bool,
        ∃ t ≤ a * (T arg.length + arg.length + (f arg).length + 1),
          (∀ u < t, (C.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords exit (Function.update (stateWord C.k arg) dst (f arg))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonHeaderCountSeam
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonHeaderCountSeam :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (dst : Fin C.k) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ),
      dst.val = 1 ∧ ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (α.length + 1),
        (∀ u < t, (C.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (Function.update (stateWord C.k (canonHeader α)) dst
            (canonCount (canonHeader α)))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonOffset
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonOffset (w : List Bool) : List Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonOffset_spec
Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonOffsetTM
Turing.MachineFormat.canonReadyWords
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonReadyWords (k : ℕ) (header : List Bool) : Fin k → List Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonReadySeam
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonReadySeam :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ), 4 ≤ C.k ∧
      ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (α.length + 1),
        (∀ u < t, (C.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (canonReadyWords C.k (canonHeader α))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonSeekOnBank
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonSeekOnBank {k : ℕ} (ι : Fin 2 ↪ Fin k) :
    ∃ (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S)
      (R : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (entry exit : S) (a : ℕ),
      ∀ {x : List Bool} (p : ℕ) (w : List Bool),
        Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = p → ∀ hp : p ≤ x.length + 1,
        ∀ d : Cfg k Bool S x, d.state = some entry →
        (∀ q : ℤ, -1 ≤ q → q ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
          d.workTapes (ι 0) (d.workTapePos (ι 0) + q) = FinTM.bufferTape w q) →
        (∀ q, d.workTapes (ι 1) q = none) →
        ∃ t ≤ a * (w.length + d.inputPos.val + p + 1),
          (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          R.runFrom d t = { d with state := some exit, inputPos := ⟨p, by omega⟩ }

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonGuardFront
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonGuardFront (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry yes no : C.State) (a : ℕ), 4 ≤ C.k ∧ yes ≠ no ∧
      ∀ α bits rest : List Bool, pairDecode α = some (bits, rest) →
        ∃ t ≤ a * (α.length + 1),
          let d := C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) t
          d.state = some (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
            then yes else no) ∧ d.output = [] ∧
          d.inputPos.val = (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
            then 2 * bits.length + 3 else α.length + 1) ∧
          ∀ i : Fin C.k, i.val ≠ 1 →
            d.workTapes i = FinTM.bufferTape (canonReadyWords C.k bits i) ∧
              d.workTapePos i = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBoolPopTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonBoolPopTM (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Option Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBoolPop_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBoolPop_run (k : ℕ) (positive : 0 < k) (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (canonBoolPopTM k ⟨0, positive⟩).runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) none (stateWord k [b])) 1 =
      Cfg.ofWords (some b) (fun _ => [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonBoolBranch
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonBoolBranch (M : FinTM Bool) (p : List Bool → Bool)
    (c : ℕ) (computes : M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) (fun n => c * (n + 1))) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry : C.State) (exit : Bool → C.State) (a : ℕ),
      0 < C.k ∧ Function.Injective exit ∧
      ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1),
        (∀ u < t, ∀ b, (C.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠ some (exit b)) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords (exit (p x)) (fun _ => [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonHeaderBranch
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonHeaderBranch :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry : C.State) (exit : Bool → C.State) (a : ℕ),
      0 < C.k ∧ Function.Injective exit ∧
      ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1),
        (∀ u < t, ∀ b, (C.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠ some (exit b)) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords (exit (canonHeaderOK x)) (fun _ => [])

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.decode_of_canonHeader
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma decode_of_canonHeader (F : MachineFormat) (x : List Bool)
    (invalid : canonHeaderOK x = false) : F.decode x = F.fallback

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonSeam_avoids
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonSeam_avoids {k : ℕ} {S R : Type} [DecidableEq S]
    {x : List Bool} (A : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (leave : S)
    (B : MultiTapeTM k Bool R) (enter : R) (target : S ⊕ R)
    {d e : Cfg k Bool S x} {t v : ℕ}
    (run : A.runFrom d t = e) (atExit : e.state = some leave)
    (first : ∀ u < t, (A.runFrom d u).state ≠ some leave)
    (before : ∀ u ≤ t, ((A.runFrom d u).mapState (Sum.inl : S → S ⊕ R)).state ≠
      some target)
    (after : ∀ u < v,
      ((B.runFrom (e.mapState (fun _ => enter)) u).mapState (Sum.inr : R → S ⊕ R)).state ≠
        some target) :
    ∀ u < t + 1 + v,
      ((seamCompTM A leave B enter).runFrom (d.mapState Sum.inl) u).state ≠
        some target

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonCounterBank
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonCounterBank {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : Fin 1 ↪ Fin k

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGuard_onBank
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonGuard_onBank {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (F : MachineFormat)
    (x bits rest : List Bool) (pair : pairDecode x = some (bits, rest))
    (d : Cfg k Bool (CounterLoopState (Option (Fin (canonGuardBlock F - 1 + 1)))) x)
    (control : d.state = some (.dec .run))
    (position : d.inputPos.val = 2 * bits.length + 3)
    (counter : d.workTapes i = FinTM.bufferTape (canonCount bits))
    (home : d.workTapePos i = 0) (silent : d.output = []) :
    let G := embedEmitTM (canonCounterBank i) (binaryGuardTM (canonGuardBlock F - 1))
    ∃ t ≤ (canonGuardBlock F + 6) * (x.length + 1),
      let e := G.runFrom d t
      e.state = some (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
        then .done else .escape) ∧ e.output = [] ∧
      e.inputPos.val = (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
        then 2 * bits.length + 3 + canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1)
        else x.length + 1) ∧
      (∀ u < t, (G.runFrom d u).state ≠ some .done ∧
        (G.runFrom d u).state ≠ some .escape) ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ i → e.workTapes j = d.workTapes j ∧ e.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonGuardReady
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonGuardReady (F : MachineFormat) (k : ℕ) (hk : 4 ≤ k) :
    ∃ (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S)
      (C : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (entry : S) (exit : Bool → S) (a : ℕ),
      Function.Injective exit ∧ ∀ x bits rest : List Bool,
        pairDecode x = some (bits, rest) → ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1),
          let start := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (canonReadyWords k bits)
          let e := C.runFrom start t
          e.state = some (exit (decide
            (canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length))) ∧
          e.output = [] ∧ e.inputPos.val =
            (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
              then 2 * bits.length + 3 else x.length + 1) ∧
          (∀ u < t, ∀ b, (C.runFrom start u).state ≠ some (exit b)) ∧
          ∀ j, j.val ≠ 1 →
            e.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape (canonReadyWords k bits j) ∧
              e.workTapePos j = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonGuardFrontStrict
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonGuardFrontStrict (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry : C.State) (exit : Bool → C.State) (a : ℕ),
      4 ≤ C.k ∧ Function.Injective exit ∧ ∀ x bits rest : List Bool,
        pairDecode x = some (bits, rest) → ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1),
          let start := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])
          let e := C.tm.runFrom start t
          e.state = some (exit (decide
            (canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length))) ∧
          e.output = [] ∧ e.inputPos.val =
            (if canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length
              then 2 * bits.length + 3 else x.length + 1) ∧
          (∀ u < t, ∀ b, (C.tm.runFrom start u).state ≠ some (exit b)) ∧
          ∀ j, j.val ≠ 1 →
            e.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape (canonReadyWords C.k bits j) ∧
              e.workTapePos j = 0

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonBlankLift
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonBlankLift {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (bank : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (q : S) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (embedEmitTM bank M).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q (fun _ => [])) t =
      embedEmitCfg bank (fun _ => FinTM.bufferTape []) (fun _ => 0) []
        (M.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q (fun _ => [])) t)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonCheckedFront
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonCheckedFront (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry : C.State) (exit : Option Bool → C.State) (a : ℕ),
      4 ≤ C.k ∧ Function.Injective exit ∧ ∀ x : List Bool,
        ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1), ∃ verdict : Option Bool,
          let start := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])
          let e := C.tm.runFrom start t
          e.state = some (exit verdict) ∧ e.output = [] ∧
          (∀ u < t, ∀ q, (C.tm.runFrom start u).state ≠ some (exit q)) ∧
          (verdict ≠ some true → F.decode x = F.fallback) ∧
          (verdict = some true → ∃ bits rest,
            pairDecode x = some (bits, rest) ∧ bits = (codeBitsNat bits).bits ∧
            canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length ∧
            e.inputPos.val = 2 * bits.length + 3 ∧
            ∀ j, j.val ≠ 1 →
              e.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape (canonReadyWords C.k bits j) ∧
                e.workTapePos j = 0)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonExitDispatch
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonExitDispatch {k : ℕ} {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (positive : 0 < k) (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start : S)
    (exit : Option Bool → S) (distinct : Function.Injective exit) :
    ∃ (R : Type) (_ : Fintype R) (_ : DecidableEq R) (N : MultiTapeTM k Bool R)
      (entry : R) (leave : Bool → R), Function.Injective leave ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (v : Option Bool),
        let d := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) start (fun _ => [])
        (M.runFrom d t).state = some (exit v) →
        (∀ u < t, ∀ q, (M.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (exit q)) →
        N.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords entry (fun _ => [])) (t + 1) =
          (M.runFrom d t).mapState (fun _ => leave (decide (v = some true))) ∧
        ∀ u < t + 1, ∀ b, (N.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠ some (leave b)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.exists_canonParseFront
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma exists_canonParseFront (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry : C.State) (exit : Bool → C.State) (a : ℕ),
      4 ≤ C.k ∧ Function.Injective exit ∧ ∀ x : List Bool,
        ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + 1), ∃ verdict : Bool,
          let start := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (fun _ => [])
          let e := C.tm.runFrom start t
          e.state = some (exit verdict) ∧ e.output = [] ∧
          (∀ u < t, ∀ q, (C.tm.runFrom start u).state ≠ some (exit q)) ∧
          (verdict = false → F.decode x = F.fallback) ∧
          (verdict = true → ∃ bits rest,
            pairDecode x = some (bits, rest) ∧ bits = (codeBitsNat bits).bits ∧
            canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length ∧
            e.inputPos.val = 2 * bits.length + 3 ∧
            ∀ j, j.val ≠ 1 →
              e.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape (canonReadyWords C.k bits j) ∧
                e.workTapePos j = 0)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGrammar
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonGrammar (k n : ℕ) (rest : List Bool) : Option (List Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.scan_eq_canonGrammar
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma scan_eq_canonGrammar (F : MachineFormat) (α bits rest : List Bool)
    (hp : pairDecode α = some (bits, rest)) (hb : bits = (codeBitsNat bits).bits)
    (hg : canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length) :
    F.scan α = canonGrammar F.k (codeBitsNat bits) rest

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonGrammar_verdict
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonGrammar_verdict (F : MachineFormat) (α bits rest : List Bool)
    (hp : pairDecode α = some (bits, rest)) (hb : bits = (codeBitsNat bits).bits)
    (hg : canonGuardBlock F * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length) :
    ((canonGrammar F.k (codeBitsNat bits) rest).isSome = false → F.decode α = F.fallback) ∧
      ((canonGrammar F.k (codeBitsNat bits) rest).isSome = true →
        ∃ tail, F.scan α = some tail)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStrip
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonStrip (α : List Bool) : List Bool

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStrip_append
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStrip_append (u tail : List Bool) (h : tail.all id = true) :
    canonStrip (u ++ [false] ++ tail) = u ++ [false]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonFlatMap_last
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonFlatMap_last {A : Type} (L : List A) (f : A → List Bool) (hL : L ≠ [])
    (hf : ∀ a ∈ L, ∃ u, f a = u ++ [false]) : ∃ u, L.flatMap f = u ++ [false]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.actionBitsK_last
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma actionBitsK_last {k n : ℕ} (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ∃ u, actionBitsK a = u ++ [false]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.serializeK_last
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma serializeK_last {k n : ℕ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ∃ u, serializeK M = u ++ [false]

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonScan_all
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonScan_all (F : MachineFormat) (α tail : List Bool)
    (hs : F.scan α = some tail) : tail.all id = true

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStrip_of_scan
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStrip_of_scan (F : MachineFormat) (α tail : List Bool)
    (hs : F.scan α = some tail) : canonStrip α = F.serialize (F.decode α)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonStrip_split
Turing.MachineFormat.canonStrip_boundary
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonStrip_boundary (w : List Bool) :
    (canonStrip w).length ≤ w.length ∧
      w.take (canonStrip w).length = canonStrip w ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length), (canonStrip w).length ≤ r → w[r] = true) ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length), (canonStrip w).length = r + 1 → w[r] = false)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonTrimTM
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header: private def canonTrimTM (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (ScanPhase Bool)

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonEraseLast
Turing.MachineFormat.canonTrim_run
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonTrim_run (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (x : List Bool)
    (words : Fin k → List Bool) :

    (distinct : Function.Injective exit) :
    ∃ (H : Type) (_ : Fintype H) (_ : DecidableEq H) (N : MultiTapeTM m Bool H)
      (anchor escape : H), escape ≠ anchor ∧
      ∀ (x : List Bool) (d : Cfg m Bool S x), d.state = some entry →
        ∀ (t : ℕ) (v : Bool), (M.runFrom d t).state = some (exit v) →
          (∀ u < t, ∀ b, (M.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (exit b)) →
          0 < t + 2 ∧
          N.runFrom (d.mapState (fun _ => anchor)) (t + 2) =
            (M.runFrom d t).mapState (fun _ => if v then anchor else escape) ∧
          ∀ u, 0 < u → u < t + 2 →
            ∃ q, (N.runFrom (d.mapState (fun _ => anchor)) u).state = some q ∧

        ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + w.length + 1), 0 < t ∧
          (N.runFrom d t).state = some
            (if (codeSkipActionK k (counterValue w) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome

          (N.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonRepeat_orbit {m : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (anchor escape : S) (τ : Cfg m Bool S x → ℕ)
    (valid : Cfg m Bool S x → Prop) (tail : Cfg m Bool S x → List Bool)
    (r : List Bool → Option (List Bool))
    (step : ∀ c, valid c → c.state = some anchor →
      (M.runFrom c (τ c)).state = some (if (r (tail c)).isSome then anchor else escape) ∧
      ∀ ys, r (tail c) = some ys → valid (M.runFrom c (τ c)) ∧
        tail (M.runFrom c (τ c)) = ys)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S x) (hc : valid c) (ha : c.state = some anchor) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ j ≤ n,
      (∀ i < j, valid (roundOrbit M τ c i) ∧ (roundOrbit M τ c i).state = some anchor) ∧
      ((j = n ∧ valid (roundOrbit M τ c j) ∧
          (roundOrbit M τ c j).state = some anchor ∧
          codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c) = some (tail (roundOrbit M τ c j))) ∨
        (0 < j ∧ (roundOrbit M τ c j).state = some escape ∧
          codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c) = none))

TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.name: Turing.MachineFormat.canonCounterRepeat
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/CodeSimu.header:
private lemma canonCounterRepeat {m : ℕ} {S : Type} [DecidableEq S] {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (anchor escape : S) (different : escape ≠ anchor)
    (τ : Cfg m Bool S x → ℕ) (valid : Cfg m Bool S x → Prop)
    (tail : Cfg m Bool S x → List Bool) (r : List Bool → Option (List Bool)) (B : ℕ)
    (spec : ∀ d, valid d → d.state = some anchor →
      0 < τ d ∧ τ d ≤ B ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < τ d →
        ∃ q, (M.runFrom d u).state = some q ∧ q ≠ anchor ∧ q ≠ escape) ∧
      (M.runFrom d (τ d)).state = some (if (r (tail d)).isSome then anchor else escape) ∧
      ∀ ys, r (tail d) = some ys → valid (M.runFrom d (τ d)) ∧
        tail (M.runFrom d (τ d)) = ys)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S x) (hc : valid c) (ha : c.state = some anchor)
    (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ)
    (word : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      ct (cp + z) = FinTM.bufferTape w z)
    (n : ℕ) (value : Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = n) :
    ∃ T ≤ n * (B + 4) + 2 * w.length + 2, ∃ j ≤ n,
      T = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, τ (roundOrbit M τ c i)) +
        counterOverhead w (j + if (codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c)).isSome then 1 else 0) ∧
      (counterLoopTM M anchor (some escape)).runFrom
          (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct cp) T =
        counterLoopCfg (some (if (codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c)).isSome then .done else .escape))
          (roundOrbit M τ c j)
          (fun z => if cp ≤ z ∧ z < cp + (w.length : ℤ) then
            if (codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c)).isSome then some true
            else FinTM.bufferTape (counterWord w j) (z - cp) else ct z) cp ∧
      (∀ u < T,
        ((counterLoopTM M anchor (some escape)).runFrom
          (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some .done ∧
        ((counterLoopTM M anchor (some escape)).runFrom
          (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some .escape) ∧
      (∀ ys, codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c) = some ys →
        j = n ∧ valid (roundOrbit M τ c j) ∧ tail (roundOrbit M τ c j) = ys) ∧
      (codeSkipRepeat r n (tail c) = none →
        0 < j ∧ (roundOrbit M τ c j).state = some escape)
